paper.title: Faster Than Flash: Exploiting Attention Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
paper.abstract: The development of long-context Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by the memory bandwidth bottleneck and quadratic complexity of the attention mechanism during decoding. To overcome the inherent trade-offs between the memory overhead of metadata-based metrics and the computational inefficiency of adaptive selection strategies, we present Faster Flash Decoding (FFD), a novel hardware-algorithm co-design framework designed to break the memory wall in long-context decoding. FFD integrates

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是长上下文自回归解码中的内存带宽瓶颈，重点不是训练阶段的长序列计算，而是每生成一个 token 都要从 HBM 重新读取大段 KV cache 的问题。已有训练-free 稀疏注意力通常把“选择重要 token/block”和“执行注意力计算”拆成两个阶段：selector 依赖额外 metadata 做重要性估计，computer 再按索引取数计算。这带来两个具体代价：metadata 本身占内存和带宽；自适应选择策略如果接近 top-p，又需要全局 softmax 或同步，抵消稀疏带来的收益。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把长上下文 decoding 的稀疏注意力问题重新放回硬件执行路径里处理。它不是单纯提出一个新的 attention pruning 指标，而是尝试消除 selector-computer 分离造成的系统开销。对基座模型研究的启发主要有两点：第一，长上下文能力不能只看预训练长度和 benchmark 分数，decode 阶段的 KV 访问形态会直接限制可用上下文长度；第二，训练-free 稀疏化如果要真正可用，选择策略必须和 kernel 融合，否则理论 sparsity 很容易被索引、同步、metadata 读写吃掉。
summary.technical_approach: FFD 的核心是 content-aware scanning 加 top-δ selection，并把二者做成 fused kernel。它不额外存 cluster、partial dimension 或几何 bound 这类 metadata，而是把 K cache 拆成低比特量化表示和残差信息：低比特 K thumbnail 用于高速估计 query-key 相似度，残差路径用于保持计算精度。这样 selector 扫描的对象就是 KV cache 的压缩内容本身，而不是外部索引结构。选择策略上，top-δ 不固定保留 top-k，也不做 top-p 所需的全局概率累积，而是按 block 对 attention score sum 的估计贡献做过滤。直觉上，如果某些 block 对 softmax 分母贡献低于数值精度相关阈值，它们对最终 attention 输出的影响可以被忽略。由于 LLM attention 分布常有较强稀疏性和局部峰值，这个判断可以近似并行化，避免全局同步。系统实现上，FFD 把扫描、选择和后续 attention 计算融合在一个 kernel 内，computer 直接复用 selector 阶段得到的估计结果，减少重复访存、索引搬运和 reduction bubble。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了 kernel-level 最高 11.6× 加速，并在 256K context 下仍能运行；端到端吞吐最高提升 2.37×。实验覆盖短上下文和长上下文任务，包括 RULER 和 LongBench，用来验证高比例稀疏不会明显破坏模型能力。关键实验点不是单个 benchmark 的小幅分数变化，而是三组取舍：低比特 content-aware scan 相比 metadata-based selector 是否减少带宽压力；top-δ 相比 top-k 是否能适应不同 entropy 的 attention 分布；fused selector-computer kernel 相比解耦实现是否把理论稀疏转化为实际吞吐。消融重点应关注 sparsity、accuracy、kernel time、end-to-end throughput 随上下文长度变化的曲线，尤其是长到 128K/256K 后的带宽主导区间。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Method 中三部分：K cache 的低比特量化扫描设计、top-δ 的数值精度推导、fused kernel 的执行路径。Figure 2 和 Algorithm 1 应该是理解整体数据流的入口；性能图表要重点看 kernel-level 和 end-to-end 的差异，因为很多 sparse attention 方法只在算子内快，放到完整 decoding pipeline 后收益会下降。消融部分建议重点看 top-k、top-p、top-δ 的对比，以及不同上下文长度下的 sparsity-accuracy 曲线。值得深挖的问题是：top-δ 的阈值是否对模型、层、head、任务稳定；K thumbnail 的量化误差是否会系统性误删重要远程 token；该方法和 KV cache quantization、paged attention、speculative decoding 同时使用时是否会有冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the bandwidth bottleneck of long-context autoregressive decoding. The issue is not the compute-heavy prefill phase, but the decode phase where each generated token reloads a large KV cache from HBM. Existing training-free sparse attention methods usually separate selection from computation: a selector first builds or reads metadata to choose tokens or blocks, and a compute kernel then gathers the selected KV entries. This creates extra memory traffic, indexing overhead, and synchronization cost. Adaptive strategies such as top-p are more distribution-aware than top-k, but their global normalization makes them expensive in the decode path.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an execution-aware formulation of sparse long-context decoding. The paper is useful for foundation-model work because it shows that long-context capability is constrained not only by pretraining length or benchmark accuracy, but also by the memory-access pattern of KV cache during serving. It also clarifies a practical requirement for training-free sparsity: the selector must be fused with the attention computation, otherwise metadata reads, index movement, and global reductions can erase much of the theoretical gain.
summary_en.technical_approach: FFD combines content-aware scanning, a top-δ selection rule, and a fused selector-compute kernel. Instead of storing separate metadata such as centroids, partial-dimensional keys, or geometric bounds, it scans a compressed representation of the K cache itself. The K cache is decomposed into low-bit quantized thumbnails, used for fast query-key similarity estimation, plus a residual path for fidelity. The selection rule, top-δ, filters blocks according to their estimated contribution to the attention score sum. This differs from top-k, which imposes a fixed budget regardless of the attention entropy, and from top-p, which requires global probability accumulation. The paper argues that blocks whose contribution is below a numerically motivated threshold have negligible effect on the final attention output, and that the criterion can be approximately parallelized because LLM attention is often highly concentrated. At the systems level, FFD fuses scanning, selection, and attention computation into one kernel so that the compute phase reuses the selector’s intermediate estimates and avoids redundant HBM traffic and reduction bubbles.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results include up to 11.6× kernel-level speedup, scaling to 256K context, and up to 2.37× end-to-end throughput improvement. The evaluation covers both short- and long-context benchmarks, including RULER and LongBench, and reports that model quality is largely preserved under high sparsity. The important experimental evidence is the tradeoff among sparsity, accuracy, kernel time, and full decoding throughput. The ablations to inspect are the comparisons between top-k, top-p, and top-δ; the effect of low-bit content-aware scanning versus metadata-based selection; and the gap between isolated kernel gains and end-to-end generation speed, especially at 128K to 256K context where HBM bandwidth dominates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the method sections on low-bit K-cache scanning, the numerical motivation for top-δ, and the fused kernel design carefully. Figure 2 and Algorithm 1 are the fastest way to understand the dataflow. The most useful plots are likely the sparsity-accuracy curves and the kernel versus end-to-end speed comparisons across context lengths. It is worth checking whether the top-δ threshold is stable across models, layers, heads, and tasks; whether quantized K thumbnails ever drop rare but important remote evidence; and how this design interacts with KV-cache quantization, paged attention, and speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 稀疏注意力常死在“选块元数据+同步”上，这篇把 selector/compute 融成 kernel 才像真解法；重点看 top-delta 与带宽测量。
recommendation.en: Sparse attention often loses to metadata and synchronization overhead; fusing selector+compute into one kernel is the right direction—focus on top-delta and bandwidth accounting.

paper.title: RouteSparse: Input-Conditional Pattern Routing for Budgeted Long-Context Prefilling
paper.abstract: Dynamic sparse attention can reduce the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling without changing model weights. MInference assigns each attention head one pattern offline and estimates that pattern's sparse indices for every prompt. This design is efficient, but it assumes that a head's preferred pattern and sparsity budget remain suitable across inputs. We introduce RouteSparse, which routes each head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A low-cost probe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文 prefilling 的核心瓶颈：现有动态稀疏注意力通常给每个 head 固定一个离线模式，无法适应不同输入的注意力形态与预算需求。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率与长上下文架构优化。它不是新的预训练方法，但对长上下文 serving、prefill latency 和稀疏注意力可控退化很有参考价值，尤其适合研究 inference-time compute allocation 的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 RouteSparse：为每个 attention head 和 prompt segment 在一个 GPU-friendly sparse pattern 库中做输入条件路由。先用低成本 probe 估计各模式效用与不确定性，再由 latency-aware router 选择模式和 sparsity budget；高不确定样本回退到更密集掩码。论文还把路由写成 constrained risk minimization，并从被省略概率质量推导 attention-output error certificate，用来约束精度损失。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的主结果是在 Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct、128K prompt 上达到 6.5× dense prefill speed。评测覆盖 long-context retrieval、QA、summarization 和 language modeling。对比对象显然包括 dense attention 与 MInference 一类固定模式方法，但摘要未给出完整精度损失数字；从设定看，关键是看不同任务下 router 是否稳定优于单模式稀疏。
summary.authors_note: 来自重庆大学。摘要未显示业界头部实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a key bottleneck in long-context prefilling: existing dynamic sparse attention methods often assign one offline pattern per head, which cannot adapt to input-dependent attention structure or budget needs.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for long-context serving rather than a new pretraining method. It is still useful for researchers thinking about inference-time compute allocation and controllable degradation under sparse attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: RouteSparse routes each attention head and prompt segment over a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A cheap probe estimates pattern utility and uncertainty, then a latency-aware router selects both the pattern and sparsity budget; uncertain cases fall back to denser masks. The paper also formulates routing as constrained risk minimization and derives an attention-output error certificate from omitted probability mass.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is 6.5× dense-prefill speed on Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct with 128K-token prompts. Evaluation covers long-context retrieval, QA, summarization, and language modeling. The likely baselines are dense attention and fixed-pattern methods such as MInference, though the abstract does not provide the full accuracy-retention numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: From Chongqing University. No major frontier-lab affiliation is evident from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 这是比较干净的长上下文 prefill 工程问题：别看 headline speedup，重点看它的 uncertainty fallback 和 error certificate，能不能把稀疏退化做成可控信号。
recommendation.en: This is a fairly clean long-context prefill paper: ignore the headline speedup and focus on the uncertainty fallback plus the error certificate—those are the parts that might make sparse degradation actually controllable.

institutions: Affiliation:College of Computer Science, Chongqing University

paper.title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
paper.abstract: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows set

summary.core_problem: 双向注意力机制计算复杂度随序列长度呈平方级增长，现有的稀疏注意力方法要么依赖输入结构（如文本顺序、图像空间邻近性），要么使用缓慢的聚类过程，难以在推理阶段实现免训练且高效的加速。
summary.importance: 提出了一种免训练的块稀疏注意力加速方法 ClusterAttention，通过快速递归聚类和条带均值补偿机制，在保持高精度的同时，实现了与密集注意力相当的单次查询-键交互延迟，为长序列任务（如高分辨率图像、视频生成、基因组数据）提供了实用的加速方案。
summary.technical_approach: ClusterAttention 采用快速递归聚类方法，根据每个注意力头中键和查询的几何分布生成固定大小（2的幂次方）的簇。为了降低稀疏注意力带来的误差，作者推导了误差表达式，发现未选中簇的键值协方差和 Jensen 不等式效应是主要误差来源。为此，引入了“条带均值补偿”（SMC）机制，通过未选中簇的键和值质心与查询交互，有效补偿了丢失的注意力质量，从而在不显著增加计算量的情况下提升了近似精度。
summary.experiments: 在 DINOv2（视觉 Transformer）和 TabPFN-3（表格数据 Transformer）上的实验表明，ClusterAttention 结合 SMC 机制，在保持较高精度的同时，显著降低了计算延迟。与基于注意力的精确路由相比，随机聚类结合质心选择在某些情况下表现更好，验证了误差分析中关于协方差项的结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 2 节的误差分析（特别是公式 4 和 5），理解 SMC 机制的理论基础；第 3 节的快速递归聚类算法；以及第 4 节的实验结果，观察不同聚类方法和补偿机制对精度和延迟的影响。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The computational complexity of bidirectional attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on input structure (e.g., text order, image spatial proximity) or use slow clustering processes, making it difficult to achieve training-free and efficient speedup during inference.
summary_en.importance: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a training-free block-sparse attention speedup method. By employing fast recursive clustering and a striped mean-compensation mechanism, it achieves latency per query-key interaction comparable to dense attention while maintaining high accuracy, providing a practical acceleration solution for long-sequence tasks (e.g., high-resolution images, video generation, genomic data).
summary_en.technical_approach: ClusterAttention uses a fast recursive clustering method to generate fixed-size clusters (powers of two) based on the geometric distribution of keys and queries in each attention head. To mitigate the error introduced by sparse attention, the authors derive an error expression, identifying the key-value covariance of unselected clusters and the Jensen inequality effect as the main sources of error. To address this, they introduce a 'striped mean-compensation' (SMC) mechanism, which compensates for the lost attention mass by interacting the key and value centroids of unselected clusters with the query, thereby improving approximation accuracy without significantly increasing computation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on DINOv2 (Vision Transformer) and TabPFN-3 (Tabular Data Transformer) demonstrate that ClusterAttention combined with SMC significantly reduces computational latency while maintaining high accuracy. Compared to attention-based exact routing, random clustering combined with centroid selection performs better in some cases, validating the conclusions regarding the covariance term in the error analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the error analysis (especially Equations 4 and 5) to understand the theoretical basis of the SMC mechanism; Section 3 for the fast recursive clustering algorithm; and Section 4 for experimental results, observing the impact of different clustering methods and compensation mechanisms on accuracy and latency. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 提出一种无需训练的注意力加速方法，其对稀疏注意力误差的理论分析（紧密聚类可能导致更大误差）值得关注，可作为长上下文或高效推理的参考。
recommendation.en: Proposes a training-free attention speedup method. Its theoretical analysis of sparse attention error (tight clusters may lead to larger errors) is noteworthy and can serve as a reference for long-context or efficient inference.

paper.title: BF1: A Causal Dyadic Sparse-Attention Retrofit for Efficient Long-Context Transformers
paper.abstract: Dense causal attention remains expensive at long context even when implemented with highly optimized exact kernels. We study BF1, a deterministic block-aligned dyadic sparse-attention route that combines a small exact local neighborhood, a global first block, and logarithmically spaced historical blocks. The route is related to prior log-sparse and dilated attention patterns; our contribution is a correctness-gated pretrained-model retrofit, a matched topology-control study, and a systems charac

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文 Transformer 的一个很具体但很实际的问题：即便有 FlashAttention 这类高效 exact kernel，因果 dense attention 的交互数仍然随序列长度二次增长，到了 4K、8K、32K 这类长度，推理延迟和训练成本都很难看。很多稀疏注意力论文提出过各种模式，但真正难的是三件事同时成立：一，能 retrofit 到已有预训练模型，而不是从头设计新架构；二，训练后语言建模损失不要明显坏掉；三，系统层面真的能在 wall-clock latency 上赢过优化过的 dense attention。BF1 的问题设定就是把这三件事绑在一起验证。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在长上下文架构与系统接口，而不是新的建模能力。论文没有声称 dyadic/log-sparse 路由本身新颖，价值在于把一个固定、可复现、数据无关的稀疏模式做成了可 retrofit 的工程方案，并且把“理论上 pair 数少”与“整模型 TTFT 是否真的下降”分开测清楚。这个区分很重要，因为很多稀疏注意力工作只报告算子级复杂度或 kernel microbenchmark，却没有解释为什么整模型收益有限。BF1 给出的结论是：单层 attention 算子可以很快，但低 batch 下 decode/planning 生命周期成本仍是主要瓶颈。对做长上下文预训练的人，这比单纯的 O(n log n) 公式更有用。
summary.technical_approach:
BF1 是一个确定性的 block-aligned causal sparse route。序列先按 block width b 切块，论文公开配置里 b=64。对第 j 个 query block，可见的 key/value block 包括四部分：当前 block 的因果三角、自身前面两个局部 block、全局第一个 block、以及按 dyadic 距离回看的历史 block，也就是 j-2^r 这类前驱块，从 4 blocks 的偏移开始。形式上这是 local + global-first + dyadic history 的组合。

作者明确承认这和早期的 LogSparse、LongNet 一脉相承，创新点不在路由图本身，而在 pretrained-model retrofit、matched-control 训练比较、以及 Blackwell GPU 上的 correctness-gated 系统测量。所谓 correctness-gated，意思是他们不只跑快路径 benchmark，而是逐项验证 partial blocks、backward gradients、dense-path equivalence、future-token isolation、顺序反转 benchmark 等，确保稀疏实现没有偷偷破坏因果性或数值正确性。

复杂度上，固定 block width 时，每个转换层的 selected interactions 是 O(n log n)，图通信深度是 O(log n)。这里的“通信深度”可以理解为信息从远处 token 传到当前位置需要跨多少层稀疏边，dyadic predecessor 让这个深度从线性降到对数级。和纯 local sliding window 相比，这是 BF1 的结构优势；和随机非局部图相比，它是确定性的、可复现的，也更容易做 kernel 优化。

论文还做了一个很重要的设计选择：不是把所有层都改成 BF1，而是做 selected eight-layer retrofit，并把这个真实改造的 whole-model TTFT 与“全层都换掉”的 timing-only ceiling 分开报告。这个做法比较诚实，也更接近生产系统，因为很多时候不是每一层都适合稀疏化，尤其在已有预训练模型上直接替换全部注意力层风险很高。
summary.experiments:
系统结果是全文最硬的部分。作者在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 上报告，优化后的 BF16 实现从 4K 上下文开始超过 dense attention；在 32K 时，单层 attention 达到 10.91× speedup。更重要的是，真实的八层 retrofit 在 warm 32K whole-model TTFT 上带来 15.3% 的下降。这个数字没有单层 10× 那么夸张，但更可信，因为它把 attention 之外的层、调度、kernel launch、planning 等开销都算进去了。

训练结果方面，论文做了三种 matched Stage A 对照：Dense continued training、equal-pair-count local sliding、equal-pair-count static-random nonlocal graph。BF1 在三次训练 seed 下都排第一。这里最关键的不是“第一”这个标签，而是控制做得比较细：local sliding 和 random graph 都匹配了 pair budget，因此 BF1 的优势更可能来自拓扑结构，而不是单纯看得更多。换句话说，作者试图回答的是“在相同稀疏预算下，dyadic + first-block 这种图是否比局部或随机图更适合 next-token LM”。

论文还单独讨论了 selected-page decode semantics，并指出在低 batch 场景下，主瓶颈不是 selected-page attention arithmetic，而是 planning lifecycle。这个观察很重要，因为它解释了为什么很多稀疏 decode 方案在 paper benchmark 上很快，落到真实 serving 却收益有限：算子省下来的时间被 page selection、mask planning、runtime orchestration 吃掉了。

从当前给出的正文片段看，底座是 Qwen3-0.6B 几何配置。若全文有 perplexity 或 downstream LM 指标，阅读时要重点看 BF1 retrofit 后相对 dense-continued-training 的差距是否稳定很小，以及这种差距是否随上下文长度扩大。如果长上下文收益建立在明显牺牲短上下文 LM 质量之上，那方法的适用面会窄很多。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“算子定义—系统测量—训练对照”三步走。先看 3.1 和 3.2，弄清楚 BF1 的 block 图到底连了哪些边，以及为什么 selected interactions 是 O(n log n)、通信深度是 O(log n)。然后直接看系统实验，特别是 dense crossover 点、32K 单层 speedup、八层 retrofit 的 whole-model TTFT。最后看 matched-control 训练实验，确认作者是否真的把 pair budget、训练步数、拓扑差异分开控制了。

如果只花 25 分钟，优先看 Figure 1、复杂度命题、Blackwell correctness-gated benchmark 表、以及 Stage A 训练对照结果。更值得深挖的点有三个：一是为什么选择 first block 作为全局锚点，而不是 learned global tokens；二是八层 retrofit 选的是哪些层，是否说明中高层比低层更适合稀疏化；三是 decode planning cost 的分解，这部分对 serving 系统设计比路由图本身更有现实意义。

summary_en.core_problem: BF1 addresses a practical long-context question rather than a new modeling paradigm: even with highly optimized exact kernels such as FlashAttention, causal dense attention still scales quadratically with sequence length, so long-context training and inference remain expensive. Many sparse patterns have been proposed before, but the hard part is making three things hold at once: the pattern must retrofit into a pretrained model, preserve language-modeling behavior after adaptation, and deliver real wall-clock gains over optimized dense attention. BF1 is framed exactly around that engineering gap.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly architectural and systems-facing. The paper does not claim novelty for dyadic or log-sparse routing by itself. The contribution is a reproducible sparse route, a pretrained-model retrofit study under matched controls, and a careful separation between operator-level savings and whole-model latency. That separation matters. Many sparse-attention papers stop at asymptotic complexity or kernel microbenchmarks. BF1 explicitly shows that faster sparse attention arithmetic does not automatically translate into large end-to-end gains, especially at low batch where planning and runtime lifecycle costs dominate. For long-context pretraining and serving, that is a useful and realistic result.
summary_en.technical_approach:
BF1 is a deterministic, block-aligned causal sparse-attention pattern. The sequence is partitioned into blocks of width b, with the reported public configuration using b = 64. For a query block j, the route includes four components: the causal self block, two exact local predecessor blocks, the first global block, and historical predecessor blocks at dyadic distances, i.e. j - 2^r starting from an offset of four blocks. In short, it is local + global-first + dyadic history.

The paper is explicit that this route is related to earlier log-sparse and dilated designs such as LogSparse Transformer and LongNet. The claimed novelty lies elsewhere: pretrained-model retrofit, matched topology-control experiments, and correctness-gated Blackwell measurements. The correctness-gated part is important. The authors do not only benchmark a fast path; they verify partial blocks, backward gradients, dense-path equivalence, future-token isolation, and opposite-order benchmarks up to 32K, which makes the systems claims more credible.

With fixed block width, each converted layer uses O(n log n) selected token interactions and has O(log n) graph communication depth. The communication-depth argument is the structural reason BF1 should beat pure local sliding windows: long-range information can propagate in logarithmically many sparse hops rather than linearly many local layers. Compared with static random nonlocal graphs, BF1 is deterministic and easier to optimize at the kernel level.

Another sensible design choice is that the paper does not replace all attention layers in the model and call it done. It reports an actual eight-layer retrofit separately from an all-layer timing-only ceiling. That makes the results more realistic for pretrained models, where replacing every layer with a sparse operator can be risky.
summary_en.experiments:
The strongest evidence is on the systems side. On an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, the optimized BF16 implementation reportedly crosses dense attention around 4K context length. At 32K, the per-layer attention operator reaches 10.91× speedup. More importantly, the actual eight-layer retrofit reduces warm whole-model TTFT by 15.3% at 32K. That number is much smaller than the per-layer speedup, but it is also much more informative because it includes the rest of the model and runtime overheads.

For language modeling, the paper runs three matched Stage A training comparisons: dense continued training, equal-pair-count local sliding, and equal-pair-count static-random nonlocal graphs. BF1 ranks first in all three matched runs. The key point is not the ranking alone. The controls are designed to keep the sparse budget comparable, so the advantage is more plausibly due to topology rather than simply attending to more pairs. In other words, the paper tries to answer whether a dyadic-plus-first-block graph is a better sparse inductive bias for next-token LM than local-only or random sparse graphs under similar budget.

The decode analysis is also useful. The paper reports selected-page decode semantics and argues that, at low batch, the dominant unresolved cost is planning lifecycle rather than selected-page attention arithmetic. That observation explains why sparse decode methods often look strong in operator benchmarks but deliver limited gains in real serving stacks.

From the provided text, the tested geometry is based on Qwen3-0.6B. When reading the full paper, the most important thing to check is how much LM quality is lost relative to dense continued training, and whether that gap stays small across context lengths. If long-context efficiency comes with a noticeable short-context LM penalty, the deployment envelope becomes narrower.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is: operator definition, systems measurements, then matched training controls. Start with the route definition and complexity proposition to understand exactly which blocks are connected and why the selected interactions are O(n log n) with O(log n) communication depth. Then jump to the systems section and focus on the dense crossover point, the 32K per-layer speedup, and the whole-model TTFT for the eight-layer retrofit. Finally, read the matched Stage A training results to see whether topology, sparse budget, and training adaptation are properly disentangled.

If you only have about 25 minutes, prioritize Figure 1, the complexity statement, the correctness-gated Blackwell benchmark tables, and the matched-control training results. Three details are worth deeper inspection: why the first block is used as the global anchor instead of learned global tokens, which eight layers were retrofitted and why, and how the planning-lifecycle overhead is broken down during decode. That last point may be more operationally important than the sparse route itself.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统测量和 retrofit gate；单层 10.9× 到整模 15% 的落差，比稀疏模式本身更值得记。
recommendation.en: Read the systems measurements and retrofit gate; the drop from 10.9× layer speedup to 15% model gain is the real lesson.

paper.title: Learning how to Forget: Fine-tuning for Long-Context Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: A lot of prior work addressed key-value (KV) cache selection and compression by sparse attention to enable long-context inference for transformer language models without excessive hardware budgets. We provide a new method for fine-tuning models with sparse attention. It works for any KV cache policy, runs on a moderate hardware budget (e.g., a single Nvidia A100 GPU with 40 GB RAM), and allows the model to co-adapt with the policy, often outperforming models trained with exact attention (sequenc

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 选择和稀疏注意力策略与模型参数不匹配的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是高效推理与训练系统方法。关键点不是再提出一个 KV 压缩规则，而是让模型在 fine-tuning 阶段适应给定的 sparse attention policy，从而减少训练-推理不一致。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出一种适用于任意 KV cache policy 的 sparse-attention fine-tuning 方法，让模型与缓存选择策略共同适配。实现侧提供 H2O sparse attention 的高效版本，并加入 dedicated scaled dot product attention kernel 支持。作者还开源 KeysAndValues 库，覆盖长上下文推理和 fine-tuning 的相关方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法可在中等硬件预算下运行，例如单张 40GB Nvidia A100。实验中 H2O 是领先 policy；经过 sparse-attention fine-tuning 的模型经常超过使用 exact attention 训练、依赖 sequence parallelism 的模型。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和绝对指标。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Amazon Web Services、Amazon、University of Amsterdam 和 Technical University Berlin。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between long-context KV-cache selection policies and models trained under dense attention.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is in efficient long-context inference and fine-tuning. The useful idea is not another cache heuristic, but adapting the model to the sparse-attention policy used at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method fine-tunes language models under a chosen sparse-attention KV policy so the model can co-adapt with that policy. It is policy-agnostic, includes an efficient H2O sparse-attention implementation with dedicated scaled dot-product attention kernel support, and is released in the KeysAndValues library.
summary_en.experiments: The approach is reported to run on moderate hardware, such as a single 40GB Nvidia A100. H2O is the strongest policy in their experiments, and sparse-attention fine-tuned models often outperform models trained with exact attention using sequence parallelism. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Amazon Web Services, Amazon, University of Amsterdam, and Technical University Berlin.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 kernel 部分即可；它提醒长上下文稀疏策略不能只在推理端硬切，训练适配可能更关键。
recommendation.en: Read the method and kernel sections; the useful prior shift is that sparse long-context policies should be trained into the model, not only patched at inference.

paper.title: Partition the Support, Reconstruct the Residual: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation and World Models
paper.abstract: Training-free block-sparse attention can accelerate video transformers, but row-wise attention concentration does not by itself specify an executable sparse operator. Queries sharing a block route may have poorly overlapping supports, while retained attention mass alone does not determine the post-softmax error from skipped interactions. We show that partition geometry affects both pooled support and the predictability of the remaining residual from the sparse output. We introduce SparsePR, whic

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成模型中免训练块稀疏注意力机制的精度损失问题，特别是由于查询支持集重叠度低和残差不可预测导致的误差。
summary.importance: 提出了一种改进的免训练稀疏注意力机制，通过几何划分和残差重建降低了注意力近似误差，对长上下文或视频模型的推理加速有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SparsePR，结合了响应耦合划分（Response-Coupled Partitioning）和探针拟合残差重建（Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction）。通过对 K/V 响应进行聚类来指导查询路由，并使用少量精确计算的查询行来校准稀疏输出的仿射校正。
summary.experiments: 在四个异构的视频生成和世界模型上进行了测试，一致降低了注意力重建误差。
summary.authors_note: 德州农工大学的研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the accuracy loss in training-free block-sparse attention for video generation models, specifically the errors caused by poorly overlapping query supports and unpredictable residuals.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an improved training-free sparse attention mechanism that reduces approximation error through geometric partitioning and residual reconstruction, offering reference value for inference acceleration in long-context or video models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces SparsePR, combining Response-Coupled Partitioning with Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction. It clusters K/V responses to guide query routing and uses a small set of exactly computed query rows to calibrate an affine correction for the sparse output.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across four heterogeneous video generation and world models, consistently reducing attention-reconstruction error.

recommendation.zh: 针对视频模型的免训练稀疏注意力优化，通过残差重建降低误差，对 LLM 长上下文推理加速有微弱启发，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Training-free sparse attention optimization for video models, reducing error via residual reconstruction. Offers minor inspiration for LLM long-context inference acceleration; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: LoSA: Near-Lossless Sparse Attention for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration
paper.abstract: Video diffusion transformers are costly to sample: every denoising step applies self-attention over a long 3D token sequence, a quadratic cost that dominates as resolution and duration grow. Sparse attention reduces this cost without retraining, but existing methods pursue aggressive sparsity, where further speedup costs disproportionately more attention fidelity. We target the opposite end of this trade-off: fix near-lossless fidelity by construction, and remove as much computation as this cons

summary.core_problem: 在不训练、不明显损伤视频质量的前提下，降低视频 diffusion transformer 采样阶段长 3D token 自注意力的二次计算开销。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成推理加速中的注意力稀疏化方法。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对长序列注意力稀疏性、跨 denoising step 的注意力模式稳定性有一定旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: LoSA 不固定稀疏率，而固定 99% retained attention mass。方法先在一个早期 dense denoising step 精确测量 block-level attention mass，再为每个 head 和 query block 保留达到质量阈值所需的最小 key/value block 集合，并在后续步骤复用该高质量支持集。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告两个关键观察：约 40% 的 block interaction 可被移除，同时保留 99% attention mass；高质量 attention support 在 denoising steps 间保持稳定。具体模型、数据集、速度提升和画质指标需读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the quadratic self-attention cost of video diffusion transformers during sampling without retraining and without visible quality loss.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time sparse-attention method for video generation. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the measured stability of attention support across denoising steps is a useful signal for long-sequence attention efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoSA fixes a retained-attention-mass threshold rather than a target sparsity ratio. It measures exact block-level attention mass at an early dense denoising step, keeps the smallest key/value block set that reaches 99% mass for each head and query block, and reuses this support in later steps.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that around 40% of block interactions can be removed while retaining 99% of attention mass, and that high-mass support is stable across denoising steps. Model scale, datasets, speedups, and quality metrics require checking the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attention support 稳定性的实验；方法偏视频采样工程，不会直接改预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read only the attention-support stability evidence; the method is mostly video-sampling engineering, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Autonomy-of-Heads: Data-Free Sparse Attention from Frozen Query-Key Geometry
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by quadratic attention computation and growing KV-cache costs. Existing sparse attention and KV-compression methods typically decide which tokens or heads to preserve from runtime attention scores, observation windows, calibration prompts, or learned gates, making head diagnosis input-dependent and costly to deploy. We propose Autonomy-of-Heads (AoH), a data-free method that identifies retrieval and streaming heads from the spectral geometry of query-ke

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文推理中的 attention head 选择问题：现有稀疏注意力或 KV 压缩方法通常依赖运行时 attention score、校准 prompt、观察窗口或学习 gate，部署成本高，也难以在 prefill 一开始就确定哪些 head 需要全局上下文。论文提出只从冻结权重的 query-key 几何判断 head 的功能。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献偏推理效率，但它对理解长上下文模型的 head specialization 有启发。论文把 attention head 的 retrieval/streaming 分工和权重空间里的谱结构联系起来，而不是只看输入相关的 attention map。这个视角可用于分析长上下文能力如何在预训练中形成，也可能反过来指导 head-level regularization、长上下文继续训练和稀疏 attention 架构设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Autonomy-of-Heads。对每个 attention head，定义 kernel attention operator：M_h = W_K^{h⊤} W_Q^h。该矩阵刻画 query 与 key 在该 head 中的匹配方向。论文用 M_h 的 effective rank 作为 head 功能指标：低 effective-rank 表示谱集中，少数主方向主导匹配，更像 retrieval head，需要保留全局 KV；高 effective-rank 表示匹配方向分散，更接近 streaming head，可以只保留 sink tokens 和 recent window。为了部署，作者不显式构造 d_model × d_model 的 M_h，而是利用 d_head × d_head 的 proxy 计算非零奇异值。最终策略很简单：低 ER head 用 full attention，高 ER head 用 sink-plus-recent attention。整个过程不需要训练数据、校准样本或额外 gate。
summary.experiments: 论文先给出两个观察。第一，在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，不同 head 的平均 attention distance 在 4K 到 100K context 下结构稳定，且 effective rank 与长距离 attention 行为呈负相关：低 ER head 更倾向远距离检索，高 ER head 更局部。第二，在 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的 32K passkey retrieval 测试中，把高 ER head 逐步改成 streaming attention 对准确率影响较小；先改低 ER head 会使检索准确率快速下降，说明低 ER head 对远程信息访问更关键。LongBench 实验覆盖三个长上下文 LLM。在 50% sparsity 下，AoH 接近 full attention，并稳定优于 random 和 reversed head selection。效率实验显示，在长上下文下它能降低 prefill/decode latency 和 KV-cache memory；文中 streaming head 使用 128 个 sink tokens 加 256 个 recent tokens，因此在 32K、64K、128K 这类长度下 KV budget 近似等于 full-attention head 的比例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。重点看 Observations 部分的两组证据：effective rank 与 average attention distance 的关系，以及 passkey retrieval 中 low-ER-first/high-ER-first 的对照。方法部分关注 M_h = W_K^{⊤}W_Q 的定义、effective rank 的计算，以及 d_head 级别谱计算为什么等价于关注非零奇异值。实验部分看 LongBench 50% sparsity 的主表和 latency/KV memory 曲线即可。需要留意的限制是：AoH 的 head 标签是输入无关的，因此适合稳定 head 分工明显的模型；如果某些模型大量依赖动态 routing 或 layer-wise adaptive behavior，固定分类可能不够细。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context attention heads can be classified without prompts, runtime attention statistics, calibration data, or learned gates. The target problem is sparse long-context inference: deciding which heads must keep global KV access and which heads can be restricted to sink-plus-recent attention from the start of prefill.
summary_en.importance: The work is primarily an inference-efficiency paper, but it is also useful for pretraining analysis. It links retrieval versus streaming behavior to spectral structure in frozen query-key weights, rather than to input-specific attention maps. This gives a weight-space diagnostic for head specialization in long-context LLMs. Such diagnostics can inform how long-range retrieval capabilities emerge during pretraining or continued long-context training, and may be useful when designing head-level sparsity or regularization schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Autonomy-of-Heads defines a head-specific kernel attention operator M_h = W_K^{h⊤} W_Q^h. This operator captures the query-key matching directions available to a head. The classifier uses the effective rank of M_h. A low effective rank means the spectrum is concentrated in a few dominant matching directions; these heads are treated as retrieval heads and keep full-context attention. A high effective rank means the spectrum is more diffuse; these heads are treated as streaming heads and keep only a small sink cache plus a recent window. For efficiency, the nonzero singular values are computed through a d_head by d_head proxy rather than by materializing the full d_model by d_model matrix. The resulting sparse policy is training-free, data-free, compatible with GQA-style settings, and simple enough to be applied before any prompt is processed.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first reports two supporting observations. On Qwen2.5-7B, per-head average attention distance remains structurally stable from 4K to 100K context lengths, and lower-effective-rank heads tend to attend farther back in the context. On Llama3.1-8B-Instruct at 32K context length, a passkey retrieval study shows a clear separation: converting high-ER heads to streaming attention has limited impact, while converting low-ER heads first causes retrieval accuracy to collapse quickly. The main LongBench evaluation spans three long-context LLMs. At 50% sparsity, AoH remains close to full attention and outperforms random and reversed head-selection baselines. The efficiency results show reductions in prefill and decode latency as well as KV-cache memory at long sequence lengths. Streaming heads use a small 128-token sink cache and a 256-token recent window, so at 32K and beyond the KV budget is dominated by the fraction of heads kept in full attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 20 minutes. Start with the observation figures connecting effective rank to average attention distance and passkey retrieval degradation. Then read the method section for the definition of M_h, the effective-rank criterion, and the d_head-dimensional spectral computation. For results, focus on the 50% sparsity LongBench tables and the latency/KV-cache plots. The main limitation to keep in mind is that AoH assigns fixed, input-independent head roles. This is attractive for deployment, but may be less precise for models whose attention functions are highly prompt-dependent or shaped by dynamic routing mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 只看谱几何定义和 head 分类实验；若稳定成立，应加入内部长上下文压缩诊断工具链。
recommendation.en: Read the spectral-geometry definition and head-classification results; if it holds up, it belongs in an internal long-context compression diagnostic stack.

paper.title: Training-Free Hashing-Based Attention via Binary Principal Components
paper.abstract: Long-context large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet self-attention remains a major efficiency bottleneck -- especially during decoding -- due to the necessity of repeatedly processing ever-growing key-value (KV) caches. Existing sparse attention reduce computation by attending to fewer KV pairs, but often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation, require additional training, or rely on expensive hashing. In this work, we present BinaryPC, a tra

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码阶段自注意力随KV缓存增长成为计算瓶颈，现有稀疏注意力方案要么精度损失大、要么需要额外训练、要么哈希计算开销高
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练-free、数据感知的哈希稀疏注意力方案BinaryPC，在不修改模型参数、不增加训练成本的前提下降低长上下文解码的注意力计算量
summary.technical_approach: 通过计算KV数据的二值主成分构造紧凑二进制哈希码与对应哈希函数，相比于数据无关的LSH和需要训练的非线性哈希，可显式保留数据结构信息，无需梯度训练，基于哈希桶做稀疏注意力计算
summary.experiments: 在多个长上下文任务上测试，BinaryPC在不同上下文长度下均优于LSH等无训练稀疏注意力基线，精度接近全注意力，同时显著降低解码阶段的KV计算量

summary_en.core_problem: Self-attention during long-context LLM decoding becomes a compute bottleneck as KV cache grows; existing sparse attention methods either suffer large accuracy drops, require additional training, or incur high hashing overhead.
summary_en.importance: A method contribution proposing BinaryPC, a training-free, data-aware hashing-based sparse attention that reduces long-context decoding compute without modifying model parameters or adding training costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs compact binary hash codes and hash functions by computing binary principal components of KV data. Unlike data-independent LSH or trained non-linear hashing, it explicitly preserves data structure without gradient-based training, then performs sparse attention within hash buckets.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple long-context tasks, BinaryPC outperforms training-free sparse attention baselines including LSH across context lengths, achieves accuracy close to full attention while significantly reducing KV compute during decoding.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free的长上下文稀疏注意力方案，无需改模型即可降低解码算力，知道结论即可，无需深读
recommendation.en: A training-free sparse attention approach for long-context decoding that cuts compute without model modifications; know the result, no need to read in depth.

paper.title: SPADE: An Input-Adaptive Sparse Attention Engine for Fast Video Diffusion Models Inference
paper.abstract: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality but pay quadratic self-attention cost, making inference prohibitive at video-token scales. The challenge is input-adaptive sparsity: selecting critical Q/K/V tokens with negligible overhead and executing them for end-to-end gains. We present SPADE, a training-free sparse-attention engine of three parts: (i) vDiT-SSR, a specification defining 3D blocking candidates and formalizing dynamic masks via Summarizer/Estimator expressions; (ii) r

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 diffusion transformer 在高视频 token 数下自注意力二次复杂度导致推理过慢的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与稀疏注意力工程。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对长序列、多模态生成模型的 attention sparsity 和 kernel 落地有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPADE，一个免训练的输入自适应稀疏注意力引擎。方法包括 vDiT-SSR 稀疏规则描述、基于 SICS 和 head-wise policy 的运行时方案生成，以及低开销索引搜索、flash block-sparse attention、kernel grouping 组成的执行器。
summary.experiments: 在 Hunyuan-Video 与 Wan 2.1/2.2 上评估文本到视频和图像到视频生成。报告 attention 加速 2.26x-3.40x，端到端推理加速 1.49x-1.80x，同时声称保持生成质量；摘要未给出具体质量指标或显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the quadratic self-attention bottleneck in video diffusion transformers at large video-token scales.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-system and sparse-attention contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to long-sequence multimodal generation and practical sparse attention execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPADE is a training-free input-adaptive sparse attention engine. It defines vDiT-SSR for 3D blocking and dynamic mask expressions, generates runtime schemes with SICS and head-wise policies, and executes them through low-overhead index search, flash block-sparse attention, and kernel grouping.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on Hunyuan-Video and Wan 2.1/2.2 for text-to-video and image-to-video generation. The method accelerates attention by 2.26x-3.40x and end-to-end inference by 1.49x-1.80x while claiming preserved quality; the abstract does not expose detailed quality metrics.

recommendation.zh: 知道 vDiT 动态稀疏能拿到端到端收益即可；不做视频生成 serving 的话，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing that adaptive sparsity can yield real end-to-end vDiT speedups; skip the details unless you work on video-generation serving.

paper.title: LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
paper.abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-

summary.core_problem: DeepSeek Sparse Attention 通过 Lightning Indexer 做细粒度 token 选择，在长上下文上接近全注意力质量，但部署时存在两个系统瓶颈：indexer 对所有 prefix token 打分仍有 O(L^2) 开销，在 1024K 上下文时可占单层延迟的 90%；其选出的离散索引导致稀疏注意力算子进行非连续 HBM 访问，实测只能达到约 4.5% 的峰值 HBM 带宽。LongCat Sparse Attention 要同时解决索引计算开销和硬件访问效率问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇对长上下文预训练和推理都有直接价值的工作。DSA 已被 DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-5 等大规模模型采用，但其 indexer 成本会在超长上下文下重新成为主要瓶颈。LSA 给出的跨层索引、流式连续布局和层次化索引，既降低训练成本，也降低推理延迟，并在 Meituan LongCat 的 69B、560B 以及 1.6T 模型上验证，说明它不是单一 kernel 技巧，而是可进入大模型训练 recipe 的稀疏注意力方案。
summary.technical_approach: LSA 由三个互补机制组成。Streaming-Aware Indexing 将一部分稀疏注意力预算分配给可预测的连续区域，包括 attention sink 和局部滑动窗口，其余预算用于动态 token 级选择；这样核心注意力算子可以合并访问连续 KV 块，提升 HBM 带宽利用率。Cross-Layer Indexing 观察到相邻层的显著 token 往往一致，于是把连续 N 层分成一组，只让 owner layer 运行 indexer，其余 reuse layer 共享索引；为避免直接复用带来的质量下降，训练时加入跨层蒸馏目标，使 owner indexer 选择对整组层都重要的 token，索引计算约降为原来的 1/N。Hierarchical Indexing 是训练免费的推理模块，先在 block/page 级表示上检索 top-M 候选页，再在这些页内做细粒度 token 打分，将单 query 选择复杂度从 O(L) 降到 O(L/P + MP)，其中 P 是页大小。
summary.experiments: LSA 在 LongCat-Flash-Lite（69B-A3B）和 LongCat-Flash（560B-A27B）两个规模上评估，在通用、推理、代码和长上下文 benchmark 上与全注意力保持持平。论文称其训练效率显著优于全 MLA，从而支持在有限算力下训练 LongCat-2.0（1.6T-A48B）到最高一百万 token 上下文。基于 LSA 扩展的 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse 将原生上下文长度提升到 1M，相比稠密版本有更高的长上下文推理效率和更强的 agent 能力。消融显示 SI 和 CLI 作为训练感知机制能保持质量；HI 作为即插即用模块进一步加速推理，质量损失很小。
summary.reading_guide: 需要精读。先看第 2.3 节对 DSA 两个瓶颈的 profiling，尤其是 indexer 延迟占比和 HBM 带宽利用率；这是理解后续设计动机的关键。第 3 节中，CLI 的跨层蒸馏和 owner/reuse 分层最值得细读，因为它改变了训练时稀疏注意力的计算分配，而不只是推理优化。HI 的页级粗筛加 token 级细筛可作为训练免费策略单独评估。实验部分建议对比 69B 和 560B 上的质量曲线、长上下文 needle/agent 任务以及消融，重点看 SI、CLI、HI 分别带来的精度与延迟权衡。
summary.authors_note: Meituan LongCat 团队。论文围绕 LongCat 系列模型，包括 LongCat-Flash-Lite、LongCat-Flash 和 LongCat-2.0。

summary_en.core_problem: DeepSeek Sparse Attention uses the Lightning Indexer for fine-grained token selection and achieves near-full-attention quality on long contexts, but deployment exposes two system bottlenecks. The indexer still scores every prefix token and retains O(L^2) overhead, reaching up to 90% of per-layer latency at 1024K context. Its selected indices are also discontinuous, forcing scattered HBM accesses in the sparse-attention operator and yielding only about 4.5% of peak HBM bandwidth. LongCat Sparse Attention targets both indexing cost and memory-access efficiency.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to long-context pretraining and inference. DSA has been adopted by large-scale models such as DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, but its indexer cost becomes dominant at very long contexts. LSA combines cross-layer indexing, streaming-aware contiguous layout, and hierarchical retrieval to reduce both training and inference cost. Validation on Meituan LongCat models at 69B, 560B, and 1.6T scales shows that the design is not merely a kernel trick but a sparse-attention recipe usable in foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: LSA has three complementary mechanisms. Streaming-Aware Indexing allocates part of the sparse-attention budget to predictable contiguous regions, namely attention sinks and a local sliding window, while using the remaining budget for dynamic token-level selection; this allows the core attention operator to use coalesced accesses over contiguous KV blocks. Cross-Layer Indexing exploits the observation that salient tokens are often consistent across adjacent layers: consecutive N layers are grouped, only the owner layer runs the indexer, and reuse layers share its selected tokens. A cross-layer distillation objective trains the owner indexer to capture tokens salient to the whole group, reducing indexing computation to roughly 1/N. Hierarchical Indexing is a training-free inference module that first retrieves top-M candidate pages from block-level representations and then performs fine-grained token scoring only within those pages, reducing per-query selection complexity from O(L) to O(L/P + MP), where P is the page size.
summary_en.experiments: LSA is evaluated on LongCat-Flash-Lite (69B-A3B) and LongCat-Flash (560B-A27B), matching full attention on general, reasoning, coding, and long-context benchmarks. The improved training efficiency over full MLA enables training LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B) with up to one-million-token context under a limited compute budget. LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse extends native context length to 1M and provides higher long-context inference efficiency and stronger agentic capabilities than its dense predecessor. Ablations indicate that the training-aware SI and CLI mechanisms preserve quality, while the plug-and-play HI module adds inference speedup with marginal quality loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read in depth. Start with the DSA bottleneck profiling in Section 2.3, especially indexer latency share and HBM bandwidth utilization, because it motivates all three designs. In Section 3, study CLI most carefully: the owner/reuse grouping and cross-layer distillation change how sparse-attention computation is allocated during training, rather than only optimizing inference. HI is worth evaluating separately as a training-free coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy. In the experiments, compare quality curves, long-context and agentic results, and ablations across the 69B and 560B scales, focusing on the quality-latency trade-offs of SI, CLI, and HI.
summary_en.authors_note: Meituan LongCat team. The paper centers on the LongCat model family, including LongCat-Flash-Lite, LongCat-Flash, and LongCat-2.0.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看 indexing 三件事；它把稀疏注意力瓶颈从算法复杂度拉回到 HBM 访问形态。
recommendation.en: Read the indexing design; it reframes sparse attention limits as HBM access and amortized scoring, not just asymptotic sparsity.

paper.title: Token Radius Attention for Efficient Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers (VDiTs) enable high-fidelity generation but incur quadratic cost from dense 3D self-attention. Existing head- and block-level sparse methods share computation budgets across queries, overlooking token-specific attention demand. We observe that retained density varies across queries yet correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, while dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods with token-dependent radii. Based on these findings, we propose Token Radi

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散Transformer的3D稠密自注意力随token数平方增长，现有稀疏方法在head/block层统一分配计算预算，忽略不同token的注意力需求差异。
summary.importance: 提出训练免费的token级动态稀疏注意力框架，在主流视频生成模型上实现1.5-2x加速且质量损失可控。
summary.technical_approach: 观察到query的注意力保留密度与注意力熵呈对数线性相关，核心交互集中在query中心邻域；将每个query的熵映射为独立token预算，转换为带时序衰减的注意力半径，无需显式key排序；通过融合熵提取、warm-up复用、块稀疏掩码构建降低额外开销。
summary.experiments: 在Wan2.1、Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo共7个文生视频/图生视频配置上测试，仅保留9-19%注意力交互，实现1.56x-2.05x加速，生成质量与原模型相当。

summary_en.core_problem: 3D dense self-attention in video Diffusion Transformers incurs quadratic cost, while existing sparse methods share computation budgets at head/block granularity, ignoring token-specific attention demand.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free token-level dynamic sparse attention framework that delivers 1.5-2x speedup on mainstream video generation models with negligible quality loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that retained attention density per query correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, and dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods; maps per-query entropy to independent token budgets converted to temporally decayed attention radii without explicit key ranking; reduces overhead via fused entropy extraction, warm-up reuse, and block-sparse mask construction.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 7 T2V/I2V configurations of Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo, retains only 9-19% of attention interactions, achieves 1.56x-2.05x speedup with competitive generation quality.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成专用的token级动态稀疏注意力，无排序动态半径的思路可作长上下文LLM稀疏注意力的旁证，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Video-generation-specific token-wise dynamic sparse attention; its ranking-free dynamic radius idea offers minor reference for long-context LLM attention, abstract suffices.

paper.title: Understanding Sparse Attention Selectivity in Long-Context Foundation Models via Counterfactual Evaluation
paper.abstract: Sparse attention is widely deployed in long-context serving stacks, yet no framework audits how discarding blocks changes the influence of specific content on model output. We first establish that the phenomenon is real and causal: Block Sparse Flash Attention (BSFA) route replay across four architectures changes output decisions in 13 of 16 cells, with zero identity-replay label flips. We then introduce a dense-calibrated counterfactual audit using matched probe cards---Gold (carrying the corre

summary.core_problem: 稀疏注意力已成为长上下文大模型推理服务的标准组件，但现有评估仅关注吞吐、内存占用和整体基准精度，无法检测稀疏化对不同内容块输出影响力的因果性改变——尤其是正负向偏移相互抵消、整体指标不变但内容影响力分布已发生扭曲的隐蔽问题。
summary.importance: 该工作揭示长上下文模型的预训练与推理侧稀疏化策略无法完全解耦：稀疏注意力的选择偏好会直接改变模型实际利用上下文信息的模式，反过来影响长上下文预训练能力的评估与目标设计。其提出的反事实审计协议提供了一套超越整体基准分数的稀疏注意力验证方法，发现的信号集中与整合损失的竞争机制，也为稀疏感知的预训练目标设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过块稀疏Flash注意力（BSFA）路由重放，在四个模型架构上验证稀疏路由确实会因果性改变内容对输出的影响。随后设计密集校准的反事实审计协议：在同一个prompt中放置三类匹配的探针块——Gold（携带正确答案）、Poison（携带目标错误答案）、Benign（纯填充内容），通过6种排列消除位置效应；分别记录自然稀疏路由的选择结果，以及强制路由下各探针对答案置信度margin的影响，再与同内核路径下的密集注意力基线做差得到核心指标Δ（稀疏内容效应减密集内容效应），Δ为正代表稀疏注意力放大了该探针的影响力，为负则代表密集注意力下影响力更大。最后通过跨块注意力消融实验验证整合损失的作用机制。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖4个模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B）、2个任务（SCBench-KV、SciFact）、3个压缩比（0.25/0.50/0.75）。16个模型-任务-比例单元中，13个单元出现强制错误路由提升错误答案margin的现象，无显著反向单元，也无身份重放标签翻转。观察到两种竞争模式：一是信号集中，选择器优先保留Gold和Poison块的比例远高于Benign块；二是整合损失，丢弃块会切断跨块注意力通路，降低内容影响力。压缩比是核心控制变量：所有单元的Δ都随压缩比升高向正向移动（信号集中逐渐占优），部分单元出现符号反转，例如Qwen3-8B在SCBench-KV上Δ从c=0.25的-0.31升至c=0.75的+0.93。跨块注意力消融显示，隔离探针块的跨块通信会使其影响力从4.48 logits降至0。使用KVPress、SnapKV等KV缓存驱逐机制重复实验，8个单元全部验证了相同的方向规律。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节的反事实审计协议设计（尤其是三类匹配探针块和6种位置排列的控制逻辑）、第5节的压缩比扫描实验与两种竞争机制的分析、第6节的跨块注意力消融机制验证。预计阅读时间20-25分钟，无需深入推导，重点理解实验控制逻辑与核心发现即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Sparse attention is now standard infrastructure for long-context LLM serving, but existing evaluations only measure throughput, memory footprint, and aggregate benchmark accuracy. They cannot detect causal, content-specific shifts in how much influence different context blocks exert on model outputs — especially cases where positive and negative shifts cancel out, leaving aggregate metrics unchanged even as the underlying influence distribution is distorted.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates that long-context model pretraining and inference-time sparsification cannot be fully decoupled: sparse attention selection patterns directly change which content the model actually uses, which in turn affects how we evaluate long-context pretraining capabilities and design pretraining objectives. The counterfactual audit protocol provides a rigorous way to validate sparse attention schemes beyond top-line benchmark scores. The observed tradeoff between signal concentration and integration loss also informs the design of sparsity-aware pretraining targets.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the authors use Block Sparse Flash Attention (BSFA) route replay across four model architectures to establish that sparse routing causally alters content influence on outputs. They then design a dense-calibrated counterfactual audit protocol: three matched probe blocks (Gold with correct answer, Poison with target wrong answer, Benign filler) are placed in a single prompt, with 6 permutations to eliminate position effects. They record the selector's natural route, then measure each probe's effect on answer margin under forced routing. The primary metric Δ subtracts the dense attention content effect (measured on the same kernel path with no pruning) from the sparse content effect: positive Δ means sparse attention amplifies the probe's influence, negative Δ means dense attention does. A cross-block attention ablation confirms the integration loss mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover 4 models (Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-8B), 2 tasks (SCBench-KV, SciFact), and 3 compression ratios (0.25/0.50/0.75). Across 16 model-task-ratio cells, forcing the wrong evidence route increases the wrong-answer margin in 13 cells, with no significantly negative cells and zero identity-replay label flips. Two competing patterns emerge: signal concentration (selectors retain Gold and Poison blocks far more often than Benign blocks) and integration loss (discarding blocks severs cross-block attention pathways, reducing content influence). Compression ratio is the key control variable: Δ shifts toward positive values (signal concentration dominates) at higher compression across all cells, with sign reversals in some cells. For example, Qwen3-8B on SCBench-KV shows Δ moving from -0.31 at c=0.25 to +0.93 at c=0.75. Cross-block attention ablation shows isolating a probe block from cross-block communication reduces its influence from 4.48 logits to exactly zero. The same directional pattern is confirmed across 8 cells when repeating the audit with KV-cache eviction methods (KVPress, SnapKV).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the counterfactual audit protocol design (especially the matched probe blocks and 6-position permutation controls), Section 5 for the compression ratio sweep and analysis of the two competing mechanisms, and Section 6 for the cross-block attention ablation that validates the integration loss mechanism. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes. No deep derivation needed; focus on the experimental control logic and core findings.

recommendation.zh: 做稀疏注意力或长上下文路由的人重点看 §4 的探针设计和 Fig 4，它把“保留了哪些 block”从相关性变成因果结论。
recommendation.en: For sparse-attention or long-context routing work, focus on the probe design in §4 and Fig 4; they turn 'which blocks are retained' from correlation into causal conclusions.

paper.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
paper.abstract: We present Wonder, a general-purpose video world model for real-time, camera-controllable world exploration. Given an image or a conditional video, Wonder constructs a playable world where users can navigate interactively by moving the camera, discovering unseen regions, and revisiting previously observed areas in real time and over a long-term horizon. Achieving this capability requires a system-level co-design of control method, memory mechanism, and training strategy. We introduce a novel cam

summary.core_problem: 构建可实时交互、可由相机控制、能长期探索和回访的通用视频世界模型。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成/世界模型系统设计。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接方法贡献，但 dense camera conditioning、长程生成记忆和稀疏注意力检索，对未来统一视频-语言世界模型有可借鉴的系统信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Wonder，通过系统级协同设计把控制、记忆和训练策略结合起来。核心包括：用 dense coordinate field 作为相机条件，使模型获得空间对齐的运动和朝向线索；用稀疏 attention 记忆机制在推理时只检索少量相关上下文 token，使实际上下文增长时计算仍可控；同时配套训练策略以支持长期可导航生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 或量化提升。它声称支持从单张图像或条件视频生成可交互世界，用户可移动相机、探索未见区域并长期回访已见区域，目标是实时运行。
summary.authors_note: Vishal M. Patel 和 Kalyan Sunkavalli 是视觉生成、图像/视频建模方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to build a real-time, camera-controllable video world model that supports long-horizon exploration and revisiting of generated environments.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation and world-modeling system contribution. It is not a direct LLM pretraining method, but its camera conditioning and sparse memory design are relevant to future unified video-language world models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Wonder combines control, memory, and training strategy. It uses a dense coordinate field as camera conditioning to provide spatially aligned motion and orientation cues, and an efficient sparse-attention memory mechanism that retrieves a small set of relevant context tokens at inference time as the generation history grows.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims support for image- or video-conditioned playable worlds with interactive camera movement, unseen-region discovery, and long-term revisiting in real time.
summary_en.authors_note: Vishal M. Patel and Kalyan Sunkavalli are recognized researchers in visual generation and image/video modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不必按 LLM 论文读；只看稀疏记忆检索如何约束长程视频生成上下文。
recommendation.en: Do not read it like an LLM paper; inspect only how sparse memory retrieval constrains long-horizon video generation context.

paper.title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Token-level sparse attention, as implemented by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) in production systems, makes the downstream attention efficient but shifts the bottleneck to the indexer that feeds it. To select the top-k tokens for each query, the indexer must still score every preceding token, incurring a cost of O(L^2) per layer for a sequence of length L. We observe that this per-query scan is largely redundant: nearby queries select highly overlapping top-k tokens, and the indexer scores are

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 token-level sparse attention 在真实长上下文推理里的一个新瓶颈：主注意力已经从全量 attention 降到只看 top-k token，但用于选出这 top-k 的 indexer 仍然要对每个 query 扫完整个前缀，单层复杂度还是 O(L^2)。论文抓住的不是 token 轴、head 轴或 layer 轴，而是 query 轴上的冗余：相邻 query 往往会选到高度重合的 top-k token，因此没必要为每个 query 各做一次完整前缀扫描。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练方法本身，而在长上下文 serving 与稀疏注意力落地。很多稀疏 attention 方案论文里看起来便宜，真正上线时却被索引阶段拖住，这篇工作把瓶颈拆得很清楚，也给出一个不改模型、不重训、可直接替换的方案。它的价值主要有两点：第一，说明 sparse attention 的效率分析不能只看 downstream attention kernel，还要把 candidate selection 算进去；第二，提出 query-group 共享索引这一条独立于 token/head/layer 压缩的新轴，对后续训练期联合设计也有启发，比如是否可以在预训练中显式鼓励局部 query 的检索一致性，从而让这类近似更稳。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，也很工程化。PIVOT 的核心是把一组相邻 query 合成一个 proxy query，只做一次 full-prefix traversal，然后把这次扫描得到的高分 token 作为整组共享候选集。之后再分两种变体。PIVOT-Refine 会让组内每个 query 只在这个小候选集上重新打分，再取自己的 top-k；这样把原本每个 query 的 O(L) 扫描改成 O(c)，其中 k < c << L。PIVOT-Reuse 更激进，直接把 proxy query 的 top-k 复用给整组 query，连 per-query refine 都省掉。复杂度上，g 个 query 的索引成本从 O(gL) 变成 Refine 的 O(L + gc) 或 Reuse 的 O(L)。论文成立的经验基础有两个：一是相邻 query 的 top-k overlap 很高；二是 indexer score 沿 key 轴呈长尾分布，所以只要 c 比 k 稍大，通常就能覆盖组内大部分真正需要的 token。实现上它保持 DSA 接口不变，下游 Sparse MLA 完全不用改，因此是 drop-in replacement。prefill 阶段按固定组大小分组；decode 阶段则直接利用 multi-token prediction 同一步产生的 d+1 个 token 作为一组，因此能和 MTP 的加速叠加。方法的关键取舍也很清楚：Refine 更稳，Reuse 更便宜；组越大，摊薄越明显，但候选覆盖风险也会上升。
summary.experiments: 论文在 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5.1 上做了 LongBench 与 RULER 评测，结论是 Refine 基本能维持与原始 dense DSA indexer 相当的精度，同时显著降低索引开销。文中给出的代表性结果是：在长上下文场景下，indexer operator 最多可加速 4×，端到端延迟最多降低 1.6×。问题背景里的一个数字也很关键：在 200K context 时，原始 indexer 可占 prefill 延迟约 81%，decode 延迟约 41%，这解释了为什么只优化 attention kernel 不够。实验重点不是绝对任务分数提升，而是 accuracy-latency tradeoff：PIVOT-Refine 在较小候选预算下就能接近基线，说明 query-group 的 top-k union 远小于最坏情况 gk；PIVOT-Reuse 则进一步换取速度，但更依赖 query 相似性。消融的核心变量应包括 group size g、candidate size c、Refine vs Reuse、prefill 与 decode 两阶段差异，以及不同长上下文长度下的收益变化。全文给人的信息是：收益主要来自把重复 prefix scan 摊薄，而不是改写下游稀疏 attention 算子。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2。Figure 2 基本给出了整篇成立的证据：相邻 query 的 top-k overlap 高，而且组内 top-k 并集增长很慢。然后看方法部分里 proxy query 的构造方式、candidate set 的选取、Refine 与 Reuse 的复杂度对比。实验部分重点看三类结果：一是 indexer latency 与 end-to-end latency 的拆分；二是不同 g、c 下的精度保持情况；三是 prefill 和 decode 是否都稳定受益。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得跟进，实现接口兼容性和 MTP 结合方式最值得看，因为这决定了它是不是一个真实可部署的方案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in token-level sparse attention. Even if the downstream attention only attends to top-k tokens, the indexer still scores every prefix token for every query, so indexing remains O(L^2) per layer. The key observation is that this work does not reduce cost along the token, head, or layer axis; it attacks redundancy along the query axis. Nearby queries often retrieve highly overlapping top-k tokens, so running a full prefix scan for each query is wasteful.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly on long-context inference and sparse-attention deployment rather than pretraining itself. Many sparse-attention designs look efficient on paper but hide a dense retrieval stage that dominates latency in production. This paper is useful because it makes that hidden cost explicit and proposes a training-free replacement. Two takeaways matter. First, sparse-attention efficiency should be evaluated end-to-end, including candidate selection. Second, query-group shared indexing is an orthogonal optimization axis, which may later inform training-time co-design, for example by encouraging local retrieval consistency so that such approximations become more reliable.
summary_en.technical_approach: PIVOT groups nearby queries and replaces multiple full-prefix scans with one shared scan. A group is aggregated into a single proxy query, which traverses the prefix once and selects a shared candidate set of size c. Then there are two variants. PIVOT-Refine rescoring: each query re-scores only the shared candidate set and picks its own top-k. This changes per-query work from O(L) to O(c), where k < c << L. PIVOT-Reuse is cheaper: it directly reuses the proxy top-k for all queries in the group, skipping per-query refinement. For a group of size g, indexing cost drops from O(gL) to O(L + gc) for Refine or O(L) for Reuse. The method relies on two empirical properties shown in the paper: high top-k overlap among nearby queries, and long-tailed indexer scores along the key axis, so a candidate budget only slightly above k is often enough. Importantly, PIVOT preserves the DSA interface and leaves the downstream Sparse MLA operator unchanged, making it a drop-in replacement. In prefill, groups are formed by contiguous query positions; in decode, the d+1 tokens from one multi-token prediction step form a natural group, so PIVOT composes with MTP speedups.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 with LongBench and RULER. The main result is not better task quality but a better accuracy-latency tradeoff. PIVOT-Refine largely matches the dense DSA indexer in accuracy while reducing indexing cost substantially. The headline numbers are up to 4x speedup for the indexer operator and up to 1.6x end-to-end latency reduction at long context. A key motivating number from the paper is that at 200K context, the original indexer can account for about 81% of prefill latency and 41% of decode latency. The important ablations are group size g, candidate size c, Refine versus Reuse, and behavior in prefill versus decode. The evidence suggests that the gain comes from amortizing repeated prefix scans, not from changing the sparse attention kernel itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 2. Those plots carry the central empirical claim: neighboring queries have high top-k overlap, and the union of their top-k sets grows much more slowly than the worst-case gk. Then read the method section for proxy-query construction, candidate selection, and the complexity difference between Refine and Reuse. In experiments, focus on latency breakdowns, quality retention under different g and c, and whether gains hold in both prefill and decode. Around 20 to 30 minutes is enough for a solid skim. If deciding whether it is deployable, pay most attention to interface compatibility and how it leverages MTP during decode.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek生产级稀疏注意力的索引优化，思路巧妙且训练无关，做长上下文/高效注意力的研究员应重点看其分组共享扫描的设计。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek's production-grade sparse attention index optimization, clever and training-free; researchers on long-context/efficient attention should study its group-shared scan design.

paper.title: Parameter-free Adaptive Sparse Attention via Compression-Based Content Selection
paper.abstract: Data-adaptive sparse attention masks substantially outperform fixed patterns (e.g., BigBird and Longformer) and can even exceed dense attention on long sequences. Existing adaptive approaches---including SBM-Transformer, Dynamic Mask Attention, and NSA---typically require additional learnable parameters, custom gradient estimators, or specialized CUDA kernels.   We show that classical data compression provides an effective masking signal with \textbf{no additional parameters}. By computing per-b

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 Transformer 需要自适应稀疏注意力掩码，现有方法（SBM-Transformer、NSA、Dynamic Mask Attention 等）要么引入额外可学习参数，要么依赖特殊梯度估计器或自定义 CUDA 核，带来训练和部署复杂度。
summary.importance: 提出一种零额外参数、无需自定义算子的自适应稀疏注意力信号来源：用经典数据压缩（gzip）的压缩率判断信息密度。对预训练研究的启发在于：不一定要通过学习或复杂路由网络才能找到有价值的远距离依赖，简单的信息论信号在长序列上可能比基于梯度的掩码学习更稳健。不过 gzip 作为 CPU 端压缩器，直接接入训练/推理路径的工程代价和多 tokenizer/多模态可扩展性仍需验证。
summary.technical_approach: 把输入切分为固定大小的块（默认 b=128 bytes），对每个块用 gzip level 1 计算压缩率 r_i；r_i 越高表示块越不可压缩、信息密度越高。用当前序列内块压缩率的均值作为阈值，将块标记为 literal（信息密度高）或 redundant（重复、可预测）。注意力掩码由三部分构成：（1）literal 块之间全连接形成远距离主干，且跳过局部窗口内的近邻；（2）相邻块通过 w=1 的局部窗口始终相连，提供 256 bytes 局部上下文；（3）去除 BigBird/Longformer 使用的固定位置 global token。整体复杂度为 O(N)，不需要学习参数或直通估计器，压缩用标准库即可实现。
summary.experiments: 在 PG-19 等长序列语言建模上与 BigBird、SBM-Transformer 等对比。关键数字：在 8K 上下文，该方法达到 1.71 BPB，SBM-Transformer 为 3.38 BPB；相对 BigBird，在 4K 上下文优势约 0.05 BPB，在 8K 扩大到 0.63 BPB，优势随序列长度增长。消融显示 literal-to-literal 长程连接贡献 -0.43 BPB（占 BigBird 改进的 68%），局部窗口贡献 -0.12 BPB（19%），去掉固定 global token 贡献 -0.08 BPB（13%）。不同序列上 literal 块比例约在 36%–67% 之间自适应变化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看方法部分的掩码构造逻辑（§3.2）和消融分解（§4.3），尤其是为什么去掉 global token 反而更好、为什么压缩率信号在长上下文下比 learned mask 更稳。预计阅读时间 15–20 分钟。若关注实际部署，需自行评估 gzip 在 GPU 训练中的调用开销与 batch 内并行度影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Adaptive sparse attention masks are needed for long-context Transformers, but existing methods such as SBM-Transformer, NSA, and Dynamic Mask Attention introduce extra learnable parameters, custom gradient estimators, or specialized CUDA kernels, adding training and deployment complexity.
summary_en.importance: The paper shows that a zero-parameter signal from classical data compression—gzip compression ratio—can identify information-dense blocks and build effective adaptive sparse masks. The main implication for pretraining research is that useful long-range dependencies do not always require learned routers or complex gating; simple information-theoretic cues can be more robust than gradient-based mask learning at long context. The main caveat is that gzip runs on CPUs as a preprocessing-style step, so its integration cost into training/inference loops and its portability across tokenizers and modalities remain open.
summary_en.technical_approach: The input is split into fixed-size blocks (b=128 bytes by default). For each block, a gzip compression ratio r_i is computed using gzip level 1; higher r_i means the block is harder to compress and therefore more information-dense. Blocks are labeled as literal or redundant using the within-sequence mean ratio as a threshold, so the literal fraction adapts per input. The attention mask has three parts: (1) all literal blocks are connected to each other for long-range attention outside a local window; (2) adjacent blocks are always connected via a small local window (w=1, covering 256 bytes); (3) fixed-position global tokens used by BigBird/Longformer are removed entirely. The construction runs in O(N) time, uses no learnable parameters, and requires no custom kernels.
summary_en.experiments: On long-sequence language modeling benchmarks such as PG-19, the method is compared against BigBird and SBM-Transformer. At 8K context, it reaches 1.71 BPB versus 3.38 BPB for SBM-Transformer. The gap over BigBird grows from about 0.05 BPB at 4K context to 0.63 BPB at 8K context. An ablation decomposes the gain over BigBird: literal-to-literal long-range edges contribute -0.43 BPB (68% of the total improvement), the local window contributes -0.12 BPB (19%), and removing fixed global tokens contributes -0.08 BPB (13%). Across PG-19 sequences, the literal fraction varies from about 36% to 67% without any sparsity hyperparameter.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the mask construction in Section 3.2 and the ablation in Section 4.3, especially the claim that fixed global tokens hurt performance and that compression-based selection remains stable at 8K while learned masking degrades. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes. For systems-oriented readers, the main follow-up question is whether gzip can be made efficient enough in a GPU training loop.

recommendation.zh: 用 gzip 压缩率做 attention routing 的思路很巧妙，提供了一种无需训练的 data-dependent sparsity baseline，值得关注其在更大规模模型上的表现。
recommendation.en: The idea of using gzip compression ratio for attention routing is clever, providing a training-free data-dependent sparsity baseline. Worth watching its performance on larger models.

paper.title: RIS-Kernel: A Model-Agnostic Architecture for Long-Context LLM Inference via Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Full self-attention in large language models scales as O(N^2), which limits long-context document analysis to 65,536 tokens and requires costly GPU clusters. The Reduced Interaction Sampling (RIS) inference engine addresses this constraint as a model-agnostic architecture. Without modifying weights, RIS reduces self-attention complexity to O(N log N) using sparse stochastic geometry that fits within commodity memory limits. We validate RIS on Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct across two regimes. In controlled

summary.core_problem: LLM全注意力O(N²)复杂度限制长上下文推理，需在不改权重前提下实现模型无关的稀疏注意力推理。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出模型无关的稀疏注意力推理架构RIS-Kernel，将自注意力复杂度降至O(N log N)。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Reduced Interaction Sampling(RIS)推理引擎，基于稀疏随机几何实现O(N log N)复杂度，无需修改模型权重；支持随机稀疏模式与多种子集成。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct上验证，32768 token场景下，1%密度+70个集成种子的RIS-Stochastic准确率75.00%，超过稠密基线71.88%；5%密度+10种子与稠密基线持平。

summary_en.core_problem: Full self-attention's O(N²) complexity limits long-context LLM inference; a weight-agnostic sparse attention architecture is needed.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a model-agnostic sparse attention inference architecture that reduces self-attention complexity to O(N log N).
summary_en.technical_approach: The Reduced Interaction Sampling (RIS) inference engine uses sparse stochastic geometry to achieve O(N log N) complexity without modifying model weights, supporting stochastic sparsity patterns and multi-seed ensembling.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct at 32,768 tokens: RIS-Stochastic with 1% density and 70 ensemble seeds reaches 75.00% accuracy, outperforming the dense baseline of 71.88%; 5% density with 10 seeds matches the dense baseline.

recommendation.zh: 稀疏注意力推理的增量工作，低密集成反而超过稠密基线的现象值得留意，但实验规模小，作为弱信号参考。
recommendation.en: Incremental sparse attention inference work; the counterintuitive low-density ensemble outperforming dense attention is notable but small-scale, treat as weak signal.

paper.title: ELSAA: Efficient Low-Rank and Sparse Attention Approximation for Training Transformers
paper.abstract: The quadratic $N\times N$ attention score matrix remains a central obstacle to extending Transformers to longer input lengths. Existing efficient attention methods usually reduce this bottleneck by either imposing sparsity, so that each query attends to only a small subset of keys, or by using low-rank/kernel sketches, so that global interactions are compressed into a lower-dimensional representation. We propose \emph{ELSAA}, an efficient low-rank and sparse approximation of attention. Important

summary.core_problem: 稠密自注意力的二次复杂度是长上下文Transformer训练的核心瓶颈。现有稀疏注意力、低秩/线性注意力两类近似方案各有缺陷：稀疏模式容易遗漏权重低但全局重要的交互，低秩近似会抹平尖锐的高权重token依赖。已有的稀疏+低秩组合方法仅做逐元素修正，没有解决两个分支的归一化尺度不匹配问题，易出现交互双计数、训练不稳定、融合效果不佳的问题。
summary.importance: ELSAA为长上下文训练中的稀疏-低秩组合注意力提供了即插即用的融合框架，不需要修改QKV投影层的参数化形式，可与FlashAttention等现有IO优化的注意力实现兼容，为长序列预训练的效率-精度权衡提供了新的可选路径。
summary.technical_approach: 和对注意力权重矩阵做稀疏低秩分解以提升参数效率的方法不同，ELSAA直接在QKV投影完成后对注意力算子本身做近似：并行设置两个分支，稀疏分支选取与query高相似的key集合计算精确注意力，捕获强局部/高权重交互；低秩分支通过压缩特征图计算全局上下文，覆盖稀疏分支遗漏的弥散性残差依赖。核心改进是分母感知的校正机制：分别估计两个分支覆盖的softmax归一化质量，将分支输出重缩放到统一尺度后，通过可学习门控融合。这一设计消除了朴素分支加和带来的交互双计数和尺度扭曲问题，支持任意稀疏模式（局部窗口、局部敏感哈希、路由、动态top-k选择等）和低秩/线性注意力核的组合。
summary.experiments: 目前公开的手稿章节仅覆盖动机与核心设计部分，未披露完整实验结果。从结构设计来看，方法仅引入极少量门控参数，相对于朴素双分支注意力实现的额外开销很低。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第2章的方法动机和分母校正推导，对比其与Scatterbrain等现有稀疏-低秩组合方法的核心差异，预计阅读时间15分钟。待完整手稿发布后，再结合长上下文预训练基准上的速度、精度实测结果评估实际落地价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The quadratic complexity of dense self-attention remains the primary bottleneck for long-context Transformer training. Existing sparse or low-rank attention approximations each have characteristic failure modes: sparse patterns miss weak but globally important interactions, while low-rank approximations smooth out sharp, high-magnitude token dependencies. Prior methods that combine the two rely on entry-wise correction but fail to resolve the normalization scale mismatch between branches, leading to unstable training and suboptimal fusion of the two approximation pathways.
summary_en.importance: ELSAA provides a plug-and-play fusion framework for combined sparse-lowrank attention in long-context training, without requiring modification to QKV projection weight parameterizations. The method is compatible with existing IO-optimized attention implementations such as FlashAttention, and offers a practical tradeoff point between compute efficiency and approximation fidelity for long-sequence pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Unlike methods that decompose attention weight matrices into sparse and low-rank factors for parameter efficiency, ELSAA approximates the attention score operator directly after QKV projection. The architecture uses two parallel branches: a sparse branch that computes exact attention over a selected set of high-similarity keys to capture strong, localized interactions, and a low-rank branch that computes global context via compressed feature maps to cover diffuse residual dependencies. The core innovation is a denominator-aware correction mechanism that estimates the softmax normalization mass covered by each branch, rescales branch outputs to aligned scales, and fuses them with learned gating weights. This eliminates double-counting of interactions and scale distortion from naive branch addition, and works with arbitrary sparse pattern implementations (local windows, LSH, routing, dynamic top-k selection) and low-rank/linear attention kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The released manuscript sections cover motivation and core design only, with full experimental results not yet included in the available text. By construction, the method introduces no trainable parameters beyond light gating terms, and incurs minimal overhead relative to naive two-branch attention implementations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the method motivation and denominator correction derivation in Section 2 to understand the key difference from prior sparse-lowrank combination methods such as Scatterbrain. Allocate ~15 minutes for reading. Wait for the full manuscript to evaluate empirical speed and accuracy tradeoffs on long-context pretraining benchmarks before drawing practical deployment conclusions.

recommendation.zh: 稀疏+低秩联合近似注意力算子的思路干净，分母归一化是容易踩的坑，重点看 §3 归一化设计和实验中的长序列训练曲线。
recommendation.en: The joint sparse+low-rank approximation of the attention operator is cleanly designed, and denominator normalization is a common pitfall; focus on §3 normalization design and long-sequence training curves.

paper.title: LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in long chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 have led to increasingly longer inference context lengths under the test-time scaling paradigm. However, the O(n^2) computational complexity of standard self-attention causes inference costs to grow sharply with long sequences, limiting the deployment of long-CoT reasoning in production settings. To address this, we propose LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play attention replacement module that requir

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很现实的问题：推理模型在 test-time scaling 下会生成很长的 CoT，准确率往往随思维链长度上升，但标准 softmax attention 的计算和缓存成本也随上下文迅速变重。已有两类路子都不理想：一类是直接让模型少想、短想，代价是推理能力容易掉；另一类是用纯线性注意力或状态压缩替代全注意力，代价是精确检索能力不足，尤其在数学推理这类强依赖局部关键 token 回看的任务上容易失真。LISA要解决的核心矛盾，就是在不从头预训练、不改模型主体参数和输出格式的前提下，把长上下文推理的每步成本压到近似常数，同时尽量保住甚至提升 reasoning quality。
