paper.title: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for KVCache in Long Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context Large Language Model inference is severely bottlenecked by the massive Key-Value (KV) cache, yet existing sparse attention methods often suffer from static fixed-budget (Top-k) retrieval or rely on proxy scores that are computationally expensive and biased. To address these limitations, we propose RaBitQCache, a novel sparse attention framework that utilizes randomized rotated binary quantization and high-throughput binary-INT4 arithmetic to efficiently estimate attention weights. O

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的 KV cache 访问瓶颈。问题不只是显存大，而是每一步解码都要在巨大的历史 KV 上做选择和读取。已有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法通常依赖固定预算的 Top-k 检索，或者依赖近似但偏差较大的 proxy score 来估计注意力重要性。前者不够自适应，后者既不够准，也缺少误差保证，因此很难安全地做 Top-p 这类按真实注意力质量自适应分配预算的检索。作者要解决的核心问题是：能否构造一个足够便宜、足够准、还有理论误差界的注意力代理分数，用它在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下做动态稀疏检索。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 efficient inference，而不是预训练本身，但对大模型系统研究有现实价值。它的重要性主要在两个层面。第一，方法上它把 KV 选择问题明确地写成高维向量相似度估计问题，并借助 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 视角构造了带理论界的 proxy score，这比很多经验型 sparse attention 方法更扎实。第二，系统上它不是只给一个近似公式，而是把二值化、INT4 查询、异步流水和 lazy update 一起做成了可运行方案。对基座研究员来说，直接启发不在建模，而在于：长上下文能力的上限越来越受 memory movement 和 retrieval policy 约束，未来训练和推理可能需要更统一地考虑“哪些历史 token 值得被精确保留”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 RaBitQCache，核心思想是把 Key 的高维浮点向量映射成随机旋转后的二值码，再用一个极轻量的二值-低比特算术近似 query-key 内积，从而估计注意力权重。具体分成几个层次。

第一层是表示压缩。在 prefill 阶段，作者对 Key 向量做随机旋转，然后映射到单位超立方体顶点，也就是得到 binary code。随机旋转的作用是让原始空间中的几何关系在低成本表示里尽量保真，避免直接按坐标符号切分带来的偏置。这个设计明显受 JL lemma 和相关近似近邻检索方法启发。

第二层是 proxy score 构造。在 decoding 阶段，不再直接用全精度 query 与所有 key 做内积，而是把 Query 做 INT4 量化，再与二值化 Key 进行高吞吐计算，得到一个对真实 attention score 的无偏估计。论文强调两点：一，这个估计器是 unbiased；二，它有严格的误差界。前者意味着估计值不会系统性高估或低估某类 token，后者意味着不仅能做相对排序，还能对分数大小本身有一定可信度，这正是支持 Top-p 检索的关键。

第三层是检索策略。不同于固定 Top-k，RaBitQCache 用估计到的注意力质量做 adaptive Top-p retrieval。因为不同层、不同头、不同任务的注意力稀疏度差异很大，固定 k 往往要么取多了浪费算力，要么取少了伤精度。Top-p 更接近“保留足够多的重要质量”，理论上更适合异质的注意力分布，但前提就是 proxy score 必须能近似真实权重幅值，而不只是给个粗排序。

第四层是系统实现。作者实现了硬件感知的 kernel 和调度，包括异步流水线以及 lazy updates，用来隐藏二值检索和数据搬运的额外开销。这个部分很关键，因为很多 sparse/offloading 方法算法上省 FLOPs，系统上却被 gather/scatter 和 CPU-GPU 传输拖垮。RaBitQCache 试图把“近似检索”真正做成吞吐友好的路径。

和 Quest、DS 这类方法相比，区别主要在三点：检索粒度更细，不是整页粗选；proxy score 更接近真实内积，不是部分维度或启发式统计；支持自适应 Top-p，而不是被迫固定预算。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法描述看，作者做的是长上下文推理加速实验，并声称显著优于现有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法。虽然给出的片段没有完整主表数字，但正文明确强调了几个结果方向。第一，在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下，RaBitQCache 能在保持模型性能基本稳定的同时提升长上下文推理效率。第二，相比现有方法，它的优势来自更准确的 token 重要性估计，因此在相同预算下精度损失更小，或者在相近精度下可进一步减少检索 token 数。第三，系统优化后，额外的代理分数计算和调度开销被较好掩蔽，否则算法收益很难兑现成端到端 latency 改善。

如果通读全文，建议重点抓几类实验。其一，proxy score 与真实 attention score 的相关性或误差分析，这是方法成立的根。其二，Top-k 与 Top-p 的对比，尤其是在不同层、不同头、不同任务上的预算自适应效果。其三，和 Quest、DS、静态位置选择等基线的端到端 latency、吞吐、显存/带宽占用比较。其四，消融随机旋转、二值码长度、INT4 量化精度、lazy update 和异步流水各自贡献。真正有说服力的结果通常不是单一 speedup，而是 accuracy-latency 曲线整体外移。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看引言里对现有动态 KV 检索两类缺陷的归纳：proxy 不准，以及没有误差界。这两点决定了作者为什么坚持做带理论保证的估计器。然后直接看方法部分中 proxy score 的定义与定理，确认无偏性和误差界到底针对的是 query-key 内积、attention logits，还是归一化后的权重。接着看系统实现图，判断异步流水和 lazy update 是否只是工程补丁，还是和算法设计强耦合。最后看主实验和消融，重点关注 accuracy-latency tradeoff，而不是只看单点加速比。

如果只想快速判断价值，优先读三处：理论部分的主命题、Top-p 检索实验、端到端系统性能表。若要深挖，可以继续追两个问题：一，随机旋转和二值化在不同层的分布漂移下是否稳定；二，这种 proxy 是否能迁移到训练时的 memory compression 或检索增强注意力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the main bottleneck in long-context decoding: not just the size of the KV cache, but the cost of repeatedly selecting and reading from a very large history. Existing sparse-attention and KV-offloading methods usually rely on either fixed-budget Top-k retrieval or cheap but biased proxy scores for token importance. Fixed Top-k is not adaptive enough, while weak proxies are often inaccurate and lack error guarantees, which makes adaptive Top-p retrieval hard to trust. The core question here is whether one can build a proxy score that is cheap, accurate, and theoretically controlled, so that dynamic sparse retrieval can be done without touching the full KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model systems work. Its main value is twofold. First, it formulates KV selection as a high-dimensional similarity estimation problem and brings in a Johnson-Lindenstrauss-style perspective to construct a proxy with explicit guarantees. That is methodologically stronger than many heuristic sparse-attention designs. Second, it does not stop at the estimator: it also builds a hardware-aware implementation around binary keys, INT4 queries, asynchronous pipelining, and lazy updates. For LLM researchers, the broader lesson is that long-context capability is increasingly constrained by memory movement and retrieval policy, not only by model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RaBitQCache compresses high-dimensional key vectors into rotated binary codes, then uses very cheap binary-low-bit arithmetic to estimate query-key similarity during decoding. The method has several layers.

First is representation compression. During prefill, each key vector is randomly rotated and then mapped to the vertices of a unit hypercube, producing a binary code. The random rotation is important: it preserves geometric structure better than naive sign binarization and reduces coordinate-aligned bias. This design is clearly inspired by JL-style dimensionality reduction and approximate nearest-neighbor methods.

Second is the proxy-score construction. During decoding, the method does not compute full-precision inner products between the query and all keys. Instead, it quantizes the query to INT4 and computes a lightweight interaction with the binary keys. The resulting score is used as an estimator of the true attention score. The paper emphasizes two properties: the estimator is unbiased, and it comes with a rigorous error bound. Unbiasedness matters because it avoids systematic distortion of token importance. The error bound matters because it enables not just rough ranking but magnitude-aware estimation, which is exactly what adaptive Top-p retrieval needs.

Third is the retrieval policy. Unlike fixed Top-k methods, RaBitQCache uses the estimated attention mass to perform adaptive Top-p retrieval. This is a meaningful design choice because attention sparsity varies widely across layers, heads, and tasks. A fixed k is often either too conservative, wasting compute, or too aggressive, hurting accuracy. Top-p is a better match to heterogeneous attention distributions, but only if the proxy can estimate score magnitudes reasonably well rather than merely preserving order.

Fourth is the systems layer. The paper implements hardware-aware kernels and scheduling, including asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates, to hide the overhead of proxy computation and data movement. This part is important because many sparse or offloading methods save arithmetic on paper but lose the benefit in practice due to gather/scatter overhead and transfer latency.

Relative to methods such as Quest or DS, the differences are clear: finer retrieval granularity, a proxy closer to the true inner product, and support for adaptive Top-p rather than fixed-budget selection.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper evaluates long-context inference acceleration and claims clear gains over prior sparse-attention and KV-offloading baselines. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, but the experimental story is already visible. First, RaBitQCache improves long-context inference efficiency without requiring access to the full KV cache and while keeping model quality largely intact. Second, its advantage comes from more accurate token-importance estimation, which means lower quality loss at the same retrieval budget, or lower budget at similar quality. Third, the systems optimizations appear necessary to convert algorithmic savings into end-to-end latency gains.

When reading the full paper, four experimental blocks deserve attention. One is the correlation or error analysis between the proxy score and the true attention score; that is the foundation of the method. Another is the comparison between Top-k and Top-p retrieval, especially across layers, heads, and tasks with different sparsity patterns. A third is the end-to-end comparison against baselines such as Quest, DS, and static-position retrieval in terms of latency, throughput, and memory or bandwidth usage. A fourth is the ablation over random rotation, binary code length, INT4 quantization, lazy updates, and asynchronous scheduling. The most convincing evidence will likely be an improved accuracy-latency frontier rather than a single speedup number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A 25-35 minute skim should be enough to judge the paper. Start with the introduction's diagnosis of prior dynamic KV retrieval: inaccurate proxies and no error bounds. That framing explains why the paper insists on a theoretically grounded estimator. Then go straight to the method section and read the definition of the proxy score together with the main theorem. Check carefully whether the guarantee applies to the raw query-key inner product, the attention logits, or something after normalization. After that, inspect the systems diagram to see whether asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates are core to the design or just implementation details. Finally, read the main results and ablations with an eye on the accuracy-latency tradeoff, not just isolated speedup numbers.

If time is limited, prioritize three parts: the main theoretical proposition, the Top-p retrieval experiments, and the end-to-end system table. For deeper follow-up, two questions are worth asking: how stable the rotated binary representation is under layer-wise distribution shift, and whether the same proxy machinery could be reused for training-time memory compression or retrieval-augmented attention.

recommendation.zh: KV cache二值量化+自适应Top-p稀疏方案扎实，无偏估计证明与硬件流水线设计，可作为预训练做长上下文兼容设计的直接参考
recommendation.en: Solid KV cache binary quantization + adaptive Top-p sparsity design; the unbiasedness proof and hardware pipeline are directly useful for long-context compatible pretraining.

paper.title: Depth-Staggered Fibonacci Spacing for Sparse Attention: Static Schedules Beat Learned Dilation and Extrapolate Where Dense Attention Fails
paper.abstract: We study sparse self-attention in which each query attends to a dense local window plus a set of Fibonacci-spaced offsets, with a per-layer scalar alpha that compresses or expands the spacing. Across 21 language models trained under one matched recipe (60M parameters, 512 hidden, 16 layers, 426M tokens), we compare four ways of setting alpha across depth: fixed, per-layer learned, a static linear stagger, and a coprime (anti-gridding) reassignment of that stagger, together with a reach-matched p

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体但常被凭经验处理的问题：在静态稀疏注意力里，跨层的稀疏间距应该如何安排。作者把每层的远程注意力偏移写成 Fibonacci 序列乘一个层级缩放系数 α，然后比较四种深度调度：全层固定、每层可学习、线性静态 stagger、以及借鉴 dilated conv anti-gridding 思路的 coprime stagger。核心结论很明确：让 α 在训练中自己学，几乎学不动，也没有带来收益；真正有效的是预先手工设定一个随深度变化的静态调度。换句话说，问题不在于“给模型一个可学习的 spacing 自由度”，而在于“是否显式地让不同层承担不同尺度的感受野”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的启发主要有三点。第一，它给稀疏注意力设计里一个常见但证据不足的假设做了负结果澄清：单层 spacing 参数未必会在语言建模训练中自发形成有意义的层次结构。第二，它说明静态结构先验在小到中等规模训练里仍然很有价值，尤其是在参数和训练 token 都受限时，手工设计的 depth schedule 可能比“让模型自己学”更稳。第三，它把长度外推问题和相对位置分布偏移联系得比较清楚：稀疏模式在 4× 训练长度下比 dense baseline 更稳，不只是因为更省算力，而是因为它避免了 dense+RoPE 在超长长度上遇到的大量训练外相对位置。这一点对长上下文预训练和 attention pattern 设计都有参考意义。不过量级上要克制看待：实验规模只有约 60M 参数、426M tokens，结论更像是结构归纳偏置的受控证据，而不是可直接外推到大模型生产配方的定论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法本身很简洁。每个 query 看到两部分 key：一段局部 dense window，以及一组按 Fibonacci 间距取样的远程位置。Fibonacci 的好处是近处更密、远处近似几何变稀，比 power-of-2 更平滑。为了让 α 可学习，作者没有用硬 mask，而是对非整数偏移位置做线性插值 gather，这样 α 即使落在整数附近也有梯度。α 被约束在 [0.5, 1.5]，因为基础 Fibonacci 序列在 α=1 时已经基本覆盖 1024 长度上下文，额外自由度主要是压缩或轻微扩张感受野。

四种调度里，真正关键的是 staggered linear：16 层从 α=0.5 线性爬升到 1.5，浅层偏局部，深层偏全局。这个设计对应一种很朴素的分工：底层先做短程组合，高层再逐步扩大跨距。coprime stagger 则把同一组 α 值按步长 7 重新分配到层上，目的是打散相邻层的相似采样，避免规则栅格带来的覆盖空洞。作者还做了一个 reach-matched power-of-2 对照，把“Fibonacci 基底更好”与“只是因为覆盖更远或 rung 数不同”区分开。全文最有价值的地方不是提出了复杂新模块，而是把变量控制得很干净：同一 attention 实现、同一训练 recipe、同一 RoPE/GQA/projection，只改稀疏偏移调度，因此能比较可信地把差异归因到 spacing schedule 本身。
summary.experiments:
实验设置相当统一：16 层、d_model=512、8 heads、2 KV heads、head dim 64、序列长 1024、总参数 60.9M，训练 13k steps、总计 426M tokens。数据混合约为 35% FineWeb-Edu、22% Wikipedia、20% TinyStories、23% 数学数据。作者总共训练了 21 个模型，并对局部窗口 W∈{6,8,10,12} 做 sweep。

结果层面，摘要已经给出主排序：static stagger consistently 优于 fixed 和 learned α；而且这种收益不依赖 Fibonacci 基底本身，因为把同样的 stagger 用到 power-of-2 base 上，也能明显抬升性能，超过 fixed Fibonacci，并接近 learned Fibonacci。这个结果很关键，它说明“跨层错开 spacing”是主效应，“Fibonacci 比 power-of-2 更细密”是附加效应。作者还报告 learned α 基本停留在初始化附近，说明单标量层参数在这种训练规模和目标下没有形成有效自组织。

长度外推是另一个重点。模型只在 1024 长度训练，但评测到 4× 长度时，结构化稀疏注意力保持相对稳定，而 recipe-matched dense baseline 明显失效。作者给出的机制解释是：稀疏模式只访问一小组固定相对距离，因此即使绝对长度变长，模型遇到的相对位置仍大多在训练分布内；dense attention 在更长序列上则会暴露大量未见过的远距离相对位置，RoPE 表示和注意力统计都会偏移。还有两个负结果也值得看：一是训练长度内 dense 仍然更强，说明稀疏结构并没有在常规长度上追平 dense；二是 position-resolved 分析显示 stagger 的收益并不只集中在长距离 token，而是较均匀地分布在各位置，这意味着它改善的可能是层间表示组织，而不只是“补长程依赖”。

给定当前截取内容，没有逐表的精确 perplexity 数字可完整复原，但论文的实验叙事已经足够清楚：fixed < learned ≈ 部分基线 < static stagger，且 dense 在训练长度内最好、在外推长度上最差。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一看方法部分对 interpolated gather 的说明，理解为什么 learned α 有梯度却仍学不动，这关系到负结果是否可信。第二看主结果表和 window sweep，重点不是某个窗口最优，而是排序在不同 W 下是否稳定。第三看长度外推章节，尤其是作者如何把 dense 崩溃归因到 out-of-distribution relative positions，而不是简单的数值不稳。

如果时间有限，建议按这个顺序读：Introduction 的贡献声明 → Method 中四种 α schedule 定义 → 主实验结果 → extrapolation 分析 → 负结果讨论。预计 20-30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 learned α 为什么几乎不动，究竟是优化信号太弱、参数化范围太窄，还是单标量控制力不足；二是 static stagger 的收益能否迁移到更大模型、更长训练、或 MoE/多头异构 spacing 设定。论文没有把这两点做透，但它把问题框得很清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important design question in sparse self-attention: how should attention spacing vary across depth? Each layer uses a dense local window plus long-range offsets from a Fibonacci sequence scaled by a layer-wise factor α. The authors compare four depth schedules for α: fixed, learned per layer, static linear staggering, and a coprime reassignment inspired by anti-gridding in dilated convolutions. The central result is simple: learned α barely moves from initialization and does not help, while a hand-designed static depth schedule consistently improves language modeling quality. The real issue is not whether the model can learn spacing, but whether different layers are explicitly assigned different receptive-field scales.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the paper is useful in three ways. First, it provides a clean negative result against a common intuition: giving sparse attention a learnable spacing parameter does not automatically produce meaningful depth specialization. Second, it shows that static structural priors still matter in small-to-mid-scale language modeling. When model size and token budget are limited, a carefully chosen depth schedule can outperform a more flexible learned variant. Third, it offers a concrete explanation for length extrapolation behavior: structured sparse attention is more robust at 4× training length because it avoids exposing the model to a large mass of unseen relative positions, which dense attention with RoPE does encounter. That mechanism is relevant to long-context pretraining and attention pattern design. The scope should still be read carefully: the experiments are only at roughly 60M parameters and 426M training tokens, so the contribution is controlled evidence about inductive bias rather than a production-ready recipe for frontier-scale models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is intentionally simple. Each query attends to two sets of keys: a local dense window and a set of long-range positions sampled at Fibonacci-spaced offsets. Fibonacci spacing gives denser coverage at short range and progressively sparser coverage at long range, which is smoother than power-of-2 spacing. To make α learnable, the paper avoids a hard boolean mask and instead gathers key/value rows at fractional offsets using linear interpolation. That preserves gradients to α even when offsets land near integers. α is constrained to [0.5, 1.5], since the base Fibonacci ladder already spans the 1024-token context at α=1.

The most important schedule is the static linear stagger: α increases from 0.5 in the first layer to 1.5 in the last layer across 16 layers. This encodes a simple division of labor, with lower layers focusing on local composition and upper layers expanding the receptive field. The coprime stagger uses the same set of α values but permutes them across layers with stride 7, aiming to reduce regular coverage holes by making adjacent layers maximally different. The paper also includes a reach-matched power-of-2 control to separate the effect of the Fibonacci base from the effect of depth staggering itself. A strong point of the study is experimental control: same attention implementation, same projections, same RoPE and GQA setup, same training recipe, and only the spacing schedule changes. That makes the attribution to depth scheduling much more credible than many sparse-attention comparisons.
summary_en.experiments:
All runs use the same small LM recipe: 16 layers, d_model=512, 8 attention heads, 2 KV heads, head dimension 64, sequence length 1024, tied embeddings, and 60.9M total parameters. Training lasts 13k steps for 426M tokens. The data mix is about 35% FineWeb-Edu, 22% Wikipedia, 20% TinyStories, and 23% math data. In total the paper trains 21 models and sweeps local window sizes W in {6, 8, 10, 12}.

The main empirical ordering is the key takeaway: static staggering beats both fixed and learned α, and this gain is base-agnostic. Applying the same stagger to a power-of-2 base lifts it above fixed Fibonacci and roughly to parity with learned Fibonacci. That means depth staggering is the dominant effect, while the Fibonacci base adds a separate but smaller benefit. Another important result is that learned α stays close to initialization, which supports the claim that the negative result is not due to poor reporting but to weak or ineffective optimization of the spacing parameter itself.

Length extrapolation is the other major result. Models are trained at length 1024 and evaluated up to 4× that length. Structured sparse attention remains comparatively robust, while the recipe-matched dense baseline degrades sharply. The paper explains this through relative-position distribution shift: sparse attention only uses a fixed set of relative distances, so longer sequences do not introduce many unseen relative positions; dense attention does, and RoPE-based representations then operate further out of distribution. Two negative findings are also worth noting. Dense attention still wins at the training length, so sparse structure does not close the in-distribution quality gap. And the position-resolved analysis shows that the gain from staggering is fairly uniform across positions rather than concentrated only at long-range tokens, suggesting that the benefit is about better layerwise organization, not merely stronger long-distance access.

The excerpt provided here does not include every table value, so exact perplexity numbers cannot be reconstructed fully. Still, the experimental story is clear: fixed is worst, learned does not justify its extra flexibility, static stagger is the strongest sparse variant, and dense is best in-distribution but weakest under long-length extrapolation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the method section on interpolated gather so you can judge whether the learned-α negative result is meaningful rather than an artifact of zero gradients. Second, inspect the main result tables and the window-size sweep; the important point is not which window is best, but whether the ranking is stable across W. Third, read the extrapolation section carefully, especially the argument that dense attention fails because of out-of-distribution relative positions rather than generic numerical instability.

A good reading order is: contribution claims in the introduction, the four α schedules in the method section, the main comparison results, the extrapolation analysis, and finally the discussion of negative results. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. The two deeper questions left open are also the most interesting ones: why learned α barely moves, and whether static staggering still helps at larger scale, longer training, or with richer heterogeneity such as head-wise schedules or MoE-style specialization.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式级工作，但它明确提示“学 dilation”未必值回推理成本；只看静态 stagger 对 learned alpha 的对照和长外推结果，就足够决定要不要在内部 recipe 里加这条线。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it cleanly suggests learned dilation may not justify its inference cost; the static-vs-learned ablation plus long-context extrapolation is enough to decide whether to add this line to internal recipes.

paper.title: Predict, Reuse, and Repair: Accelerating Dynamic Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Decoding
paper.abstract: Dynamic sparse attention (DSA) accelerates long-context LLM decoding by attending to only the top-K KV blocks relevant to each query, but it introduces a serialized selection-to-attention dependency that emerges as a new latency bottleneck. We present PRR, a speculate-reuse-repair runtime that exploits temporal locality in DSA selections to predict likely blocks, speculate the attention over them while selection is in flight, and incrementally repair missed blocks once the true selected set is k

summary.core_problem: 动态稀疏注意力（DSA）通过每个解码步仅选择与当前query最相关的top-K个KV块进行计算，有效降低了长上下文LLM解码的注意力算术开销，但引入了块选择与注意力计算之间的严格串行依赖：选择阶段必须完成后才能启动注意力计算，在长上下文场景下选择延迟最高可占单token生成延迟的41%，成为新的关键路径瓶颈；现有推理引擎和注意力核不支持增量合并部分计算结果，无法通过投机执行隐藏该延迟同时保证结果与原生DSA一致。
summary.importance: 这是针对动态稀疏长上下文注意力方案固有工程开销的实用runtime优化，不需要修改模型权重、不改变注意力语义即可带来端到端解码加速，对长上下文模型部署有直接参考价值；属于推理系统类工作，对预训练方法论的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PRR（预测-复用-修复）三阶段投机执行框架：1）预测阶段采用轻量EMA预测器跟踪每个KV块重要性分数的时间轨迹，提前预判当前步大概率被选中的块集，预测器的平滑超参在prefill阶段利用已计算的重要性分数校准，几乎无额外开销；2）复用阶段通过profiling得到的动态预算控制预测块集大小，保证对预测块的投机注意力计算与块选择阶段并行执行，且不会占用关键路径、延迟后续FFN阶段；3）修复阶段基于FlashAttention的online softmax递推逻辑实现自定义CUDA核，待真实top-K块集返回后，仅计算漏掉的块的注意力贡献，直接合并到已有的部分注意力结果中，预测集内不属于真实top-K的块不会引入错误，最终输出与原生DSA数学等价，无精度损失。
summary.experiments: 在GLM-4-9B等模型上，基于LongBench、InfiniteBench、RULER、AIME、MATH500等长上下文与推理基准测试，PRR相对主流DSA实现Quest、InfLLM-v2分别带来1.42倍、1.56倍的单token解码加速，下游任务精度与原生DSA完全一致；实测显示连续解码步之间平均68%的选中KV块会被复用，为投机机制提供了足够的时间局部性基础。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第2章的DSA瓶颈拆解与实测数据，以及增量修复核的online softmax设计思路，不需要深挖CUDA kernel实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Dynamic sparse attention (DSA) reduces long-context LLM decoding compute by attending only to the top-K KV blocks relevant to each query, but introduces a strict serialization dependency between block selection and attention computation. Selection must complete before attention can start, accounting for up to 41% of per-token generation latency in long-context scenarios, forming a new critical-path bottleneck. Existing inference engines and attention kernels do not support incremental merging of partial attention results, making it impossible to hide this latency via speculation while preserving exact DSA semantics.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical runtime optimization addressing fixed engineering overhead common to all production DSA implementations for long-context serving. It delivers end-to-end speedups without modifying model weights or changing attention behavior, with direct applicability to long-context deployment. It is primarily an inference systems contribution, with limited direct implications for pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRR implements a three-stage predict-reuse-repair speculative execution pipeline: 1) Predict: A lightweight EMA-based predictor tracks temporal trajectories of per-block importance scores to forecast the upcoming top-K block set, with smoothing hyperparameters calibrated during prefill using already computed importance scores at near-zero overhead. 2) Reuse: A profiling-guided dynamic budget controls the size of the predicted block set, ensuring speculative attention over predicted blocks runs in parallel with selection, without delaying the subsequent FFN stage. 3) Repair: A custom CUDA kernel built on FlashAttention's online softmax recurrence incrementally computes attention contributions from missed blocks once the true top-K set is available, merging results directly into the partial speculative attention state. Blocks in the predicted set but not the true top-K do not introduce errors, and the final output is mathematically equivalent to vanilla DSA with zero accuracy loss.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on GLM-4-9B and other models across LongBench, InfiniteBench, RULER, AIME, and MATH500, PRR delivers 1.42x per-token speedup over Quest and 1.56x over InfLLM-v2, while preserving exact downstream task accuracy relative to base DSA implementations. Measurements show 68% of selected blocks are reused across consecutive decoding steps, providing sufficient temporal locality for the speculation mechanism to be effective.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the DSA bottleneck characterization in Section 2 and the incremental repair kernel design. Skip low-level CUDA implementation details unless working directly on DSA inference systems. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对长上下文稀疏注意力的系统级优化，推测+修复的思路很漂亮，做长文本推理加速的同学值得一看。
recommendation.en: System-level optimization for long-context sparse attention; the speculate-and-repair approach is elegant, worth reading for those working on long-context inference acceleration.

paper.title: MATCH: Modulating Attention via In-Context Retrieval for Long-Context Transformers
paper.abstract: The quadratic computational cost of traditional attention mechanisms poses a major bottleneck to the scalability and practical deployment of large language models (LLMs), particularly in long-context scenarios. To improve efficiency, existing approaches often enforce rigid structural constraints such as local attention windows. However, these strategies typically lead to substantial performance degradation on tasks requiring precise long-range recall. In this work, we propose MATCH, a scalable a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的一个老问题：稀疏注意力把复杂度和 KV cache 压下来了，但代价是远距离精确召回能力明显变差，尤其在需要从很早位置找准证据的任务上。论文要解决的不是再设计一种固定稀疏模式，而是让稀疏模型在保持线性或次线性开销的同时，按当前上下文动态补回那些真正重要的远端 token 位置。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在两点。第一，它把“长上下文效率”和“长程精确召回”拆成两个模块：主干仍用稀疏注意力保证吞吐，外部检索器负责跨长距离找信息。这种分工比单纯扩大窗口或做更复杂的稀疏模板更接近工程上可落地的路线。第二，它提示一个值得继续追的方向：长上下文能力未必只能靠更强的原生注意力结构，也可以靠检索式辅助模块在推理时补足。对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，因为方法更偏 inference-time architecture augmentation，而不是训练范式或数据配方的改变。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MATCH：在稀疏注意力模型之外接一个外部 retriever，用它从整段上下文中挑出对当前 token 生成最有帮助的远端位置，再把这些位置对应的信息并入注意力计算。论文的出发点很明确：固定局部窗口的问题不在于“看得少”，而在于“看不到该看的远处 token”；因此需要一个上下文相关、按输入动态变化的选择机制。

从全文描述看，MATCH 包含两部分。第一部分是 retrieval-enhancing encoder / retriever。它以较低成本编码整段上下文，形成可检索表示，用来为当前查询位置返回一小组候选 token 位置。第二部分是 retrieval-enhanced attention。原始稀疏注意力仍保留局部窗口或已有稀疏结构，额外再把检索到的远端 token 作为补充 key/value 参与注意力。这样做不是替换稀疏注意力，而是在其上增加一条“远程跳连”。

它和已有方法的差别主要有三点。其一，不像 sliding window 那样用固定模式假设重要信息大多在邻域内；MATCH 允许跨任意距离访问。其二，不同于很多 post-sparsification / KV eviction 方法只是在已有 full-attention 模型上删 token，它主动引入一个检索器来恢复被稀疏化损失掉的 recall。其三，它强调 context-dependent sparsity：真正重要的远端依赖随输入变化，因此检索目标也必须动态变化，而不是预先写死规则。

从研究味道上看，这更像“给稀疏 Transformer 加一个轻量 RAG-in-context 通道”，但检索对象不是外部知识库，而是当前 prompt 内部的历史 token。这个设定很适合长上下文 ICL、needle-style recall 和文档问答场景。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验结论是：MATCH 在合成 ICL 任务和真实长上下文 benchmark 上，都能显著改善稀疏注意力模型的表现，同时保持更好的效率。摘要和引言没有给出完整数字表，但实验设计的重点比较清楚：

1. 对比对象包括 full attention、原始 sparse attention，以及加入 MATCH 后的 sparse model。
2. 任务覆盖 synthetic recall / ICL 和 real-world long-context understanding，目标是看远距离信息检索是否恢复，而不是只看短上下文 perplexity。
3. 论文还专门分析 throughput 和 memory footprint，说明作者把它当成效率-性能折中方案，而不是单纯追求精度。

从可推断的结果结构看，MATCH 的收益应主要集中在需要精确定位远端证据的位置敏感任务；对局部模式占主导的任务，提升不会同样明显。另一个值得注意的点是，它的额外开销来自 retriever 编码和检索步骤，因此最终收益取决于：检索到的 token 数量是否足够小、检索命中率是否足够高、以及是否能在 prefilling 阶段高效完成。若这些条件成立，MATCH 相比直接扩大窗口会更划算。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。

第一，看方法总览图和 retrieval-enhanced attention 的公式，弄清楚检索到的位置是怎样并入原 attention 的。重点不是实现细节，而是它到底补的是 key/value、attention mask，还是额外分支。

第二，看 retriever 的构造。要确认它是预训练外部编码器、共享主干表示、还是单独训练的模块；还要看检索粒度是 token-level、chunk-level 还是 block-level。这决定了方法能否扩展到更长上下文。

第三，看效率表和长程 recall benchmark。只要这两部分站不住，这类方法就容易退化成“多加一个模块换一点分数”。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想判断是否值得继续跟，可以重点看 introduction、method overview、主结果表，以及 throughput/memory 分析。若后续要做相关工作，再细读检索器训练方式和消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of sparse long-context Transformers: they reduce compute and KV-cache cost, but they lose precise long-range recall. The goal is not to design yet another fixed sparsity pattern, but to let a sparse model recover the few truly relevant distant tokens on demand, without going back to full quadratic attention.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mostly architectural and practical rather than foundational for pretraining. The paper separates long-context modeling into two roles: sparse attention handles efficient local token mixing, while an external retriever restores global recall. That decomposition is useful for anyone working on long-context serving or sparse pretraining recipes. It also suggests a broader lesson: some long-context deficits may be better treated as retrieval failures than as pure attention-design failures. The direct impact on pretraining methodology is limited, since the contribution is closer to inference-time augmentation than to a new training objective or data recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MATCH augments a sparse-attention backbone with an external in-context retriever. The retriever scans or encodes the full prompt efficiently, identifies token positions that are likely useful for the current prediction, and passes those positions back to the Transformer. The attention layer then combines its usual sparse local context with a small set of retrieved distant tokens.

The design choice is motivated by a simple observation: fixed sparse patterns fail not because they see too few tokens in total, but because they cannot adaptively jump to the right distant evidence. MATCH therefore keeps the efficiency of sparse attention while adding a dynamic access path to arbitrary positions in the sequence.

From the full text, the method has two main components. First, a retrieval-enhancing encoder / retriever builds searchable representations over the whole context. Second, a retrieval-enhanced attention mechanism injects the retrieved positions into the sparse attention computation, effectively adding remote key/value access on top of the local sparse pattern.

Compared with standard sliding-window attention, MATCH is input-dependent rather than pattern-fixed. Compared with post-hoc KV eviction methods, it does not only prune memory; it actively restores missing recall through retrieval. Compared with full attention, it aims to preserve most of the recall benefit using a much smaller set of selected remote tokens.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports consistent gains over sparse-attention baselines on both synthetic in-context learning tasks and real long-context benchmarks, while retaining favorable efficiency characteristics. The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, but the experimental structure is clear:

1. Baselines include full attention, sparse attention, and sparse attention plus MATCH.
2. Tasks are chosen to stress exact long-range retrieval rather than only local language modeling quality.
3. The evaluation includes throughput and memory footprint, which is important because the method adds a retriever and could otherwise hide its cost.

The likely pattern of gains is that MATCH helps most on tasks where success depends on locating a specific distant span or token. On tasks dominated by local context, the benefit should be smaller. The practical trade-off depends on whether the retriever can keep the number of fetched tokens small while maintaining high recall.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, inspect the architecture figure and the retrieval-enhanced attention equations. The key question is how retrieved positions are injected into attention.

Second, read the retriever section carefully. Check whether retrieval is token-level or chunk-level, whether the retriever is pretrained separately, and how it scales with context length.

Third, look at the efficiency tables together with the long-range recall benchmarks. Without a convincing efficiency-recall trade-off, this class of methods is much less interesting.

A 20–30 minute skim is enough to judge relevance. If it looks promising for your work, then go back to the retriever training details and ablations.

recommendation.zh: 思路朴素（稀疏注意力+检索补全），属于增量工程，建议只看方法一节和长程召回表格即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental engineering—sparse attention plus retrieval backstop; read the method section and the long-range recall table, skip the rest.

paper.title: SpotAttention: Plug-In Block-Sparse Routing for Pretrained Long-Context Transformers
paper.abstract: Long contexts have become standard in pretrained LLMs, yet they remain expensive to run: prefill compute grows quadratically with sequence length, and every decode step re-reads a key-value cache that grows linearly with it. Sparse attention cuts these costs by attending only to a relevant subset of past tokens, but selecting that subset is itself expensive. We present SpotAttention, a lightweight selector that attaches to a frozen pretrained transformer and learns by KL distillation to estimate

summary.core_problem: 现有预训练长上下文LLM的稀疏注意力方案存在选择器计算开销高、无法即插即用适配已训练完成的主模型的问题。
summary.importance: 验证了无需修改预训练主模型结构、仅通过外挂轻量选择器加KL蒸馏即可实现高效稀疏注意力，为长上下文模型的推理优化提供了与预训练解耦的可行路径，也揭示了不同层注意力预算存在不对称性这一训练动态特征。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计即插即用的块级稀疏选择器，挂载在已冻结的预训练Transformer每一层全注意力层上，仅通过KL散度蒸馏匹配原模型的头平均注意力分布，无需重新训练主模型；2. 选择器采用块级Q-K评分（按查询块×键块而非逐token计算），可直接通过张量核矩阵乘实现，降低选择开销；3. 提出双top-p规则，直接从选择器输出的校准注意力分布中为每个查询、每层动态分配注意力预算，同时预留sink和近邻块避免被核采样过滤，无需额外剪枝阶段；4. 支持对选择器的K缓存做INT4/FP4量化进一步降低内存开销。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3（稠密注意力，4B-32B）和Qwen3.5（混合线性/全注意力，4B-9B）共7个backbone上完成选择器训练，其中5个完成完整验证；128K上下文解码场景下，Qwen3-8B的吞吐量是FlashAttention的3.9倍、是Twilight的1.8倍；选择器K缓存量化到INT4/FP4可缩小3.5倍体积且保持BF16级精度；在最长128K上下文下性能与稠密注意力持平；观测到不同层的注意力预算存在显著不对称性，静态top-K规则无法匹配该特征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节方法部分的双top-p规则设计、第4节的长上下文吞吐量与精度对比实验，附录中的选择器结构与训练策略消融实验；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing sparse attention solutions for pretrained long-context LLMs face two core bottlenecks: high computation overhead of the token selector, and lack of plug-and-play compatibility with fully trained backbone models.
summary_en.importance: Validates that efficient sparse attention can be achieved without modifying pretrained backbone architecture, via a lightweight add-on selector trained with KL distillation. This provides a pretraining-decoupled path for long-context inference optimization, and reveals notable inter-layer attention budget asymmetry as a previously underdiscussed training dynamic.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A plug-in block-wise sparse selector is attached to each frozen full-attention layer of a pretrained Transformer, trained only via KL divergence to match the backbone's head-averaged attention distribution, with no retraining of the main model. 2. Block-wise Q-K scoring (per query-block × key-block tile instead of per-token) runs as a single tensor-core matrix multiplication, cutting selector overhead sharply. 3. A dual top-p rule directly allocates per-query, per-layer attention budgets from the selector's calibrated output distribution, with reserved sink and recency blocks to avoid exclusion by nucleus sampling and no separate pruning stage. 4. INT4/FP4 quantization of the selector's K-cache is supported for further memory reduction.
summary_en.experiments: Selector training completed on 7 backbones across two architecture families: Qwen3 (dense attention, 4B–32B) and Qwen3.5 (hybrid linear/full attention, 4B–9B), with full validation on 5 of them. For Qwen3-8B at 128K context decode, throughput reaches 3.9× FlashAttention and 1.8× Twilight. Quantizing the selector's K-cache to INT4/FP4 reduces its size by 3.5× while retaining BF16-level accuracy. Performance matches dense attention at contexts up to 128K; significant inter-layer attention budget asymmetry is observed, which static top-K rules cannot match.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (dual top-p rule design in the method pipeline), Section 4 (long-context throughput and accuracy comparison experiments), and ablation studies on selector structure and training strategy in the appendix; estimated reading time 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §方法和长外推实验；若 128K 上真能稳住精度，内部长上下文服务应复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and length-extrapolation experiments; if 128K accuracy holds, this deserves an internal serving reproduction.

paper.title: Training-free sparse attention based on cumulative energy filtering
paper.abstract: Sparse attention accelerates Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for video generation by computing only the important tokens while skipping the rest. The token selection strategy is key to balancing sparsity and accuracy. We formulate the token filtering process as a dual-goal optimization problem: maximizing sparsity and minimizing accuracy degradation. Existing algorithms cannot fulfill both objectives simultaneously. For example, Top-p only considers the accuracy constraint, while Top-k maintains a

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成 Diffusion Transformer 推理中稠密 attention 成本高、现有稀疏 token 选择难以同时保证精度和计算节省的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理加速方法，面向 DiT 视频生成的 sparse attention；和 LLM 预训练不是同一主线，但对长序列 attention 稀疏化和 FlashAttention 集成有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 token filtering 表述为同时最大化稀疏率、最小化精度损失的双目标问题；论文主张固定 recall rate 足以约束精度，而固定阈值会浪费计算，因此提出动态阈值策略，并和 FlashAttention 深度集成，避免额外 mask 计算开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频生成模型、分辨率、token 数、速度提升或质量指标；作者声称在相同精度水平下提高稀疏率，并通过 FlashAttention 集成消除额外 masking overhead。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduces the cost of dense attention in video-generation Diffusion Transformers, where existing sparse token-selection rules struggle to preserve quality while saving compute.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference acceleration method for DiT video generation. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but the sparse-attention criterion and FlashAttention integration are useful engineering signals for long-sequence systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates token filtering as a dual-objective problem: maximize sparsity while minimizing accuracy degradation. It argues that a fixed recall rate is enough to preserve accuracy, whereas a fixed threshold is compute-inefficient, then introduces dynamic thresholding integrated tightly with FlashAttention to avoid extra masking overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the exact video model, resolution, token count, speedup, or quality metrics. It claims higher sparsity at the same accuracy level and no additional masking overhead due to FlashAttention integration.

recommendation.zh: 只看动态阈值和 FA 集成细节即可；结论若成立，可作为长序列 attention 裁剪的弱工程信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the dynamic-thresholding and FlashAttention integration details; if the claim holds, it is a weak but useful signal for long-sequence attention pruning.

paper.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Ultra-long-context capability is becoming indispensable for frontier LLMs: agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory all require the model to jointly attend over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, yet the quadratic cost of softmax attention makes this untenable at deployment scale. We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and inde

summary.core_problem: 在数十万到百万 token 长上下文推理中，标准 softmax attention 的二次复杂度让部署成本难以承受。
summary.importance: 这是来自 MiniMax 的长上下文稀疏注意力系统性工作，贡献在注意力结构与 GPU 执行路径的联合设计。对预训练研究员的价值不只是推理加速，还在于它会反过来影响长上下文预训练时该保留什么注意力归纳偏置。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MiniMax Sparse Attention。它基于 GQA 做 blockwise sparse attention：轻量 Index Branch 对 KV block 打分，并为每个 GQA group 独立选择 Top-k block；Main Branch 只在被选中的 block 上做精确 block-sparse attention。方法刻意保持结构简单，便于跨 GPU 部署，并配套设计执行路径，把稀疏性转化为实际速度收益。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调面向 agent workflow、仓库级代码推理和持久记忆等超长上下文场景，并提到通过 GPU co-design 获得实际加速。给出的片段未包含模型规模、上下文长度、训练方式、质量损失、吞吐或延迟数字，需要重点查看实验表和 kernel 细节。
summary.authors_note: MiniMax 团队工作；作者列表包括 Xunhao Lai、Weiqi Xu、Yufeng Yang、Qiaorui Chen、Yang Xu、Lunbin Zeng、Xiaolong Li、Haohai Sun、Haichao Zhu、Vito Zhang 等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the deployment cost of standard quadratic softmax attention for hundreds-of-thousands to million-token contexts.
summary_en.importance: This is a MiniMax long-context sparse-attention system paper. Its contribution is the joint design of an attention pattern and a GPU execution path. For pretraining researchers, the key issue is not only faster inference, but also what long-context inductive bias should be trained into future base models.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiniMax Sparse Attention builds blockwise sparse attention on top of GQA. A lightweight Index Branch scores KV blocks and independently selects Top-k blocks for each GQA group. The Main Branch then performs exact block-sparse attention only over the selected blocks. The design emphasizes simplicity and GPU portability, with a dedicated execution path to turn sparsity into real speedups.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory over ultra-long contexts, and claims practical acceleration through GPU co-design. The provided text does not include model scale, context length, training setup, quality drop, throughput, or latency numbers; those tables are the parts to inspect.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from MiniMax. The listed authors include Xunhao Lai, Weiqi Xu, Yufeng Yang, Qiaorui Chen, Yang Xu, Lunbin Zeng, Xiaolong Li, Haohai Sun, Haichao Zhu, and Vito Zhang.

recommendation.zh: 必须看实验和 kernel 设计；若质量损失小，应立刻复现 group-specific block selection 的长上下文 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the experiments and kernel design; if quality loss is small, reproduce the group-specific block-selection ablation for long-context training and serving.

paper.title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) re-encode the entire prefix at every denoising step, causing recomputation that scales   quadratically with context length and becomes prohibitive for long-context scenarios. We propose Prefilling-dLLM, a training-free   prefill-decode disaggregation framework for dLLMs that partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches their KV representations once,   and selects the top-K most relevant chunks with intra-chunk token sparsity for decoding, showing that spars

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion language model 在长上下文推理时每个去噪步都要重编码整段前缀、导致计算随上下文长度急剧膨胀的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇对 dLLM 很相关，因为它抓住了 diffusion LM 与 AR LM 在推理路径上的核心差异：dLLM 没有天然的 KV-cache 复用。贡献类型是训练无关的推理系统/算法改进，不改模型本体，但直接影响 dLLM 是否能进入长上下文可用区间。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prefilling-dLLM，一个 training-free 的 prefill-decode disaggregation 框架。方法把前缀切成 N 个 chunk，只缓存一次各 chunk 的 KV 表示；解码时只选 top-K 相关 chunk，并在 chunk 内再做 token sparsity，从而把每步复杂度从依赖完整上下文的二次复杂度，降到主要依赖 decode length 的复杂度。另一个关键点是为非连续缓存 chunk KV 设计并行 attention kernel。作者还观察到给每个 chunk prepend BOS token 有助于稳定检索和质量。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 和 InfiniteBench 上评测，摘要称在 dLLM 加速方法中达到当前最优质量，并在 8K 到 32K 上下文下获得 9.1x 到 28.0x 的速度提升。机构包含港大、密歇根和 LMSYS，说明工作更偏系统与评测结合。摘要未给出具体 dLLM 基座、参数规模和与 dense baseline 的精确质量差距，但从问题设定看是 dLLM 长上下文推理里较实用的一步。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括香港大学、密歇根大学安娜堡分校和 LMSYS。LMSYS 在推理系统、评测和开源 serving 生态上有持续影响力。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the long-context inference bottleneck in diffusion LMs, where the full prefix is re-encoded at every denoising step and cost explodes with context length.
summary_en.importance: This is quite relevant for dLLMs because it targets a core inference-path weakness relative to autoregressive LMs: dLLMs do not naturally inherit efficient KV-cache reuse. The contribution is a training-free inference/system method rather than a new model, but it directly affects whether dLLMs are practical in long-context settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prefilling-dLLM is a training-free prefill-decode disaggregation framework. It partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches each chunk's KV once, then selects top-K relevant chunks during decoding and applies intra-chunk token sparsity. This reduces per-step complexity from being quadratic in the full context to being quadratic mainly in the decode length. The paper also introduces an attention kernel that can decode over non-contiguously cached chunk KVs in parallel. An additional empirical trick is prepending BOS tokens to each chunk to stabilize retrieval and quality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on LongBench and InfiniteBench, reporting state-of-the-art quality among dLLM acceleration methods and 9.1x-28.0x speedups at 8K-32K contexts. The institutions include HKU, University of Michigan, and LMSYS, suggesting a systems-oriented effort. The abstract does not specify the exact dLLM backbone, parameter scale, or dense-baseline quality deltas, but the setup is clearly relevant to practical long-context dLLM serving.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include The University of Hong Kong, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, and LMSYS. LMSYS has a strong track record in inference systems, evaluation, and open serving infrastructure.

recommendation.zh: 做 dLLM 的人该看，尤其是 sparse prefilling 竟能赢 dense attention 这一点；先盯复杂度分析、chunk 检索策略和 BOS trick，别急着把结论外推到所有生成范式。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about dLLMs: the interesting part is that sparse prefilling can beat dense attention; focus on the complexity argument, chunk retrieval, and the BOS trick before generalizing the result.

paper.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Kwai Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed to advance long-video understanding and agentic intelligence. To address the challenges of ultra-long contexts, information redundancy, and prohibitive computational costs inherent in hour-level videos, Keye-VL-2.0 is the first to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, enabling lossless 256K context processing while capturing critical frames an

summary.core_problem: 论文从短视频理解扩展到长视频理解和 Agent 能力时遇到两个核心瓶颈：(1) 小时级视频的 256K 超长上下文导致 KV cache 爆炸式增长和计算墙，现有模型被迫通过大幅帧采样牺牲时间连续性；(2) 多模态对齐与工具使用能力的联合训练会引发灾难性遗忘，导致基础 STEM / 数学 / 语言推理能力退化。
summary.importance: 这是首个将 DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) 适配到 GQA 多模态架构的工作，证明稀疏注意力可以无损处理 256K 视频上下文；提出的 Cross-Modal MOPD 蒸馏方案有效解决了多模态与基础推理能力的模态冲突。对长视频 VLM 预训练和多模态 MoE 具有参考价值。30B MoE 仅 3B 激活参数，部署效率高，是开源社区有竞争力的长视频 VLM 方案。
summary.technical_approach: 模型为 30B 参数 MoE 多模态基座（仅 3B 激活参数），基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking LLM + Keye-VL-1.5 ViT。核心创新两点：(1) Multimodal DSA：将 DeepSeek V3 的稀疏注意力扩展到视觉领域，与 GQA 兼容，结合全局 MQA 索引和分组 GQA 聚合，通过压缩和稀疏化视频特征聚合约束 KV cache 线性增长，实现 256K 无损上下文；(2) Cross-Modal MOPD（Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation）：采用多教师模型在策略滚动中对不同模态和任务的学生生成轨迹提供逐 token 稠密反馈，隔离任务特有知识再蒸馏回统一 MoE 骨干，避免端到端联合优化的不稳定性。后续进一步用 Context-RL 和 Video-RL（带桶优势缩放）稳定长序列决策树并减少视觉幻觉。训练基础设施包括可扩展视频 I/O、异构 ViT-LM 并行、定制 DSA 内核。
summary.experiments: 在 TimeLens benchmark（ActivityNet、QVHighlights、Charades）的细粒度时间定位上取得顶级成绩，在多个时间定位设置上显著超过 Gemini-3-Flash；在 Video-MME-v2 和 LongVideoBench 等超长上下文评测上表现出非线性能力提升，证明处理大量时序信息的鲁棒性。同时在 Code / Tool Use / Web Search 等原生 Agent 能力上大幅提升，而基础推理基线保持完好。
summary.reading_guide: 精读 Introduction 中关于 DSA 适配到视觉模态的动机分析（为什么标准注意力在长视频中失效）和 MOPD 解决灾难性遗忘的思路；Architecture 章节的 GQA-compatible DSA 设计细节（全局 MQA 索引 + 分组 GQA 聚合）是核心创新；Training 和 Post-training 章节的 MOPD 动态路由机制和 Context-RL / Video-RL 的桶优势缩放值得关注；图 1 的整体性能对比。大约 30-45 分钟精读技术核心。
summary.authors_note: 快手 Kuaishou Keye-VL 团队（Kwai），继 Keye-VL 和 Keye-VL-1.5 之后的迭代工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Two core bottlenecks emerge when scaling from short-video to long-video understanding and agentic capabilities: (1) 256K extreme context from hour-long videos causes catastrophic KV cache expansion and computational walls, forcing existing models to sacrifice temporal continuity via aggressive frame subsampling; (2) joint training of multimodal alignment and tool-use capabilities induces catastrophic forgetting, degrading foundational STEM, mathematical, and linguistic reasoning.
summary_en.importance: First work to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, demonstrating that sparse attention enables lossless 256K video context processing. The proposed Cross-Modal MOPD effectively resolves the modality conflict between multimodal skills and base reasoning. Valuable reference for long-video VLM pretraining and multimodal MoE design. With 30B total params and only 3B active, it offers strong deployment efficiency and is a competitive open-source long-video VLM.
summary_en.technical_approach: 30B-parameter MoE multimodal foundation (3B active), built on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking LLM + Keye-VL-1.5 ViT. Two core innovations: (1) Multimodal DSA: extends DeepSeek V3 sparse attention to the visual domain, GQA-compatible, combining global MQA-based indexing with grouped GQA aggregation; compresses and sparsifies video feature aggregation to bound linear KV cache growth, enabling lossless 256K context. (2) Cross-Modal MOPD (Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation): uses specialized teacher models to provide dense token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories across modalities and tasks during on-policy rollouts; isolates task-specific expertise then distills it back into the unified MoE backbone, avoiding instability of end-to-end co-optimization. Post-training further applies Context-RL and Video-RL with bucket advantage scaling to stabilize long-sequence decision trees and reduce visual hallucinations. Infrastructure includes scalable video I/O, heterogeneous ViT-LM parallelism, and custom DSA kernels.
summary_en.experiments: Top-tier results on TimeLens benchmarks (ActivityNet, QVHighlights, Charades) for fine-grained temporal localization, substantially outperforming Gemini-3-Flash on several temporal grounding settings. Non-linear capability scale-up on Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench, demonstrating robustness for extensive temporal information. Simultaneously achieves large gains on native agent capabilities (Code, Tool Use, Web Search) while preserving general-purpose reasoning baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Introduction for the motivation on why standard attention fails in long video and how MOPD addresses catastrophic forgetting. The Architecture section on GQA-compatible DSA design (global MQA indexing + grouped GQA aggregation) is the core innovation. Pay close attention to the MOPD dynamic routing mechanism and bucket advantage scaling in Context-RL / Video-RL under the Training and Post-training sections. Study Figure 1 for the overall performance landscape. Estimated 30-45 min for a deep technical read.
summary_en.authors_note: Kuaishou Keye-VL team (Kwai). Iterative work following Keye-VL and Keye-VL-1.5.

recommendation.zh: DSA 稀疏注意力适配到 GQA 多模态 + 256K 长视频 + MOPD 对齐这一组合值得立刻跟进，重点看 DSA kernel 与多教师 on-policy 蒸馏如何缓解遗忘。
recommendation.en: The combination of DSA sparse attention on GQA multimodal, 256K long-video support, and MOPD alignment is worth immediate follow-up—focus on the DSA kernel details and how multi-teacher on-policy distillation mitigates forgetting.

paper.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing a severe GPU memory bottleneck for ultra-long context serving. In this report, we propose Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA), a novel inference paradigm powered by a Neural Memory Indexer built upon the DeepSeek-V4 architecture. Rather than passively attending to all historical tokens, LSA proactively predicts future context demands and preserves only the query-critical KV chunks in the GPU memory. Crucially, we instantiate t

summary.core_problem: 传统LLM解码时需加载全部KV cache，超长上下文推理时GPU内存瓶颈严重。
summary.importance: 范式级创新：提出Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA)，由Neural Memory Indexer主动预测未来上下文需求，仅保留关键KV chunk在GPU内存中。
summary.technical_approach: LSA采用backbone-free解耦训练策略：将indexer建模为标准dual-encoder架构，独立于LLM backbone单独训练（用标准检索训练框架，无需加载大模型。在DeepSeek-V4架构上实例化。
summary.experiments: 在主要长上下文评测套件上验证了效率显著提升（未见完整数据（abstract被截断）。声称显著提升serving效率并同时作为attention denoiser。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek团队。这是继DeepSeek-V4架构的FlashMemory技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing severe GPU memory bottlenecks for ultra-long context serving.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm-level innovation: Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA) proactively predicts future context demands and retains only query-critical KV chunks in GPU memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: LSA uses a backbone-free decoupled training strategy: the indexer is formulated as a standard dual-encoder architecture, trained independently using standard retrieval frameworks without loading the massive backbone model. Instantiated on DeepSeek-V4.
summary_en.experiments: Significant improvements on major long-context evaluation suites (results truncated). Claims both serving efficiency and acts as attention denoiser.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek team; this is the FlashMemory technical report for DeepSeek-V4.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对长上下文推理的认知——用独立dual-encoder indexer预测未来KV需求，backbone-free训练策略极具工程启发性，应立刻在内部ablation中复现核心思路。
recommendation.en: Changes my view on long-context inference: a standalone dual-encoder indexer predicting future KV needs with backbone-free training is highly engineerable; should reproduce core idea in internal ablations immediately.

paper.title: How Much Dense Attention is Necessary? Oracle-Guided Sparse Prefill for Full/GQA Layers in Hybrid Long-Context Models
paper.abstract: Long-context prefill remains expensive because full/GQA layers still score the historical sequence, even in hybrid models with local, sparse, linear, or recurrent components. We study how much dense attention is needed to preserve task-level behavior under explicit support granularity and top-k budgets.   We introduce an attention-mass top-k oracle for existing GQA checkpoints: for each layer and query position, it computes dense attention, selects head-averaged token support, and recomputes att

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文混合模型中，全注意力层或 GQA 层仍需对历史序列进行评分，导致 prefill 阶段计算成本高昂。本文探究了在显式支持粒度和 top-k 预算下，保留任务级行为究竟需要多少密集注意力。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于注意力质量的 top-k oracle 方法，用于诊断和分离稀疏预算的可行性与索引器误差及运行时实现效应，为长上下文 prefill 的稀疏化提供了理论上限和诊断工具。
summary.technical_approach: 引入了一个 attention-mass top-k oracle，针对现有 GQA 检查点，计算密集注意力，选择 head-averaged token support，并仅在该 support 上重新计算注意力。基于该 oracle 的指导，通过 KL 蒸馏训练了一个 head-collapsed 辅助索引器。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 系列模型的检索密集型评估中，最长的 per-query oracle 行与密集注意力的差距在 1 分以内；Qwen3.5-9B 在 RULER 风格的 4K 到 100K 扫描中，差距在 0.48 分以内。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context prefill remains expensive because full/GQA layers still score the historical sequence. This paper investigates how much dense attention is necessary to preserve task-level behavior under explicit support granularity and top-k budgets.
summary_en.importance: Introduces an attention-mass top-k oracle to diagnose and separate sparse-budget feasibility from indexer error and runtime realization effects, providing a theoretical upper bound and diagnostic tool for sparsifying long-context prefill.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces an attention-mass top-k oracle for existing GQA checkpoints that computes dense attention, selects head-averaged token support, and recomputes attention only on that support. Guided by this oracle, a head-collapsed auxiliary indexer is derived and trained via KL distillation.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen-family retrieval-heavy evaluations, the longest per-query oracle rows stay within 1 point of dense attention. A Qwen3.5-9B RULER-style sweep from 4K to 100K stays within 0.48 points.

recommendation.zh: 用 oracle 测出了长上下文 prefill 稀疏化的理论上限，证明了极度稀疏的注意力足以维持检索性能，对设计高效长文本架构很有启发。
recommendation.en: Establishes the theoretical upper bound for sparsifying long-context prefill using an oracle, proving that extremely sparse attention suffices for retrieval tasks; highly insightful for designing efficient long-context architectures.

paper.title: Sparrow: Sparse Rollout for Stable and Efficient Long-context RL of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite being powerful, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) induces extremely long COT, making it computationally expensive. Since RLVR per-step cost is dominated by long-context rollout generation, sparse attention offers a promising way to accelerate dense rollout. However, sparse rollouts require a delicate stability-efficiency tradeoff: overly aggressive sparsity causes collapse, while overly lenient sparsity gives insufficient speedup. In this work, we study this tradeoff

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 训练中长 CoT rollout 成本过高，而直接用 sparse attention 加速又容易训练崩溃的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 post-train 与系统效率交叉处的一篇有方法味道的工作。它重要不在于又做了一个 sparse rollout，而在于把稳定性问题表述成 sparse-to-dense actor-policy mismatch，并提出可监控的尾部统计量作为调度信号。这对长上下文 RL、test-time scaling 乃至未来 pretrain/post-train 接口都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先观察到稀疏 rollout 的退化不是均匀发生在所有 token 上，而是少数尾部 token 的 actor-policy mismatch 触发 collapse。基于此提出 Sparrow：动态调整稀疏度，使每条轨迹中 per-token mismatch 的 lower tail 维持在临界阈值附近，从而在训练早期保稳定、后期逐步换取速度。核心思想不是固定 sparsity pattern，而是用 mismatch statistic 做闭环控制。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模，但场景明确是带 verifiable rewards 的 LLM RL，且关注长 CoT。对比对象应包括 dense rollout 和固定稀疏度 sparse rollout。论文声称在保持训练稳定的同时显著降低 rollout 成本。真正值得看的实验应是：尾部 mismatch 与 collapse 的相关性、动态调度相对固定稀疏度的稳定区间、以及不同上下文长度下的速度/效果曲线。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Beidi Chen。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the high cost of long chain-of-thought rollouts in RLVR, where naive sparse-attention acceleration often destabilizes training and causes collapse.
summary_en.importance: This is a meaningful paper at the intersection of post-training and systems efficiency. The key value is not merely another sparse rollout trick, but the framing of stability through sparse-to-dense actor-policy mismatch and the use of a tail statistic as a control signal. That has implications for long-context RL, test-time scaling, and the pretrain–post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper observes that sparse rollout degradation is not uniform across tokens; collapse is driven by a small lower tail of per-token actor-policy mismatch. Sparrow then dynamically adjusts sparsity to keep this lower-tail statistic near a critical threshold throughout the trajectory. The main idea is closed-loop sparsity control based on mismatch statistics rather than a fixed sparsity pattern.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full model sizes, but the setting is clearly LLM RL with verifiable rewards and long CoT rollouts. The relevant baselines are dense rollout and fixed-sparsity sparse rollout. The paper claims substantial rollout savings while preserving stability. The most informative results are likely the correlation between tail mismatch and collapse, the stability window versus fixed sparsity, and speed-quality tradeoffs across context lengths.
summary_en.authors_note: Beidi Chen appears in the author list.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“稀疏 rollout 为什么崩”的 prior：先复现尾部 mismatch 统计，再决定是否上 sparse RL；别只盯平均误差。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on why sparse rollouts collapse: reproduce the tail-mismatch statistic first, then decide whether sparse RL is viable; average error is the wrong lens.

paper.title: You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing
paper.abstract: Long-context inference in modern LLMs is increasingly constrained by decoding efficiency, especially in reasoning-heavy settings where models generate long intermediate chains of thought. Existing sparse attention methods often face a practical efficiency-quality trade-off. Structured block sparse methods typically provide stronger acceleration but incur noticeable quality loss, while token sparse methods are usually more accurate yet deliver limited end-to-end speedup because top-k routing over

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码中，token级稀疏注意力精度高但全缓存top-k路由开销大，端到端提速受限，存在显著的效率-质量权衡。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出跨层共享路由的稀疏注意力方案，解决了token级稀疏注意力的路由开销瓶颈，同时保留精度优势。
summary.technical_approach: 基于YOCO这类跨层KV共享架构，用单一索引器仅计算一次token级top-k选择，将生成的路由索引跨所有解码器层复用，摊销路由计算开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验细节，核心验证跨层共享路由可在保留token稀疏注意力精度的同时大幅降低解码端到端开销。
summary.authors_note: 微软研究院、清华大学，知名作者包括Li Dong、Furu Wei，团队在Transformer架构、长上下文、多模态领域有大量代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Token-level sparse attention for long-context LLM decoding has high accuracy but suffers from large top-k routing overhead over full KV cache, limiting end-to-end speedup and causing a notable efficiency-quality trade-off.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes cross-layer shared routing for sparse attention, resolving the routing overhead bottleneck of token-level sparse attention while preserving accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on cross-layer KV sharing architectures such as YOCO, a single indexer computes token-level top-k selection once and reuses the routing index across all decoder layers to amortize routing overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details are not disclosed in the abstract; core verification shows cross-layer shared routing preserves token sparse attention accuracy while significantly reducing end-to-end decoding overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: Microsoft Research, Tsinghua University; notable authors include Li Dong and Furu Wei, whose team has extensive representative work in Transformer architecture, long context, and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 跨层共享路由的设计干净，可直接用于现有长上下文基座的推理优化，值得复现路由开销和精度的对比测试。
recommendation.en: Cross-layer shared routing has a clean design, can be directly applied to long-context base model inference optimization, worth replicating for routing overhead and accuracy comparison tests.

paper.title: Vortex: Efficient and Programmable Sparse Attention Serving for AI Agents
paper.abstract: Sparse attention is becoming increasingly important for serving large language models (LLMs) as generation lengths continue to grow. However, deploying and evaluating new sparse attention algorithms at scale remains highly engineering-intensive, slowing both human researchers and AI agents in exploring the sparse attention design. To address this challenge, we present Vortex, a system that combines a Python-embedded frontend language atop a page-centric tensor abstraction for expressing a broad

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是长生成场景下稀疏注意力从算法想法到真实 serving 加速之间的工程断层。现代 LLM serving 普遍使用 paged KV cache，KV 在物理内存中非连续存放，并通过间接地址访问。很多稀疏注意力方法在论文里有理论计算收益，但落到 vLLM/SGLang 这类系统时，需要重写大量低层算子，尤其是动态稀疏场景中还要在线计算 sparsity pattern，工程成本和运行开销都很高。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文、reasoning、agent 和 RL 生成负载下的推理系统研究有参考价值。它的价值在于把稀疏注意力研究从“写一个专用 kernel”推进到“可编程、可部署、可评估”的系统抽象。对基座研究员的启发主要有两点：第一，稀疏注意力能否成为模型结构或训练 recipe 的一部分，取决于 serving 栈是否能稳定支持快速迭代；第二，动态稀疏的真实瓶颈往往不在 attention kernel 本身，而在 pattern 生成、paged layout 上的 gather、Top-K、Reduce 等辅助算子。
summary.technical_approach: Vortex 的核心是 vTensor，一个面向 paged layout 的 page-centric tensor abstraction。它试图把 paged KV cache 暴露为可组合的张量视图，而不是让用户直接处理非连续内存、block table 和地址映射。前端是嵌入 Python 的表达语言，用来描述稀疏模式如何生成、注意力如何计算；后端则和现代 LLM serving 栈集成，负责在 paged KV 上高效执行。论文明确区分了它和 FlashInfer、FlexAttention 一类工作的边界：后者在已知 sparsity pattern 时能优化 attention operator，但动态稀疏需要在线决定每个 query 看哪些 KV，这部分计算本身会成为主要开销。Vortex 的目标是把 GEMM、Reduce、Top-K 等 paged tensor 算子也纳入同一个抽象，避免每个新稀疏算法都写一套专用实现。和为 Quest、Double Sparse 等方法定制 kernel 的路线相比，它强调组合性和 serving 兼容性，包括 paged attention、prefix caching 以及不断变化的 attention backend。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文片段主要包含动机和系统设计，实验数字有限。论文在引言中提到，Double Sparse 在 SGLang 中实现大约需要 2000 行代码，其中大量代码用于在 paged tensor 上重写 GEMM、Reduce、Top-K 等基础算子。Quest 的原始实现虽然有优化稀疏 kernel，但在真实 serving 栈中比 SGLang full attention 慢 44.4 倍；在 Llama 3.1-8B 的 AMC23 评测上接近两小时，说明单独优化 kernel 不足以带来端到端收益。摘要声称 Vortex 能把稀疏注意力的理论效率转化为真实吞吐提升，但当前材料没有给出完整吞吐、延迟、显存或不同稀疏算法的对比表，因此需要到实验章节核对端到端 benchmark、动态稀疏开销拆解和不同 batch/sequence 长度下的收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 45 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 paged KV cache 和动态稀疏瓶颈的定义，这部分能快速判断问题是否真实。随后看 vTensor 抽象和前端示例，重点确认它是否能覆盖常见稀疏策略：static block sparse、retrieval/top-k sparse、heavy hitter、sliding window 加全局 token 等。后端部分建议关注两个问题：一是 paged layout 上如何减少 gather 和重复访存；二是如何接入 SGLang/vLLM 这类 serving 系统而不破坏 prefix caching 和 batch 调度。实验部分如果阅读全文，需要重点看端到端吞吐而不是单 kernel microbenchmark，并检查动态 pattern 生成的时间占比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the engineering gap between sparse-attention algorithms and real serving speedups. Modern LLM serving systems store KV caches in a paged, physically non-contiguous layout with indirect addressing. This layout breaks the assumptions of standard tensor frameworks and makes new sparse-attention variants hard to express, deploy, and evaluate. The issue is sharper for dynamic sparsity, where the sparsity pattern is computed online and can dominate the cost of the attention operator itself.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-context and long-generation model research. Reasoning, agentic workloads, and RL rollouts put heavy pressure on decode-time KV movement. A sparse-attention idea is only useful for model design if it can be evaluated under a realistic serving stack. The main lesson is that sparse attention should be treated as a system-level abstraction problem, not just a kernel optimization problem. Pattern construction, paged-tensor reductions, Top-K selection, and integration with prefix caching often decide whether the method works in practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: Vortex introduces vTensor, a page-centric tensor abstraction for computation over paged KV layouts. The frontend is a Python-embedded language for specifying how sparsity patterns are generated and how attention is computed. The backend integrates with modern LLM serving systems and executes operations efficiently on non-contiguous paged memory. The paper positions Vortex against systems such as FlashInfer and FlexAttention: those systems are effective once the sparsity pattern is known, but they do not fully address dynamic sparse attention where pattern generation is part of the algorithm. Vortex also differs from custom-kernel implementations for individual methods, because it tries to make paged GEMM, Reduce, Top-K, and attention compositionally programmable.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt contains limited experimental details. It reports that implementing Double Sparse in SGLang requires roughly 2,000 lines of code, much of it reimplementing basic paged-tensor operators such as GEMM, Reduce, and Top-K. It also notes that the original Quest implementation is 44.4x slower than SGLang full attention in a real serving setup and takes nearly two hours to evaluate Llama 3.1-8B on AMC23. These numbers support the paper’s central claim that optimized sparse kernels alone do not guarantee end-to-end gains. The abstract states that Vortex translates theoretical efficiency into real throughput improvements, but the excerpt does not include the full latency, throughput, memory, or ablation results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand why paged KV caches make sparse attention hard. Then read the vTensor abstraction and frontend examples to see whether common sparse patterns can be expressed cleanly. In the backend section, focus on how Vortex avoids excessive gathers and redundant memory movement, and how it stays compatible with prefix caching and serving schedulers. In the experiments, prioritize end-to-end serving throughput and the breakdown of dynamic pattern-generation overhead over isolated kernel benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 只看页中心张量抽象和LLM服务栈集成的设计即可，对内部稀疏注意力原型开发有工程参考价值
recommendation.en: Only review the design of page-centric tensor abstraction and LLM serving stack integration, which has engineering reference value for internal sparse attention prototyping

paper.title: Value-Aware Stochastic KV Cache Eviction for Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning models improve accuracy through extended chains of thought, but their long outputs create a memory and compute bottleneck. KV cache eviction methods reduce this cost by evicting unimportant key-value pairs from the cache, yet they often yield worse accuracy than selection-based sparse attention alternatives, which keep the full KV cache. We identify key factors crucial to KV cache eviction accuracy. First, a small fraction of value states have abnormally large magnitudes, and evicting

summary.core_problem: 推理模型在生成超长思维链时，KV cache 随序列长度线性增长，造成严重的显存与计算瓶颈。现有 eviction 方法（永久丢弃不重要 KV 对）在推理任务上精度下降显著，往往不如保留完整 cache 的 selection 类稀疏注意力方法。
summary.importance: 揭示了 KV cache 管理中两个被忽视的关键因素——value 向量幅值分布的极端偏态性，以及随机性在 eviction 中的正面作用。对推理服务的工程落地有直接参考价值，也提示了 attention value 统计特性可能是预训练动态分析的一个有用窗口。
summary.technical_approach: VaSE 是一个无需训练的 eviction 策略，建立在两个观察之上：(1) value 向量幅值呈强偏态分布，极少数大幅值 value 对精度至关重要，驱逐它们会导致模型陷入重复推理循环；(2) 在 eviction 中引入随机性能提高保留 KV 的多样性，从而提升精度。具体做法：用 value 向量的 L2 范数作为重要性评分，优先保留大幅值 value；在评分中加入随机扰动（stochastic gumbel-max 采样）增加多样性。采用周期性 eviction 框架：分为永久缓存 K 个 token + 最近 B 个 token 的 buffer。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-14B 上评测，覆盖数学、代码、科学 QA 共 6 个任务。相比之前最优 eviction 方法 R-KV，VaSE 平均提升 4.4%（4B）和 4.9%（14B）。与 CurDKV 结合时结合时，随机采样额外分别再提升 7.7% 和 9.2%。在静态显存预算下，精度甚至略超过内存随序列线性增长的 selection 方法 SeerAttention-R。在 GSM8K 上单 value 评分贡献 16.2% 提升，随机性额外贡献 4.7%。同时实测了吞吐量和峰值显存，验证与理论压缩比基本吻合。此外还将 insight 推广到 KV 量化场景，证明大幅值 value 在 per-token 量化下也造成不成比例的重建误差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Figure 2（value 幅值分布直方图）和 Figure 9（evicting 大幅值 value 导致的失败案例）。阅读约 15-20 分钟。技术贡献主要看 method 方法与消融实验（Section 3-4）。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在文中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning models generate extremely long chains of thought, causing KV cache to grow linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory and compute bottleneck. Existing eviction methods (permanently discarding unimportant KV pairs) degrade accuracy notably on reasoning tasks, underperforming selection-based sparse attention that keeps the full cache.
summary_en.importance: Uncovers two underappreciated factors in KV cache management: the extremely skewed value magnitude distribution and the benefit of stochasticity in eviction. Offers a train-free recipe that directly improves reasoning service engineering, and also suggests that value statistics may be a useful lens for analyzing pretraining dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: VaSE is a training-free eviction strategy built on two observations: (1) value vector magnitudes are strongly skewed—a tiny fraction of large-magnitude values are critical to accuracy; evicting them triggers repetitive reasoning loops; (2) injecting stochasticity into eviction improves diversity of retained KV pairs. Specifically, VaSE uses L2 norm of value vectors as importance score, prioritizing large-magnitude values, and adds stochastic perturbation (Gumbel-max sampling) to increase diversity. Adopts a periodic-eviction framework with a persistent budget of K tokens plus a small buffer B of most recent tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B across 6 tasks spanning math, code, and science QA. VaSE outperforms prior SOTA eviction method R-KV by 4.4% (4B) and 4.9% (14B) on average. When combined with CurDKV, stochastic sampling further boosts accuracy by 7.7% and 9.2% respectively. Under static memory budget, VaSE even slightly exceeds selection method SeerAttention-R whose memory grows linearly with sequence length. On GSM8K, value scoring alone contributes 16.2% improvement and stochasticity adds another 4.7%. Throughput and peak memory benchmarks closely match theoretical compression ratios. The insight also generalizes to KV quantization: large-magnitude values cause disproportionate reconstruction error under per-token quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Figure 2 (value magnitude distribution histogram) and Figure 9 (failure cases from evicting large-magnitude values). Estimated reading time 15-20 min. Method and ablation are in Sections 3-4.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看§3对大幅值value状态的现象分析即可，方案是免训练的推理侧优化，对预训练侧的直接参考有限。
recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 for the analysis of large-magnitude value states. This is a training-free inference optimization with limited direct implications for pretraining.

paper.title: LVSA: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Dense self-attention is the compute and quality bottleneck of long-video diffusion inference: cost grows quadratically with the sequence length, and beyond the training horizon the model converges to near-static output, that is, "frozen" repetitive video. State of the art approaches are either too costly, e.g., they require retraining, or fail to satisfy both performance and quality objectives in a scalable manner. To this end, we introduce Long Video Sparse Attention (LVSA), a training-free mod

summary.core_problem: 长视频 diffusion transformer 的 dense self-attention 在帧数增长时带来二次复杂度和显存压力，并且在超过训练 horizon 后容易生成近乎静止或循环的视频。LVSA 解决的是推理阶段如何在不重训模型的条件下，同时降低长视频 attention 成本并缓解 temporal repetition。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于推理侧稀疏注意力设计。它不直接改预训练目标，但对长上下文多模态模型有工程和建模启发：稀疏 pattern 不能只看 FLOPs，还要避免固定网格带来的长程伪影。对视频 DiT、长上下文 VLM、以及未来统一生成模型，训练外 attention pattern 是否能稳定外推到更长 horizon，是一个实际问题。
summary.technical_approach: LVSA 是 training-free、model-agnostic 的 block-sparse attention。对每个 query frame，它不再 attend 到所有 T 个时间帧，而是 attend 到局部窗口和全局锚点的并集：局部窗口 W(t) 覆盖当前帧附近的 temporal neighborhood，用来保持短期运动连续性；全局帧集合 G 按周期选取关键时间点，用来提供长程参照。摘要还强调 rotating global anchors 和 expanded adaptive window logic，目的是减少固定稀疏网格的偏置，避免某些时间位置长期缺少全局连接。实现上结合 FlashInfer kernel，把稀疏 frame selection 转成高效 block-sparse attention。它和 RIFLEx、UltraViCo 的差别是：RIFLEx 主要改 temporal RoPE 外推，UltraViCo 依赖 pairwise logit decay；LVSA 直接改推理 attention 的可见集合，并且不需要重新训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Wan 2.1 1.3B、Wan 2.1 14B、HunyuanVideo 1.5 等不同视频 DiT。最长测试 horizon 下，LVSA+FlashInfer 在 Wan 2.1 1.3B 上达到 3.17× 加速，在 Wan 2.1 14B 上达到 2.98×，在 HunyuanVideo 1.5 上达到 3.33×。在 Wan 系列 6× horizon 上，LVSA 在自建 VQeval 上明显优于 dense attention，主要因为 VQeval 更能惩罚 frozen 或 loopy video。它还让 HunyuanVideo 1.5 在 2× horizon、257 frames 下完成生成，而 dense attention 因显存不足不可行。与 UltraViCo 和 RIFLEx 相比，报告中最高有 3.27× 的计算优势，同时质量指标更好。NPU 实验中，Wan 2.2 A14B 为 2.71× 加速，Wan 2.1 1.3B 为 3.24× 加速。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 attention pattern 的定义、rotating global anchors 的具体实现、VQeval 如何识别循环和冻结失败，以及不同 backbone 上的速度-质量曲线。对预训练研究员来说，最值得看的不是 kernel 细节，而是稀疏连接模式为什么会影响长程生成质量：局部窗口保运动，全局锚点保长程参照，旋转机制减少固定 pattern 的系统性偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Dense self-attention in video diffusion transformers scales quadratically with the number of frames and becomes a memory bottleneck for long generation. Beyond the training horizon, it can also produce frozen or repetitive videos. LVSA targets inference-time long-video generation without retraining: reduce attention cost while avoiding long-range temporal artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in efficient inference and sparse attention design. It does not change the pretraining objective, but it is informative for long-context multimodal modeling: sparse patterns should be evaluated not only by FLOPs, but also by the temporal biases they introduce. For video DiTs, long-context VLMs, and unified generative models, training-free attention extrapolation is a practical design axis.
summary_en.technical_approach: LVSA is a training-free, model-agnostic block-sparse attention algorithm. For each query frame, attention is restricted to the union of a local temporal window and a set of global anchor frames. The local window preserves short-term motion continuity, while periodically selected global frames provide long-range references. The abstract further highlights rotating global anchors and expanded adaptive window logic, which are intended to reduce fixed-grid bias and avoid systematic temporal artifacts. The method is implemented with a FlashInfer kernel to make the block-sparse pattern efficient. Compared with RIFLEx, which modifies temporal RoPE extrapolation, and UltraViCo, which applies pairwise logit decay, LVSA directly changes the visible frame set during inference and requires no finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers several video diffusion transformers, including Wan 2.1 1.3B, Wan 2.1 14B, and HunyuanVideo 1.5. At the longest tested horizon, LVSA with FlashInfer reports 3.17× speedup on Wan 2.1 1.3B, 2.98× on Wan 2.1 14B, and 3.33× on HunyuanVideo 1.5. On the Wan models at a 6× horizon, LVSA scores clearly above dense attention on the proposed VQeval benchmark, which is designed to penalize frozen and loopy outputs more directly than standard long-video metrics. It also enables HunyuanVideo 1.5 generation at a 2× horizon of 257 frames, where dense attention runs out of memory. Against UltraViCo and RIFLEx, the paper reports up to 3.27× compute advantage with better quality scores. NPU results show 2.71× speedup on Wan 2.2 A14B and 3.24× on Wan 2.1 1.3B.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 20–30 minutes. Read the definition of the sparse attention pattern, the implementation of rotating global anchors, the VQeval design for detecting looping and freezing, and the speed-quality curves across backbones. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is why sparse connectivity affects long-horizon generation quality: local windows preserve motion, global anchors preserve long-range reference, and rotation reduces systematic bias from a fixed pattern.

recommendation.zh: 看 sparse pattern 和 kernel 部分即可；若质量指标干净，它对长上下文生成注意力设计有可复用信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the sparse pattern and kernel sections; if the quality metrics are clean, it provides reusable signal for long-context generative attention design.
