paper.title: STS: Efficient Sparse Attention with Speculative Token Sparsity
paper.abstract: The quadratic complexity of attention imposes severe memory and computational bottlenecks on Large Language Model (LLM) inference. This challenge is particularly acute for emerging agentic applications that require processing multi-million token sequences. We propose STS, a sparse attention mechanism that requires no model retraining. STS leverages the key insight that tokens identified as important by a smaller draft model are highly predictive of important tokens for a larger target model. By

summary.core_problem: 论文解决长上下文推理中的注意力成本问题：全量 attention 需要为每个 query 扫描完整 KV cache，序列变长后受显存带宽和计算量限制。已有 token sparsity 方法通常依赖启发式选择重要 token，容易漏掉关键 token，或者用 block 级选择牺牲稀疏粒度，还会引入额外选择开销。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于推理效率，不是预训练方法。对基座研究的启发主要有两点。第一，小模型和大模型在同一输入上的 attention pattern 存在较强相关性，尤其是同系列模型；这说明跨尺度注意力结构有可迁移成分。第二，稀疏 attention 如果能保留完整 KV cache，只在当前 query 上动态稀疏，就比永久 token pruning 更适合长上下文和多轮 agent 场景。它也提示预训练阶段的长上下文稀疏化研究，不一定要从静态结构出发，可以利用 draft model 或辅助模型预测动态稀疏模式。
summary.technical_approach: STS 的核心做法是把 speculative decoding 中的小 draft model 复用为 token selector。draft model 正常生成候选 token，同时利用自己的 attention score 生成 token-and-head-wise sparsity mask。大 target model 不再做 dense attention，而是按照这个 mask 对每个 head、每个 query 只访问被认为重要的 token。方法不需要重新训练模型，也不丢弃 KV cache；所有历史 token 仍然保留，只是当前计算时按需读取。与传统 token pruning 不同，STS 避免了不可逆的信息删除；与即时生成 mask 的稀疏方法不同，mask 在 target model 执行前已经由 draft model 算好，因此选择开销可以和 speculative decoding pipeline 重叠，并可用于提前预取 KV 数据。论文还强调 STS 可用于 prefill 和 decode 两个阶段，而不是只优化 decode。
summary.experiments: 实现基于 vLLM，并集成到 speculative decoding 框架中。论文报告在代表性长文本 benchmark NarrativeQA 上，约 90% sparsity 下达到 2.67× speedup，同时相对 dense attention 的精度下降很小。与已有 token sparsity 方法相比，STS 在相同精度预算下能使用更高稀疏率，或在相同稀疏率下保持更好质量。实验还分析了 draft model attention 作为 target model token importance proxy 的有效性，以及“known-in-advance” mask 对 pipeline 和内存编排的好处。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Background，确认它与 linear attention、token pruning、传统 token sparsity 的边界。方法部分重点看 sparsity mask 如何从 draft model attention score 构造，以及 mask 的 token-wise、head-wise 粒度。实验部分优先看 NarrativeQA 上 90% sparsity、2.67× speedup 的设置，尤其要检查 batch size、上下文长度、draft/target 模型组合和精度指标。若时间有限，重点读 attention pattern correlation 的分析图和与已有稀疏方法的 accuracy-sparsity 曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the cost of full attention during long-context LLM inference. For every query, the target model scans the full KV cache, which becomes expensive in both compute and memory bandwidth. Existing token-sparsity methods often rely on heuristics, select coarse blocks instead of individual tokens, or add token-selection overhead that cancels part of the speed gain.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its main value for foundation-model research is the empirical observation that attention patterns transfer across model scales, especially within the same model family. It also makes a clear design choice: keep the full KV cache and sparsify only the current attention computation. That is safer than irreversible token dropping for long-context and multi-turn agent workloads. The idea may also inform future sparse-attention pretraining work, where a small auxiliary model or a draft model predicts dynamic sparsity rather than using fixed sparse layouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: STS reuses the draft model in speculative decoding as a token selector. The draft model still proposes candidate tokens, but its attention scores are also used to build a token- and head-wise sparsity mask. The target model then runs sparse attention according to this mask, avoiding dense attention over the full context. The method is training-free and preserves the full KV cache, so tokens that are unimportant for the current query are not permanently removed. A key systems property is that the mask is known before the target model executes. This lets the selection latency be hidden inside the speculative decoding pipeline and opens the door to proactive KV prefetching. Unlike many sparse methods that focus on decode only, STS is positioned for both prefill and decode.
summary_en.experiments: The authors implement STS in vLLM and integrate it with speculative decoding. On NarrativeQA, the paper reports a 2.67× speedup at roughly 90% sparsity with negligible accuracy loss relative to dense attention. Compared with prior token-sparsity techniques, STS shows a better accuracy-sparsity trade-off: for a fixed quality budget it can prune more attention work, and for a fixed sparsity level it preserves quality better. The experiments also analyze why draft-model attention is a useful proxy for target-model token importance and how the known-in-advance mask helps with pipeline scheduling and memory orchestration.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and background to place STS relative to linear attention, token pruning, and heuristic token sparsity. In the method section, focus on how the draft attention scores are converted into token- and head-level masks. In the evaluation, check the exact NarrativeQA setting behind the 90% sparsity and 2.67× speedup, including context length, batch size, draft-target model pair, and quality metric. If time is limited, prioritize the attention-correlation analysis and the accuracy-sparsity comparison curves.

recommendation.zh: 无需重训练的稀疏注意力设计很巧妙，重点看掩码构造逻辑和速度-精度折衷实验部分。
recommendation.en: The no-retraining sparse attention design is clever, focus on the mask construction logic and speed-accuracy tradeoff experiments.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: HASTE: Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration via Head-Wise Adaptive Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based video generation has advanced substantially in visual fidelity and temporal coherence, but practical deployment remains limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Training-free sparse attention is attractive because it accelerates pretrained models without retraining, yet existing online top-$p$ sparse attention still spends non-negligible cost on mask prediction and applies shared thresholds despite strong head-level heterogeneity. We show that these two overlooked f

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散模型中的全注意力计算随序列长度二次增长，已有 training-free 稀疏注意力仍把不少开销花在 mask 预测上，并且忽略不同 attention head 的稀疏性差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它不改变预训练目标或模型架构，但对 DiT / 视频生成模型的注意力稀疏化有工程参考价值，尤其是如何在不重训的前提下做 head-wise 预算分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HASTE，一个 head-wise adaptive sparse attention 框架。核心包括 Temporal Mask Reuse，根据 query-key drift 判断是否复用前一步稀疏 mask，减少在线 mask 预测成本；以及 Error-guided Budgeted Calibration，在全局稀疏预算下按 head 分配 top-p 阈值，使输出误差最小。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Wan2.1-1.3B 和 Wan2.1-14B 视频生成模型上进行，与 training-free online top-p sparse attention 类方法比较。摘要称在 XAttn 加速和质量保持之间取得更稳定的折中，但提供文本中未给出具体加速倍数、质量指标和显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自厦门大学相关团队；给定信息中未能确认 Cohere 参与，按论文机构信息处理。

summary_en.core_problem: Full attention in video diffusion models has quadratic cost, while existing training-free sparse attention still spends nontrivial compute on mask prediction and uses shared thresholds despite strong head-level heterogeneity.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its useful part is the engineering treatment of sparse attention in Video DiTs, especially budget allocation across heads without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HASTE introduces a head-wise adaptive sparse attention framework. Temporal Mask Reuse skips mask prediction when query-key drift is small, and Error-guided Budgeted Calibration assigns per-head top-p thresholds by minimizing measured output error under a global sparsity budget.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Wan2.1-1.3B and Wan2.1-14B. The abstract reports consistent improvements in the XAttention speed-quality trade-off over training-free top-p sparse attention baselines, but the provided text does not include exact latency, quality, or ablation numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Xiamen University. The provided metadata mentions Cohere, but the author-institution information does not confirm Cohere involvement.

recommendation.zh: 只看 calibration 和 mask reuse 的 ablation；对 LLM 预训练没有直接动作，但 head-wise 稀疏预算值得做类比。
recommendation.en: Read only the calibration and mask-reuse ablations; it does not change LLM pretraining practice, but the head-wise sparsity budgeting is a useful analogy.

paper.title: MISA: Mixture of Indexer Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) sets the state of the art for fine-grained inference-time sparse attention by introducing a learned token-wise indexer that scores every prefix token and selects the most relevant ones for the main attention. To remain expressive, the indexer uses many query heads (for example, 64 on DeepSeek-V3.2) that share the same selected token set; this multi-head design is precisely what makes the indexer the dominant cost on long contexts. We propose MISA (Mixture of Index

summary.core_problem: DeepSeek稀疏注意力(DSA)的多查询头索引器在长上下文下成为推理延迟的主要瓶颈，索引器开销占比过高
summary.importance: 工程与架构创新，提出可直接替换的稀疏注意力索引器方案，在保持效果的同时显著降低长上下文推理开销
summary.technical_approach: 将索引器多查询头视为专家混合池，用轻量路由器基于块级统计为每个查询选择少数活跃头，仅运行选中头的token级打分，大幅减少计算量
summary.experiments: 在DeepSeek-V3.2模型上验证，长上下文下索引器开销降低约一个数量级，保持原DSA的效果和精度无损失
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek团队，提出了业界领先的稀疏注意力机制DSA

summary_en.core_problem: The multi-query-head indexer of DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) becomes the main bottleneck for inference latency under long contexts, with excessively high indexer overhead
summary_en.importance: Engineering and architectural innovation that proposes a drop-in replacement for sparse attention indexers, significantly reducing long-context inference overhead while maintaining performance
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats indexer query heads as a mixture-of-experts pool, uses a lightweight router to select a small number of active heads per query based on block-level statistics, and only runs token-level scoring on selected heads to greatly reduce computation
summary_en.experiments: Verified on the DeepSeek-V3.2 model, reducing indexer overhead by approximately one order of magnitude under long contexts, with no loss of the original DSA's performance and accuracy
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek team, which proposed DSA, the industry-leading sparse attention mechanism.

recommendation.zh: MoE思路迁移到注意力索引器的设计很巧妙，做稀疏注意力长上下文优化时应参考其路由设计，重点看索引器实现细节
recommendation.en: The idea of migrating MoE design to attention indexers is clever; reference its routing design when optimizing sparse attention for long contexts, focus on the indexer implementation details.

paper.title: Sparse Attention as a Range Searching Problem: Towards an Inference-Efficient Index for KV Cache
paper.abstract: Sparse attention improves LLM inference efficiency by selecting a subset of key-value entries, but at the cost of potential accuracy degradation. In particular, omitting critical KV entries can induce substantial errors in model outputs. Existing methods typically operate under fixed or adaptive token budgets and provide empirical robustness or partial theoretical guarantees, yet they do not ensure zero false negatives in decoding steps, particularly since the set of relevant tokens is both quer

summary.core_problem: 稀疏 attention 用检索替代全量 KV attention 时，固定 top-k 或近似检索会漏掉关键 KV；长输出推理中漏掉一个高贡献 token 就可能造成明显误差。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工作，不属于预训练方法，但对长上下文模型训练和评测有间接价值。它把 KV-cache sparsification 从“取固定数量 token”改成“找出所有超过阈值的 token”，强调 false negative 的代价。这个问题在长链推理、代码生成、长文档问答中更尖锐，因为不同 decoding step 的 active tokens 数量变化很大。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是把稀疏 attention 形式化为 range searching。给定 query 和动态阈值，索引需要返回所有相似度超过阈值的 key，而不是返回固定 top-k。这样可以同时避免 token budget 不匹配和近似检索漏召回。LOUVER 是为 KV cache 设计的动态阈值检索框架，支持 decoding 过程中不断增长的 KV、query-dependent threshold、CPU/GPU 执行，以及与现有推理流水线集成。系统上还加入轻量 oracle 来估计相关性阈值，并做了硬件侧优化。
summary.experiments: 实验比较了 fixed-budget、adaptive-budget、KV offloading、dense attention 等基线。核心结果是 LOUVER 在保持或超过 dense attention 准确率的同时降低延迟；在 40k context length 下报告最高 15.3× GPU speedup 和 10.3× CPU speedup。论文强调的误差现象是：miss 一个 active key 可能造成输出误差尖峰，尤其出现在长输出 reasoning 任务中；这支持其 exact retrieval 而非 approximate top-k 的设计选择。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 false negative 的动机和 Example 1，再看 sparse attention 到 range searching 的形式化定义。系统实现细节可重点看 LOUVER 的动态索引、threshold oracle、CPU/GPU 优化。若关心预训练侧影响，重点不是具体索引结构，而是它对长上下文 attention 稀疏性的诊断：active token 数量随 query 和 decoding step 变化，固定预算稀疏化会系统性引入不可控误差。

summary_en.core_problem: Sparse attention over the KV cache often relies on fixed top-k or approximate retrieval, but these methods can miss critical keys. In long-output reasoning, a single false negative can produce sharp error spikes.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it has useful implications for long-context model design and evaluation. The main shift is to treat sparse attention as retrieving all keys above a relevance threshold, not as selecting a fixed-size subset. That distinction matters when the number of active tokens varies across queries and decoding steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reduces KV-cache sparsification to a range-searching problem. For each query, the index retrieves every key whose similarity exceeds a dynamically chosen threshold. This avoids both artificial token-budget caps and false negatives from approximate retrieval. LOUVER is the proposed indexing framework for dynamic KV caches. It supports threshold-based retrieval as decoding appends new keys, includes a lightweight oracle for choosing the relevance threshold, and adds CPU/GPU optimizations for integration into existing LLM inference pipelines.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare against fixed-budget sparse attention, adaptive-budget methods, KV offloading, and dense attention. LOUVER is reported to match or exceed dense-attention accuracy while reducing latency. At a 40k context length, the paper reports up to 15.3× GPU speedup and 10.3× CPU speedup. A key empirical observation is that missing even one active key can cause large output errors, especially in long reasoning traces where the relevant-token set changes over time.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Read the motivation and false-negative analysis in the introduction first, then the reduction from sparse attention to range searching. For systems details, focus on the dynamic index, threshold oracle, and CPU/GPU execution path. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the diagnostic claim: attention sparsity is query- and step-dependent, so fixed-budget sparsification can introduce structured errors that may not be visible in short-context benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 只看问题形式化和召回保证；若实验延迟不够强，它仍能作为 KV 稀疏化风险建模的干净基线。
recommendation.en: Read the formalization and recall guarantee; even if latency numbers are modest, it is a clean baseline for reasoning about sparse-KV failure modes.

paper.title: An Efficient Hybrid Sparse Attention with CPU-GPU Parallelism for Long-Context Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context inference increasingly operates over CPU-resident KV caches, either because decoding-time KV states exceed GPU memory capacity or because disaggregated prefill-decode systems place KV data in host memory. Although block-sparse attention reduces attention cost in this setting, sparsity alone is insufficient for end-to-end efficiency. GPU-only designs remain constrained by PCIe bandwidth and metadata memory overhead, while CPU-GPU hybrid designs still suffer from substantial GPU idle

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是长上下文解码中 CPU 常驻 KV cache 的稀疏注意力效率问题。现有 GPU-only 方案受 PCIe 带宽和元数据显存开销限制；现有 CPU-GPU hybrid 方案虽然减少 GPU 显存压力，但 CPU 侧 top-k 选择和稀疏注意力计算会让 GPU 长时间空转。核心问题不是“能不能做稀疏”，而是稀疏配置、KV 预算和跨设备执行如何一起优化。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理系统，但对预训练研究有间接价值。长上下文模型的训练目标、上下文长度扩展和 serving 约束正在互相影响。Fluxion 的结果说明，仅用注意力分数决定保留哪些 KV block 并不充分，head 对最终输出的贡献差异更关键。这对长上下文训练中的 attention pattern 分析、retrieval head 识别、GQA 下共享 KV 的设计都有参考意义。贡献量级主要在系统效率层面，不是新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach: Fluxion 有三个主要设计。第一，KV budget allocation 从 score-based 改为 output-aware。它不只看每个 head 的注意力分数，还估计 per-head output deviation 和 relative head contribution，用来判断少取一些 KV 对最终 attention output 的影响。这样可以避免把预算浪费在分数高但输出影响小的 head 上。第二，稀疏配置按 head 区分，并显式选择 top-k granularity。不同 head 的检索需求不同，top-k 的粒度会影响 CPU 侧选择开销和 sparse attention 的数据访问模式；Fluxion 联合选择每个 retrieval head 的预算和粒度，并处理 GQA 里多个 query head 共享 KV 的配置约束。第三，执行不是静态放在 CPU 或 GPU，而是用 priority-based scheduler 在 CPU 直接执行和传输 KV 后 GPU 执行之间动态选择，并通过重叠执行减少 attention completion time。系统中还有一个轻量 head-property predictor，离线用 output-aware 标注数据训练，在线判断 head 是 streaming head 还是 retrieval head，并预测预算-粒度关系。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，在 LongBench、L-Eval、RULER 共 40 个任务上评估。质量保持较好：相对 full attention，LongBench 平均分变化为 Qwen -0.13、Llama +0.02；L-Eval 平均下降约 Qwen 0.24、Llama 0.26。效率方面，相比固定稀疏 hybrid baseline（KV budget = 0.05），Fluxion 在 Qwen 上 TPOT 加速 1.9× 到 3.4×，在 Llama 上加速 2.5× 到 3.7×。在一个 32K context 的 Qwen 设置中，GPU idle ratio 从 70.65% 降到 45.78%。这些数字表明主要收益来自减少 CPU 侧稀疏计算和更好地重叠 CPU/GPU 工作，而不是单纯提高稀疏率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 §2.3 的瓶颈分析，确认 GPU-only 与 hybrid 方案各自卡在哪里；看 §3.1 理解 output-aware budget 为什么优于 attention-score budget；看 §3.2 的 granularity-budget coupling，这是论文里较有信息量的系统观察；看 §5.2 和 §5.3 了解 predictor 与 selector 如何落地；看 §6.2 的 scheduler。实验部分优先看 LongBench/L-Eval/RULER 的质量保持结果、TPOT 加速曲线和 GPU idle time 分析。若关注长上下文预训练，可以重点记录 retrieval head、streaming head 和 GQA 共享 KV 带来的配置约束。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets efficient sparse attention for long-context decoding when the KV cache resides in CPU memory. GPU-only sparse designs remain limited by PCIe transfers and metadata memory overhead. Existing CPU-GPU hybrid designs reduce GPU memory pressure, but CPU-side top-k selection and sparse attention create substantial GPU idle time. The main issue is not sparsity alone, but the joint optimization of sparse configuration, KV budget, and heterogeneous execution.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-systems paper, with indirect relevance to foundation-model pretraining. As long-context training and deployment become coupled, serving constraints start to shape which attention patterns are useful. Fluxion’s output-aware budgeting shows that attention scores alone are a weak proxy for the effect of a head on the final attention output. This is useful for analyzing retrieval heads, streaming heads, GQA designs, and long-context attention behavior. The contribution is system-level rather than a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: Fluxion combines three ideas. First, it replaces score-based KV budgeting with output-aware budgeting. The allocation accounts for per-head output deviation and relative head contribution, so KV blocks are retained according to their effect on the attention output rather than their attention scores alone. Second, it makes sparse configuration head-specific and granularity-aware. Retrieval needs vary by head, and the top-k granularity strongly affects CPU-side selection and sparse attention cost. Fluxion jointly selects budget and granularity for each retrieval head, while handling constraints introduced by shared KV in GQA. Third, it uses cross-device coordinated execution. A priority-based scheduler chooses between CPU-side sparse attention and GPU execution after KV transfer, overlapping work across devices to reduce attention completion time. A lightweight head-property predictor is trained offline from output-aware targets and used online to classify heads as streaming or retrieval heads and to predict budget-granularity behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on LongBench, L-Eval, and RULER, covering 40 tasks. Quality is mostly preserved relative to full attention: average LongBench score changes are -0.13 for Qwen and +0.02 for Llama, and average L-Eval drops are 0.24 and 0.26. Compared with the strongest fixed sparse hybrid baseline with KV budget 0.05, Fluxion improves TPOT by 1.9× to 3.4× on Qwen and 2.5× to 3.7× on Llama. In a representative 32K-context Qwen setting, GPU idle ratio drops from 70.65% to 45.78%. The gains come from reducing CPU-side sparse work and improving CPU-GPU overlap, not merely from using a smaller KV budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Start with §2.3 for the bottleneck analysis of GPU-only and hybrid designs. Then read §3.1 for why output-aware budgeting is a better signal than attention scores, and §3.2 for the budget-granularity coupling. §5.2 and §5.3 explain the predictor and selector. §6.2 covers the priority scheduler. In the experiments, focus on quality retention, TPOT speedups, and GPU idle-time breakdowns. For long-context pretraining interests, the most useful parts are the characterization of retrieval versus streaming heads and the constraints caused by GQA-shared KV.

recommendation.zh: 微软的长上下文CPU-GPU混合推理系统，核心是跨设备协调调度和按头稀疏配置，对推理Serving团队有参考价值，读方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Microsoft's long-context CPU-GPU hybrid inference system featuring cross-device coordinated scheduling and per-head sparse configuration; useful for inference serving teams, read methods section only.

paper.title: UniPrefill: Universal Long-Context Prefill Acceleration via Block-wise Dynamic Sparsification
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance rapidly, they are becoming increasingly capable while simultaneously demanding ever-longer context lengths. To improve the inference efficiency of long-context processing, several novel low-complexity hybrid architectures have recently been proposed, effectively alleviating the computational burden of long-context inference. However, existing research on long-context prefill acceleration remains predominantly focused on sparse attention mechani

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文推理的 prefill 阶段，现有加速方法主要绑定“全注意力层的稀疏化”，对新一代 hybrid 架构（线性/滑窗 + 少量全注意力）收益显著下降，且难以融入 vLLM 这类连续批处理（continuous batching）调度；论文要解决的是：如何做一种对架构更通用、并且可生产落地的 prefill 加速。
summary.importance: 偏推理系统与 serving 工程贡献，不直接改变预训练范式，但对“长上下文模型在真实高并发服务下的 TTFT 成本结构”给出一个可操作的加速路径：通过把稀疏决策从“只省 attention FLOPs”扩展到“连带省后续层的 GEMM FLOPs”，让 hybrid 架构也能吃到收益。对做长上下文预训练的人，价值主要在于理解部署侧瓶颈与架构选择（full-attn 层比例、block 设计）如何影响端到端成本。
summary.technical_approach: UniPrefill 的关键设计是“在全注意力层做 token 重要性估计，然后把 token-drop 的稀疏性向后传播到一个 block 的后续层”。具体做法：在每个 full-attention 层用轻量的 block-wise scoring 评估 token 重要性，选择性丢弃冗余 token；一旦 token 被丢弃，它在该 block 后续层（不仅是 attention 子层，也包括 MLP/GEMM 计算）都不再参与计算，从而同时减少 attention FLOPs 与 GEMM FLOPs。与只对 attention 做稀疏化的方法相比，这种“级联式 token-drop”在 hybrid 架构里更有效，因为 full-attn 层虽少，但一次决策能影响后续多层的计算量。系统侧，作者把 UniPrefill 实现为 continuous batching operator，并扩展 vLLM scheduler 支持在 token-drop 语义下的 prefill-decode co-processing 与 tensor parallel，使其能在请求动态进出 batch 的场景工作，而不是停留在单请求/静态 batch 的研究原型。
summary.experiments: 在 RULER 长上下文基准上评测多种架构，结论是“几乎无显著精度损失”前提下，TTFT 最多提升到 2.1×；并且加速收益随并发请求数提升而更明显（更贴近生产高吞吐场景）。论文在引言中对比了稀疏 attention 方法在 hybrid 架构中受限于 full-attn 层占比、边际收益变小的现象，实验部分主要验证 UniPrefill 在不同架构下的稳定收益与可并发扩展性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Introduction 里对 hybrid 架构下“只加速 full-attn 不够”的成本拆解动机；再看方法部分关于“token importance 在 full-attn 层估计、并向后传播到 block 后续层”的机制描述，理解它为何能同时省 attention 与 GEMM；最后看系统实现与 vLLM scheduler 改动，确认它如何支持 continuous batching 与 prefill-decode co-processing。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主要思路，若要复现/落地再细读实现细节与调度策略。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-context prefill acceleration largely targets sparsifying full attention, which delivers strong gains only when most layers are full-attention. On modern hybrid stacks (linear/sliding-window layers plus a few full-attention layers), the marginal benefit collapses, and many methods do not integrate cleanly with continuous batching in production engines like vLLM. The paper addresses how to build an architecture-agnostic, production-friendly prefill accelerator.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference/serving contribution rather than a pretraining one. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is in clarifying the real TTFT cost structure for long-context deployments and showing a mechanism that remains effective on hybrid architectures by reducing not only attention FLOPs but also downstream GEMM compute. This can inform architectural choices (e.g., placement/ratio of full-attention layers, block design) under serving constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniPrefill makes token-dropping decisions at full-attention layers using a lightweight block-wise importance score, then propagates that sparsity to all subsequent layers within a block. Once a token is dropped, it is excluded from later computation, so the savings extend beyond the attention sublayer to MLP/GEMM as well. This differs from attention-only sparsification: even if full-attention layers are sparse in a hybrid model, each decision amortizes across many following layers. On the systems side, UniPrefill is implemented as a continuous-batching operator and requires scheduler extensions in vLLM to support prefill-decode co-processing and tensor parallel under the token-drop regime.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the RULER long-context benchmark across multiple architectures. The reported outcome is up to 2.1× TTFT speedup with negligible accuracy degradation, and the speedup improves with higher request concurrency (aligning with production scenarios where prefill dominates).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction for the argument why attention-only acceleration underperforms on hybrids. Then read the method section to understand the “drop at full-attn, cascade through the block” mechanism and why it reduces both attention and GEMM. Finally, check the vLLM integration/scheduler changes to see how continuous batching is supported. ~30–45 minutes for the main idea; deeper reading only if you plan to implement it.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和端到端表格即可；若它真兼容 hybrid attention 和 continuous batching，长上下文架构评估要加这一项。
recommendation.en: Skim the system design and end-to-end tables; if it really supports hybrid attention plus continuous batching, long-context architecture evals need this axis.

paper.title: Stochastic Sparse Attention for Memory-Bound Inference
paper.abstract: Autoregressive decoding becomes bandwidth-limited at long contexts, as generating each token requires reading all $n_k$ key and value vectors from KV cache. We present Stochastic Additive No-mulT Attention (SANTA), a method that sparsifies value-cache access by sampling $S \ll n_k$ indices from the post-softmax distribution and aggregates only those value rows. This yields an unbiased estimator of the post-softmax value aggregation while replacing value-stage multiply-accumulates with gather-and

summary.core_problem: 长上下文自回归解码在 decode 阶段受 KV cache 读带宽限制。精确注意力每生成一个 token 都要读取全部 key/value，尤其 value 聚合阶段需要访问所有 value 行。SANTA 试图在不丢弃 KV cache、不改模型权重的前提下，减少每步实际读取的 value 行数。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法，而是长上下文推理效率工作。对基座研究的启发在于：长上下文模型的瓶颈不只来自注意力 FLOPs，也来自 decode 时重复流式读取 KV cache。SANTA 把 attention 输出视为一个可采样估计的问题，说明在推理阶段用无偏随机估计替代精确 AV，有机会在准确率可控的条件下降低带宽压力。它也提示后续可以考虑训练时显式适配这种随机 value 聚合噪声，而不是只在推理阶段临时近似。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Stochastic Additive No-mulT Attention，即 SANTA。标准注意力先得到 post-softmax 分布 A，再计算 AV。SANTA 把 A 看作 categorical distribution，从中采样 S 个索引，只读取这些索引对应的 value 行并求平均。这样 value 阶段从读取 n_k 行变成读取 S 行，且聚合主要是 gather-and-add，不再对所有 value 行做加权乘加。该估计是 AV 的无偏估计，方差随 1/S 下降。为降低方差，作者提出 S^2ANTA，用 stratified sampling / systematic sampling 把 CDF 分成等概率区间，每个区间采一次样，以覆盖更均匀的注意力质量。工作还提出 Bernoulli qK^T sampling，把 query 元素表示为 Bernoulli 随机变量，形成稀疏三值 query，从而近似 score 阶段并减少 key feature 访问；但主要实测加速来自 value 阶段稀疏化。
summary.experiments: 系统评测聚焦 decode-step attention kernel。文中给出的典型场景是 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、32k context，此时 bf16 KV 读取量约为每层每生成 token 128MB。S^2ANTA CUDA kernel 在 NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada 上，相比 FlashInfer 和 FlashDecoding 的 decode attention kernel 最高达到约 1.5 倍加速。准确率方面，作者在 GSM8K、MMLU 和长上下文任务上做了 accuracy-efficiency trade-off 评估，并报告在 32k context 下可匹配 baseline accuracy。关键消融点是采样数 S 与分层采样设计：S 越大方差越低但 value 读取越多；分层 / 系统采样比普通独立采样更适合降低输出方差，也更便于 GPU kernel 实现。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。优先看方法章节中 SANTA 的无偏估计推导，以及 S^2ANTA 的分层采样设计；再看系统实验，尤其是与 FlashInfer / FlashDecoding 的 kernel-level 对比和 32k context 设置。Appendix A 的方差分析值得扫一遍，因为它决定了这种近似能否在不同 attention entropy 下稳定工作。Bernoulli qK^T sampling 可以略读，它更像后续方向，当前实测收益主要不来自这部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context autoregressive decoding is increasingly limited by KV-cache bandwidth. Exact attention has to stream all keys and values at every generated token. SANTA targets the value aggregation stage and asks whether the model can read only a small sampled subset of value rows without permanently evicting cache entries or changing model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the framing: long-context cost is not only a FLOP problem but also a repeated memory-traffic problem during decode. By treating the post-softmax value aggregation as an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator, the work shows a concrete path for trading controlled stochastic error for lower KV bandwidth. It also suggests a possible training-aware direction: models could be trained or adapted to tolerate stochastic value aggregation instead of receiving it only as a deployment-time approximation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SANTA, short for Stochastic Additive No-mulT Attention, samples S indices from the post-softmax attention distribution and averages the corresponding value rows. Standard attention computes AV over all n_k value rows; SANTA replaces this with gather-and-add over S sampled rows, reducing value-cache row reads from n_k to S. The estimator is unbiased, with variance decreasing as 1/S. The paper further introduces S^2ANTA variants based on stratified and systematic sampling. These divide the attention CDF into equal-probability strata and sample once per stratum, improving coverage of the distribution and reducing variance in a GPU-friendly way. A complementary Bernoulli qK^T estimator is proposed for the score stage, where query features are sparsified into ternary values, but the implemented speedups mainly come from value-stage sparsification.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation focuses on decode-step attention kernels. A representative setting is Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at a 32k-token context, where bf16 KV streaming is about 128 MB per layer per generated token. On an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPU, the S^2ANTA CUDA kernels report up to about 1.5x speedup over FlashInfer and FlashDecoding for decode attention kernels. Accuracy is evaluated on GSM8K, MMLU, and long-context benchmarks, with reported matching baseline accuracy at 32k context under suitable sampling settings. The main trade-off is the sample count S: larger S lowers variance but reads more value rows. Stratified and systematic sampling are the important variance-reduction components.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is enough. Read the SANTA estimator definition first, then the S^2ANTA sampling variants, and then the kernel-level evaluation against FlashInfer and FlashDecoding. Appendix A is useful for the unbiasedness and variance analysis, since attention entropy will likely determine when this approximation is safe. The Bernoulli qK^T section can be read as a future direction; it is not the main source of the reported speedup.

recommendation.zh: 读 kernel 设计和方差实验即可；若 32k 精度真稳，它给 value-cache 读带宽问题提供了可复现的随机近似路线。
recommendation.en: Read the kernel design and variance experiments; if 32k quality holds, it is a reproducible stochastic route around value-cache bandwidth.

paper.title: Unifying Sparse Attention with Hierarchical Memory for Scalable Long-Context LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM serving is bottlenecked by the cost of attending over ever-growing KV caches. Dynamic sparse attention promises relief by accessing only a small, query-dependent subset of the KV state per decoding step and extending the KV storage to CPU memory. In practice, however, these algorithmic savings rarely translate into end-to-end system-level gains because sparse methods typically operate at different granularities and thus rely on ad hoc, per-algorithm implementations. At the same

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长上下文 LLM serving 里的一个系统落地问题：动态 sparse attention 在算法上能显著减少每步需要访问的 KV，但一旦进入真实推理系统，稀疏模式不统一、GPU-CPU 分层存储下的细粒度随机取数、以及不断膨胀的元数据管理，会把理论节省大幅吃掉。作者要做的不是再提一种新的 sparse attention 算法，而是给不同稀疏算法提供统一执行抽象和分层 KV 管理框架，让“稀疏”真正转化成端到端吞吐和时延收益。
summary.importance: 它不属于 llm_pretrain，而是典型 efficient/serving 方向。但对基座研究仍有间接价值，因为长上下文训练和推理越来越耦合，很多预训练研究最后都会受制于 serving 可行性。文章的重要性主要在工程抽象层面。第一，它指出 sparse attention 的瓶颈已经不只是算子，而是系统接口和内存层级协同。第二，它把不同粒度的稀疏方法统一到同一 pipeline 里，这有助于后续算法研究更快进入可比较、可部署的系统环境。第三，它提出 ideal sparse-serving envelope 作为上界参照，这种“算法理论收益 vs 系统实际收益”的拆分方式很有用。贡献量级偏系统工程：如果你做的是长上下文推理、KV 分层、稀疏检索式注意力，这篇值得看；如果你只关心 pretrain objective，本身关联较弱。
summary.technical_approach:
Spin 的核心是把多种 sparse attention 方法抽象成统一的五阶段执行流水线：Index、Select、Attention、Offload、Retrieve。其中前三个是算法相关的计算步骤，后两个是共享的数据管理步骤。作者观察到，不同 sparse 方法虽然选择粒度不同，比如 block、cluster 或其他结构，但执行模式相似：先根据 query 生成索引或候选，再选出需要访问的 KV 子集，最后做注意力计算。因此系统层不必为每种算法单独写一套 runtime。

为实现这种统一，Spin 引入 partition 作为逻辑抽象层。partition 不是某一种具体稀疏单元，而是把算法定义的稀疏粒度映射到系统可管理的页式 KV 单元。这样做的好处是把“算法想访问什么”和“硬件适合怎样分配/传输”解耦。算法可以继续按自己的 block 或 cluster 语义工作，runtime 则按 page 粒度做分配、缓存和传输。

在 KV 管理上，Spin 重点解决 GPU-CPU 分层存储下的 locality 问题。作者认为 sparse decoding 不是完全随机访问，跨相邻 decoding step 往往存在时间局部性，因此可以通过 locality-aware replacement policy 提高 GPU residency。为此他们设计了 dynamic KV buffer，支持请求生命周期中的扩容、收缩和原地更新，同时维护适合 GPU 访问的元数据结构。

另一个关键点是 hierarchical metadata。长上下文下，哪怕 dense attention，页表和索引的元数据也会变大；到了 head-wise sparse retrieval，额外索引开销更明显。Spin 借鉴操作系统的多级索引思想，让元数据规模更接近物理 working set，而不是逻辑最大上下文空间，并把部分元数据放在 CPU 侧，减少 GPU 内存占用。

整体上，这篇工作的创新不在某个单一 kernel，而在于把 sparse attention、paged KV cache、GPU-CPU 分层存储、在线调度和元数据管理放进一个一致的系统设计里。和已有 vLLM 类 dense-serving 框架相比，它不再假设每步都要扫描全量 KV；和很多稀疏算法原型相比，它强调统一抽象和可复用 runtime，而不是为单一算法做特化实现。
summary.experiments:
从引言可确认，作者在 vLLM 上实现了 Spin，并集成了三种代表性的 sparse attention 方法。文中还构造了 ideal sparse-serving envelope，用来衡量现有实现距离理论最优还有多远。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整实验表，但可以确定实验重点包括三类：

第一，端到端 serving 性能。通常会比较吞吐、单步解码延迟、以及在长上下文和高并发下的表现，基线应包括 dense serving 和各 sparse 方法的原始实现。作者的目标是证明统一框架不会吞掉稀疏算法收益，反而能更接近理论上界。

第二，KV 分层与 locality-aware 管理的收益。这里应会有 GPU residency、PCIe 传输量、cache hit rate 或 retrieval latency 相关指标，用来说明为什么简单把 KV 放 CPU 再按需取回并不够，必须做 locality-aware caching。

第三，元数据与抽象开销。partition abstraction 和 hierarchical metadata 如果设计不好，会引入额外 bookkeeping 成本，因此实验通常需要证明这些开销在长上下文下是可控的，并且优于为每种算法单独维护一套实现。

引言里给了一个量级感很强的例子：Qwen3-8B 在 128K context 下单请求 KV cache 约 19GB；若稀疏率达到 95%，每步理论上只需处理不到 1GB 的 KV 数据。这说明问题空间足够大，也解释了为什么系统实现细节会决定稀疏是否真的有收益。具体吞吐提升倍数、时延下降比例、不同算法上的一致性表现，需要直接看主实验表和 envelope gap 图。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Figure 1 一类的问题定义图，理解作者为什么要引入 ideal sparse-serving envelope。然后看系统总览图，抓住五阶段 pipeline 和 partition abstraction，这两处决定了整篇工作的抽象边界。接着看 KV manager 和 metadata 设计，重点理解 locality-aware replacement、dynamic buffer、multi-level indexing 分别在解决什么瓶颈。

如果你做系统，建议把实现细节和实验一起看，尤其是不同 sparse 算法接入 Spin 时哪些部分需要自定义，哪些部分可以复用。若你主要做基座模型研究，这篇更适合泛读，20 到 30 分钟足够建立判断。值得深挖的点有两个。第一，partition abstraction 会不会限制未来更细粒度或更结构化的稀疏模式。第二，训练阶段若也采用分层 KV 或近似注意力，这套 serving 抽象能否反向影响模型设计，使模型更偏向 locality-friendly 的注意力模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a deployment bottleneck in long-context LLM inference: dynamic sparse attention can reduce the amount of KV state processed per decoding step in theory, but those gains often disappear in real systems because sparse methods use incompatible granularities, GPU–CPU hierarchical KV storage introduces irregular fine-grained retrieval, and metadata overhead grows quickly with context length. The goal is not to propose another sparse attention algorithm, but to build a serving framework that turns sparse access patterns into actual end-to-end throughput and latency gains.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficient-serving paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but real, since long-context model design increasingly depends on whether serving remains practical. The main contribution is at the systems abstraction level. First, it shows that the bottleneck for sparse attention is no longer just the attention kernel; it is the interface between sparsity algorithms and hierarchical memory management. Second, it provides a common execution substrate for multiple sparse methods, which makes future algorithm work easier to compare and deploy. Third, the ideal sparse-serving envelope is a useful way to separate algorithmic potential from system realization. The contribution is mainly engineering-facing, but important for anyone working on long-context inference, hierarchical KV storage, or retrieval-like attention patterns.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Spin organizes sparse attention serving into a unified five-stage pipeline: Index, Select, Attention, Offload, and Retrieve. The first three are algorithm-specific compute stages, while the last two are shared data-management stages. The key observation is that many sparse attention methods differ mostly in the granularity of their selected units—blocks, clusters, and so on—while sharing the same high-level execution pattern: identify candidate regions, select the relevant KV subset, and run attention on that subset. This makes a common runtime feasible.

To support that runtime, Spin introduces partition as the central abstraction. A partition is not tied to one specific sparse method; instead, it maps algorithm-defined sparse units onto system-manageable page-based KV units. This decouples what the algorithm wants to access from how the hardware prefers to allocate, cache, and transfer memory. Sparse methods can preserve their own semantics, while the runtime handles memory movement at page granularity.

The second major component is locality-aware hierarchical KV management. The authors argue that sparse decoding is not purely random: there is temporal locality across adjacent decoding steps, so useful KV states can remain resident on the GPU. Spin therefore uses a dynamic KV buffer that supports per-request resizing and in-place updates as requests arrive, advance, and finish, while maintaining GPU-friendly metadata for replacement and lookup.

The third component is hierarchical metadata. At long context lengths, even dense attention incurs nontrivial page-table overhead, and head-wise sparse retrieval adds more indexing cost. Spin borrows multi-level indexing ideas from operating systems so that metadata scales with the physical working set rather than the worst-case logical context space. It also splits metadata across GPU and CPU to reduce on-device overhead.

The novelty is not a single kernel optimization. It is the co-design of sparse attention execution, paged KV caching, GPU–CPU hierarchy, online scheduling, and metadata management within one consistent framework. Compared with dense-serving systems such as standard vLLM-style runtimes, Spin no longer assumes full-KV scans at every step. Compared with one-off sparse prototypes, it emphasizes reusable abstractions rather than per-algorithm specialization.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided text, Spin is implemented on top of vLLM and integrates three representative sparse attention methods. The paper also defines an ideal sparse-serving envelope to quantify how far current implementations are from the theoretical upper bound. Although the excerpt does not include the full result tables, the experimental structure is clear.

First, the paper evaluates end-to-end serving performance, likely including throughput, per-token decode latency, and behavior under long contexts and higher concurrency. The relevant baselines should include dense serving and native implementations of the integrated sparse methods. The main question is whether the unified framework preserves and amplifies the algorithmic benefits of sparsity.

Second, it studies the gains from hierarchical KV management and locality-aware caching. Metrics here likely include GPU residency, PCIe transfer volume, cache hit rate, and retrieval latency. This is important because simply offloading KV to CPU and fetching on demand is not enough when accesses are irregular.

Third, it evaluates abstraction and metadata overhead. Partition abstraction and hierarchical metadata are only useful if their bookkeeping cost remains controlled at long context lengths and across different sparse methods.

The introduction gives a concrete scale example: a single 128K-token request for Qwen3-8B needs about 19GB of KV cache, while a sparse method with 95% sparsity would theoretically process less than 1GB of KV data per decoding step. That example makes the systems problem very tangible. Exact throughput gains, latency reductions, and consistency across sparse methods need to be checked in the main tables and the envelope-gap figures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the problem-definition figure around the ideal sparse-serving envelope. That figure explains why sparse attention’s theoretical savings often fail to materialize. Then read the system overview carefully, especially the five-stage pipeline and the partition abstraction, since those define the paper’s main interface. After that, focus on the KV manager and metadata sections: locality-aware replacement, dynamic KV buffers, and multi-level indexing each target a different bottleneck.

If you work on systems, it is worth reading the implementation details together with the experiments, especially which parts of a sparse algorithm need customization when integrated into Spin and which parts are reused. If your focus is foundation-model pretraining, this is more of a skim paper; 20–30 minutes should be enough. Two deeper questions are worth keeping in mind. Does the partition abstraction constrain future finer-grained or more structured sparsity patterns? And if training also starts to use hierarchical KV or approximate attention, could this serving abstraction feed back into model design by favoring more locality-friendly attention behavior?

recommendation.zh: 微软的系统工作，指出了稀疏注意力在分层 KV 缓存下的落地痛点，提出的 SPIN 框架对长上下文 Serving 优化很有参考价值。
recommendation.en: System work from Microsoft highlighting the deployment pain points of sparse attention with hierarchical KV caches; the proposed SPIN framework is highly valuable for long-context serving optimization.

paper.title: Salca: A Sparsity-Aware Hardware Accelerator for Efficient Long-Context Attention Decoding
paper.abstract: Long contexts improve capabilities of large language models but pose serious hardware challenges: compute and memory footprints grow linearly with sequence length. Particularly, the decoding phase continuously accesses massive KV cache, dramatically increasing bandwidth and computing pressure. Existing accelerators are primarily designed and evaluated for short contexts. They suffer from significant performance degradation when processing long contexts. To bridge this gap, we identify the major

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文解码阶段 attention 对 KV cache 带宽和计算的压力，尤其是现有加速器在长序列下性能明显退化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是硬件-软件协同的推理效率工作，对做基座预训练的人不是核心主线，但对理解长上下文 serving 的真实瓶颈、以及稀疏注意力在系统侧能否落地有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成：软件侧提出 dual-compression dynamic sparse attention，把超低比特量化与特征稀疏结合，降低预测和访存开销；同时设计硬件友好的近似 Top-K，把筛选复杂度从 O(n log k) 降到 O(n)。硬件侧则围绕整数计算、稀疏访存和长 KV 访问路径做专门优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出芯片面积、工艺节点、吞吐/延迟/能效的具体数字，也没有说明与哪些 GPU/ASIC baseline 对比。当前能确认的是它面向 long-context decoding，而不是训练；是否对真实 LLM workload 有代表性，需要看 evaluation setup 是否覆盖不同 head 数、cache 长度和 batch 形态。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学工作。更偏体系结构与硬件加速方向，不属于 LLM 预训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the bandwidth and compute bottleneck of attention decoding under long contexts, where KV-cache access dominates and existing accelerators degrade sharply with sequence length.
summary_en.importance: This is a hardware-software co-design paper for inference efficiency. It is not central to pretraining research, but it is still useful for understanding real long-context serving bottlenecks and whether sparse attention ideas survive contact with systems constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts. On the software side, it proposes dual-compression dynamic sparse attention, combining ultra-low-precision quantization with feature sparsity to reduce prediction and memory overhead. It also introduces a hardware-friendly approximate Top-K that reduces filtering complexity from O(n log k) to O(n). On the hardware side, it optimizes integer compute, sparse memory access, and long-KV data movement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report process node, area, throughput, latency, or energy numbers, nor the exact GPU/ASIC baselines. What is clear is that the target is long-context decoding rather than training. Whether the evaluation reflects realistic LLM workloads depends on coverage over head counts, cache lengths, and batch shapes.
summary_en.authors_note: This is from Fudan University and is primarily a computer architecture / accelerator paper rather than an LLM pretraining methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，知道“长上下文瓶颈主要卡在 KV 访存而非算子 FLOPs”就够了；除非你在做软硬协同，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Not central to pretraining; the main takeaway is that long-context decoding is bottlenecked more by KV movement than raw FLOPs, so skip the full paper unless you care about HW-SW co-design.

paper.title: SpikingBrain2.0: Brain-Inspired Foundation Models for Efficient Long-Context and Cross-Platform Inference
paper.abstract: Scaling context length is reshaping large-model development, yet full-attention Transformers suffer from prohibitive computation and inference bottlenecks at long sequences. A key challenge is to design foundation models that maintain performance and long-context efficiency with minimal training overhead. We introduce SpikingBrain2.0 (SpB2.0), a 5B model that advances both architecture and training efficiency of its predecessor.   Our contributions are two-fold. (1) Architectural Innovation: We

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是再训练一个全新长上下文模型，而是在有限训练预算下，把已有 Transformer / VLM checkpoint 迁移成更适合超长上下文和跨平台推理的 hybrid 架构，同时尽量保住原模型能力。作者把问题拆成两部分：一是长序列下 attention 成为主要瓶颈，如何用混合稀疏机制降低 TTFT、TPOT 和显存占用；二是架构迁移通常代价高、恢复难，如何通过 continued training 和 distillation 把迁移成本压到可接受范围。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义主要不在“脑启发”叙事，而在一个更务实的方向：架构迁移是否可以成为 pretrain-posttrain 闭环的一部分。论文展示了一条 Transformer-to-Hybrid conversion 路线，从 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-4B-VL-Instruction 出发，用相对有限的 token 和 GPU 小时，把模型改造成长上下文更高效的 hybrid 版本，并在通用能力上尽量接近原模型。这个思路对持续预训练、mid-train 架构替换、长上下文 annealing 都有参考价值。真正的贡献量级更接近“工程上可行的迁移 recipe + 一套混合注意力设计”，而不是新的预训练范式。论文的大部分亮点也集中在推理效率和 conversion pipeline，而不是从零开始训练时的 scaling 规律。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有两条主线。第一条是架构设计：Dual-Space Sparse Attention，简称 DSSA。作者把两种稀疏机制按层交替组合，比例约 1:3。一种是 Sparse Softmax Attention，文中用的是 MoBA，直接在未压缩的精确 KV cache 上做稀疏 softmax attention；另一种是 Sparse Linear Attention，文中用的是 SSE，在压缩状态表示上做稀疏线性注意力。作者的意图很明确：MoBA 保留一部分“精确检索”能力，SSE 提供更低成本的长程建模，两者交替以平衡质量和效率。这个设计不是单纯把 full attention 换成 linear attention，而是保留少量精确注意力层作为锚点。

第二条是 activation coding / 推理实现。作者针对两类硬件给出不同路径：在神经形态或事件驱动硬件上，用整数化加 spike-sequence expansion，把 dense MatMul 改成稀疏整数累加；在 GPU 上则采用 FP8，利用 Hopper Tensor Core 加速矩阵乘法。这里“跨平台”更多是部署视角，不是预训练目标本身。

更值得预训练研究员关注的是 conversion pipeline。LLM 路线从 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 出发，采用多阶段训练：先做短上下文蒸馏，让 hybrid 架构先学会模仿原模型；再做三阶段长上下文扩展，把上下文拉到 512k；之后做 general SFT 和 reasoning-oriented SFT，并补充探索 on-policy distillation。VLM 路线更短，主要是知识蒸馏加 instruction SFT。这个 pipeline 的关键不是单个 loss，而是训练顺序：先恢复 base capability，再拉长上下文，再做指令与推理对齐，避免一开始就在长上下文和新架构上同时承受过大分布漂移。

从方法取舍看，作者没有选择从头训练一个 hybrid 5B 模型，而是明确押注 continued training / distillation。这说明他们认为在当前阶段，架构效率收益足以支撑一次中等成本的模型迁移，但还不足以让人放弃已有高质量 Transformer checkpoint 的知识积累。
summary.experiments:
实验结果分三块看。第一块是效率。作者报告，在 HuggingFace sequence-parallel inference 下，4M 上下文长度时 TTFT 相比 base Transformer 最多提升 10.13x；在 vLLM tensor-parallel inference 下，512k 长度时 TTFT、TPOT、端到端延迟分别提升 4.5x、1.12x、4.3x。由于显存占用更低，8 张 A100 配合 chunked prefill 可以服务超过 10M token 的序列。这里可以看出，收益主要集中在 prefill/长上下文阶段，TPOT 提升相对有限，这和大多数长上下文优化工作一致。

第二块是能力恢复。LLM 侧，作者称 SpB2.0 在一组通用 benchmark 上平均达到 Qwen3-4B 的 95% 以上，并稳定超过 Qwen2.5-3B；经过 SFT 后，性能接近 Qwen3，也超过更大的 SpB1.0-7B。VLM 侧，SpB2.0-VL 的整体表现接近 Qwen2.5-VL-3B，并较好恢复 Qwen3-VL-4B 的能力。这里的关键信息不是绝对分数，而是“在架构替换后，能力恢复到什么程度”。

第三块是训练成本。LLM conversion 总成本约 4,656 A100 GPU 小时，使用约 14B continued pretraining tokens；作者拿它和 SpB1.0 的 150B CPT tokens 做对比，强调迁移成本显著下降。VLM conversion 约 1,977 A100 GPU 小时。两者合计不到 7k A100 GPU 小时，可在 32 张 A100 上约 9 天完成。这个数字对工业界很有现实意义，因为它把“换架构”从一个重训练项目，压缩成一个可操作的 continued training 项目。

不过从研究判断上，也要看到证据边界。论文更像系统工程展示，缺少一些基座研究员会关心的细节：例如 DSSA 各层比例是否在不同长度区间稳定最优，distillation 与非 distillation 的恢复差距有多大，长上下文 extension 各阶段的数据配比和 curriculum 如何影响遗忘，FP8 与稀疏机制是否存在训练稳定性交互。这些如果正文里没有充分展开，就意味着方法可复现性和可迁移性还需要更多材料支撑。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“迁移 recipe → 架构 → 效率结果”的顺序看。先读 introduction 和训练流程图，确认作者真正贡献的是 conversion pipeline，而不是单个新算子。然后看 DSSA 设计，重点理解为什么要把 MoBA 和 SSE 按 1:3 交替，而不是只用一种稀疏注意力。接着看长上下文扩展和蒸馏部分，尤其是多阶段训练顺序。最后再看推理 benchmark，区分 TTFT、TPOT、end-to-end latency 分别改善了什么。

如果只给 40 分钟，建议优先看：模型结构图、LLM conversion pipeline、效率表、能力恢复表。若要进一步判断其对预训练的启发，重点找三类消融：一是没有 distillation 是否还能恢复；二是 DSSA 比例变化是否影响质量-效率平衡；三是 14B continued tokens 的每一阶段分别贡献了多少恢复效果。若正文没有给全，这篇就更适合作为工程路线参考，而不是直接照搬的训练法则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about training a new long-context model from scratch. Its central problem is how to migrate an existing Transformer or VLM checkpoint into a more efficient hybrid architecture for ultra-long context and cross-platform inference, while preserving as much of the original capability as possible under a limited training budget. The authors address two linked issues: attention becomes the dominant bottleneck at long sequence lengths, and architecture migration is usually expensive and fragile unless the training recipe is carefully staged.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model pretraining, the main relevance is practical rather than conceptual. The paper treats architecture migration as part of the pretrain-to-posttrain loop: start from a strong pretrained checkpoint, convert it through continued training and distillation, then recover instruction and reasoning ability after the architectural change. That is useful for continual pretraining, mid-training architecture replacement, and long-context extension. The contribution is best understood as an engineering-feasible conversion recipe plus a hybrid sparse-attention design, not as a new pretraining paradigm. Most of the evidence is about inference efficiency and capability recovery after conversion, rather than scaling behavior from scratch.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There are two main technical components. The first is the architecture, called Dual-Space Sparse Attention (DSSA). It alternates two sparse mechanisms across layers at roughly a 1:3 ratio. One is sparse softmax attention, implemented with MoBA, which operates over the exact uncompressed KV cache. The other is sparse linear attention, implemented with SSE, which works over compressed state representations. The design intent is straightforward: keep some exact retrieval capacity through sparse softmax layers, while using cheaper sparse linear layers for long-range modeling. This is not a pure replacement of full attention with linear attention; it is a hybrid where a small number of more precise layers act as anchors.

The second component is activation coding for deployment. For event-driven or neuromorphic hardware, the model uses integer quantization plus spike-sequence expansion so that dense matrix multiplications can be approximated by sparse integer accumulation. For GPUs, it uses FP8 to exploit Hopper Tensor Cores. This part is mostly about inference portability rather than pretraining objectives.

The more interesting part for pretraining researchers is the conversion pipeline. The LLM path starts from Qwen3-4B-Instruct and uses a multi-stage recipe: short-context distillation to transfer the base model into the hybrid architecture, then a three-stage long-context extension up to 512k, followed by general SFT and reasoning-oriented SFT, with some exploration of on-policy distillation. The VLM path is shorter, mainly knowledge distillation plus instruction SFT. The sequencing matters. The model first recovers base capability under the new architecture, then extends context length, then restores instruction and reasoning behavior. That ordering reduces the amount of distribution shift the model has to absorb at once.

An important design choice is that the authors do not train a new 5B hybrid model from scratch. They explicitly bet on continued training and distillation. That suggests they view architecture efficiency gains as large enough to justify migration, but not large enough to abandon the knowledge already stored in strong Transformer checkpoints.
summary_en.experiments:
The results are best read in three groups. First, efficiency. Under HuggingFace sequence-parallel inference, the model reports up to 10.13x TTFT speedup over the base Transformer at 4M context length. Under vLLM tensor-parallel inference at 512k length, it reports 4.5x, 1.12x, and 4.3x improvements in TTFT, TPOT, and end-to-end latency, respectively. Because of the lower memory footprint, the system can also serve sequences beyond 10M tokens on 8 A100 GPUs with chunked prefill. The pattern is familiar: the biggest gains are in long-context prefill, while TPOT improves more modestly.

Second, capability recovery. On the LLM side, the paper claims that SpB2.0 reaches more than 95% of Qwen3-4B performance on a broad benchmark average and consistently outperforms Qwen2.5-3B. After SFT, it approaches Qwen3 and surpasses the larger SpB1.0-7B. On the multimodal side, SpB2.0-VL is reported to be competitive with Qwen2.5-VL-3B and to recover much of Qwen3-VL-4B’s overall capability. The key point here is not the absolute score, but how much capability survives the architecture swap.

Third, training cost. The LLM conversion uses about 14B continued-pretraining tokens and costs roughly 4,656 A100 GPU hours, compared in the paper against 150B CPT tokens for SpB1.0. The VLM conversion costs about 1,977 A100 GPU hours. Together, both conversions stay under 7k A100 GPU hours and can be completed in about 9 days on 32 A100s. That is operationally meaningful because it turns architecture replacement from a full retraining project into a manageable continued-training project.

That said, the evidence is still more system-oriented than scientific. Important questions remain if the full text does not answer them in detail: whether the 1:3 DSSA ratio is robust across context lengths, how much distillation matters relative to plain continued training, how the long-context curriculum affects forgetting, and whether FP8 interacts with sparse attention in training stability. Those details matter for reproducibility and for deciding whether the recipe generalizes beyond this specific conversion.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is: conversion recipe first, architecture second, efficiency results third. Start with the introduction and the training pipeline figure to see that the main contribution is the migration recipe, not just a new sparse operator. Then read the DSSA section and focus on why MoBA and SSE are alternated at a 1:3 ratio instead of using a single sparse mechanism. After that, read the long-context extension and distillation sections, especially the stage ordering. Finally, read the inference benchmarks and separate TTFT, TPOT, and end-to-end latency, since they reflect different bottlenecks.

If you only have about 40 minutes, prioritize the model diagram, the LLM conversion pipeline, the efficiency tables, and the capability-recovery tables. If you want to judge its relevance for pretraining, look for three ablations: whether the model can recover without distillation, how sensitive the quality-efficiency trade-off is to the DSSA ratio, and how much each stage of the 14B-token continued-training budget contributes. If those are missing or thin, the paper is more useful as an engineering route for architecture migration than as a general training law.

recommendation.zh: 只看 DSSA 与 T2H 消融；若转换损失低，它会改变长上下文模型不必从零训的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the DSSA and T2H ablations; low conversion loss would weaken the prior that long-context hybrids must be trained from scratch.

paper.title: Sparse Forcing: Native Trainable Sparse Attention for Real-time Autoregressive Diffusion Video Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Sparse Forcing, a training-and-inference paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion models that improves long-horizon generation quality while reducing decoding latency. Sparse Forcing is motivated by an empirical observation in autoregressive diffusion rollouts: attention concentrates on a persistent subset of salient visual blocks, forming an implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, and exhibits a locally structured block-sparse pattern within sliding windows. Building on

summary.core_problem: 自回归扩散视频生成同时存在两个核心问题：一是长序列推理时全量注意力计算复杂度随上下文长度平方增长，延迟和显存开销过高；二是自回归迭代生成过程中预测误差不断累积，长时生成质量快速下降。
summary.importance: 打破了稀疏注意力仅用于效率优化的固有认知，证明结构化稀疏可以同时控制误差传播路径、提升长序列生成质量，相关设计可迁移到长上下文LLM预训练、AR+diffusion统一多模态建模范式的优化中。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过实验观察到自回归扩散迭代生成时，注意力会集中在少数持续存在的显著视觉块上，在KV缓存中形成隐式时空记忆，且局部滑动窗口内呈现块稀疏结构。基于该观察提出Sparse Forcing范式：可训练的原生稀疏机制会学习压缩、保留、更新这些持久块，同时将每个局部窗口的计算限制在动态选择的邻域内。配套开发了Persistent Block-Sparse Attention（PBSA）GPU内核，适配大规模训练和推理场景，降低延迟和显存占用。
summary.experiments: 已披露的结果显示，该方法在短视频生成上质量优于基线，扩展到分钟级长视频时质量增益无衰减，训练和推理端到端速度提升，显存占用降低，完整量化结果未在当前公开的部分内容中呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注引言中稀疏性抑制误差累积的逻辑分析、方法部分的可训练稀疏注意力设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive diffusion video generation faces two coupled core challenges: first, full attention introduces quadratic compute overhead with growing context length during long-sequence inference, leading to excessively high latency and memory footprint; second, prediction errors compound over autoregressive rollouts, causing rapid quality degradation for long-horizon generation.
summary_en.importance: It expands the application scope of sparse attention beyond pure efficiency optimization, proving structured sparsity can simultaneously regulate error propagation paths and improve long-sequence generation quality. The related design can be migrated to long-context LLM pretraining and optimization of unified AR+diffusion multimodal modeling paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first empirically observes that during autoregressive diffusion rollouts, attention concentrates on a small subset of persistent salient visual blocks, forming implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, with block-sparse patterns inside local sliding windows. Based on this observation, the Sparse Forcing paradigm is proposed: a trainable native sparsity mechanism that learns to compress, preserve and update these persistent blocks, while restricting computation within each local window to a dynamically selected neighborhood. A dedicated Persistent Block-Sparse Attention (PBSA) GPU kernel is developed to support large-scale training and inference with lower latency and memory footprint.
summary_en.experiments: Disclosed results show the method outperforms baselines on short video generation, and its quality gain remains stable when scaled to minute-level long videos. It delivers end-to-end speedup for both training and inference with reduced memory consumption. Full quantitative results are not included in the currently available partial content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the analysis of sparsity mitigating error propagation in the Introduction, and the trainable sparse attention design in the Methodology section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不属于 pretrain 核心，但“持久块记忆”这个观察值得看；先读注意力可视化和 PBSA 设计，看看是否能迁到长上下文多模态 LM。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the 'persistent block memory' observation is worth stealing; read the attention analysis and PBSA design to see if it transfers to long-context multimodal LMs.

paper.title: Forget, Then Recall: Learnable Compression and Selective Unfolding via Gist Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Scaling large language models to long contexts is challenging due to the quadratic computational cost of full attention. Mitigation approaches include KV-cache selection or compression techniques. We instead provide an effective and end-to-end learnable bridge between the two without requiring architecture modification. In particular, our key insight is that interleaved gist compression tokens -- which provide a learnable summary of sets of raw tokens -- can serve as routing signals for sparse a

summary.core_problem: 如何在不改 Transformer 主体架构的前提下，把“可学习的上下文压缩（gist tokens）”和“训练期稀疏注意力路由”统一起来：先压缩，再用压缩表示做选择路由，最后只对被选中的片段展开细读，从而在长上下文下显著降低注意力开销且尽量不掉能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练的启发点在于：把“压缩 token”从单纯的 KV-cache 替代物，升级为可微、端到端训练的路由信号（routing signal），从而把稀疏注意力的选择机制纳入预训练目标里学习，而不是推理期启发式 eviction/selection。它更像一种训练期长上下文稀疏化范式（coarse-to-fine），但论文重心偏高效注意力/长上下文训练，属于 pretrain 相关的系统性改造而非新建模目标。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Gist Sparse Attention (GSA) 的“压缩→选择→展开”三段式。
1) Interleaved gist tokens：在序列中按固定间隔插入 gist token，每个 gist 负责汇聚相邻一段 raw tokens（类似局部摘要）。相比 append-at-end 的 gist，这种布局让“gist ↔ chunk”对应关系更明确，便于后续选择与展开。
2) Compression as routing：先用 gist token 表示整段长上下文的粗粒度视图；对当前 query，基于其对各 gist 的注意力分数做 top-k 选择，选出最相关的若干 gist。
3) Selective unfolding：把被选 gist 对应的 raw token chunk 重新“展开”回可见上下文，让 query 对这些 chunk 做细粒度注意力；未被选中的 chunk 继续保持压缩态，避免全量二次方交互。
4) 训练方式：把上述机制放进训练期，使模型学会产生“既能压缩信息、又能作为路由信号”的 gist 表示。论文强调不需要像 NSA 那样改注意力结构分支；也不需要像 DSA 那样外置 indexer；相对 MoBA 的 mean-pooling gate，gist 是可学习且可通过梯度优化的路由载体。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格与具体数值（如训练 token 数、上下文长度、速度提升倍数、困惑度/下游指标等），因此无法基于全文确认定量结论。
从引言可确认的对比维度：在相同 token budget 下，selective unfolding 相比纯 gist 压缩（append 或 interleaved）以及推理期稀疏（如 KV eviction/selection）有更好的准确率；并把该机制纳入训练以获得更稳定的稀疏模式。但具体提升幅度、在哪些长上下文任务/基准上验证，需要以论文实验章节为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（~25–35 分钟）：
- 先看方法总览图（若有）和 Introduction：把它与 NSA/DSA/MoBA、以及两类 gist token 布局（append vs interleaved）的关系理清。
- 重点看“top-k 选择依据是什么、选择发生在 prefill 还是每层/每步、展开后的注意力计算如何限制 token budget、训练时梯度如何穿过选择/展开”的实现细节。
- 实验部分建议只抓三件事：1) 相同计算预算下的质量对比；2) 训练期引入 GSA 是否比推理期启发式更稳；3) 消融：没有 unfolding / 不同压缩比 / 不同 k / gist 插入频率对效果与成本的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: How to unify learnable context compression (gist tokens) with training-time sparse attention routing—without modifying the core Transformer architecture—via a coarse-to-fine pipeline that compresses first, selects relevant summaries, and then selectively restores the corresponding raw chunks for detailed attention.
summary_en.importance: The key pretraining-relevant idea is to turn compression tokens into differentiable routing signals learned end-to-end during pretraining, rather than relying on inference-time KV eviction/selection heuristics. Conceptually it bridges “KV compression” and “native sparse attention” by letting the model learn what to compress and how to route attention under a fixed token/compute budget. The contribution is primarily in long-context efficiency/training design, not in a new language modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Gist Sparse Attention (GSA) implements a three-stage coarse-to-fine mechanism:
1) Interleaved gist tokens: insert gist tokens at regular intervals so each gist corresponds to a local raw-token chunk.
2) Routing by gist attention: compute attention from the current query to gist tokens and perform top-k selection over gists.
3) Selective unfolding: re-introduce (unfold) the raw chunks associated with the selected gists, enabling fine-grained attention only over those chunks; the rest stays compressed.
4) Training-time integration: the whole mechanism is used during training so gist representations become both information-dense summaries and learnable gates. The paper positions this against NSA (architecture changes), DSA (external indexer), and MoBA (non-differentiable mean-pooling gates).
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experiment tables/metrics, so specific numbers (context length, compute savings, perplexity/accuracy deltas) cannot be verified here.
From the introduction-level claims: under the same token budget, selective unfolding improves accuracy over pure gist compression baselines (append-only and interleaved) and inference-only sparse attention methods; incorporating it into training yields a unified, end-to-end learnable sparse pattern. For quantitative conclusions, the experimental section is required.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 min):
- Read the Introduction and any method overview figure to understand how GSA relates to NSA/DSA/MoBA and to append-vs-interleaved gist designs.
- Focus on implementation details: what scores drive top-k selection, where selection happens (prefill vs per-layer), how unfolding respects a fixed token budget, and how training handles the (potentially) non-differentiable selection step.
- In experiments, extract: (1) quality vs compute at matched budgets, (2) training-time GSA vs inference-only sparsification, and (3) ablations on compression ratio, k, gist frequency, and unfolding on/off.

recommendation.zh: 可训练的粗细结合长上下文注意力设计，§3的gist路由机制可作为预训练长上下文优化的 ablation 候选
recommendation.en: Coarse-to-fine trainable long-context attention design, gist routing mechanism in §3 can be used as ablation candidate for pretraining long-context optimization

To address this issue, we propose \textbf{DynamicRad}, a unified sparse-attention paradigm that grounds adaptive selection within a radial locality prior. summary.core_problem: 现有长视频扩散模型的静态稀疏注意力掩码易丢失复杂动态场景下的关键长程信息，在线调整稀疏度存在过高开销。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出内容自适应稀疏注意力范式，在生成速度和质量之间取得更优平衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DynamicRad，采用双模式策略（静态比例模式优化速度、动态阈值模式优先质量），离线贝叶斯优化结合语义运动路由器，无在线搜索开销，基于物理代理任务优化注意力重构误差。
summary.experiments: 在混元视频等数据集测试，相比静态掩码方法在相当速度下生成质量更高，相比在线调整方法开销降低90%以上。
summary.authors_note: 电子科技大学、深圳高等研究院团队，无公开知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Static sparse attention masks in long video diffusion models easily lose critical long-range information in complex dynamic scenes, while online sparsity adjustment incurs excessive overhead.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a content-adaptive sparse attention paradigm that achieves better trade-off between generation speed and quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: DynamicRad adopts a dual-mode strategy (static ratio mode for speed optimization, dynamic threshold mode for quality priority), combines offline Bayesian optimization with semantic motion router, no online search overhead, optimizes attention reconstruction error based on physics proxy task.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on datasets including HunyuanVideo, achieves higher generation quality at comparable speed compared to static mask methods, reduces overhead by over 90% compared to online adjustment methods.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Shenzhen Institute for Advanced Study, no publicly well-known authors.

recommendation.zh: 稀疏注意力离线调优思路可作为多模态生成预训练的弱参考，仅看摘要和实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: The offline sparse attention tuning idea can be a weak reference for multimodal generation pretraining, only read abstract and experiment section.
